questions.text: Which of the following physical security methods is the MOST effective to prevent tailgating?
options: Biometrics in an access control vestibule
Badge readers plus a PIN pad
questions.explanation: An access control vestibule with biometrics only allows one authenticated person through at a time, directly preventing tailgating. Badge plus PIN pad still allows a second person to slip in behind an authorized user.

questions.text:
A network client is trying to connect to the wrong TCP port.
Which of the following responses would the client MOST likely receive?
questions.explanation: Connecting to a closed TCP port causes the host to respond with a TCP RST to terminate the attempted connection. FIN is used to gracefully close an established session, not reject one.

questions.text:
A company's data center is hosted at its corporate office to ensure greater control over the security of sensitive data. During times when there are increased workloads, some of the company's non-sensitive data is shifted to an external cloud provider.
Which of the following cloud deployment models does this describe?
questions.explanation: Using an on-premises private data center combined with bursting non-sensitive workloads to a public cloud provider is a hybrid cloud deployment. A pure public model would mean all data is hosted externally, which contradicts keeping sensitive data on-site.

questions.text:
A network engineer needs to create a subnet that has the capacity for five VLANs, with the following number of clients to be allowed on each:
Which of the following is the SMALLEST subnet capable of this setup that also has the capacity to double the number of clients in the future?
questions.explanation: The VLANs total 340 clients, so doubling needs 680 addresses. A /22 provides 1,022 usable hosts, enough even with each VLAN in its own doubled subnet (256+256+128+128+64 = 832). A /23 offers only 510, too few, and a /21 works but is not the smallest.

VLAN 20  VoIP phones             90
VLAN 30  Wireless clients        60
VLAN 40  Printers                50
VLAN 50  Servers                 20

         Total                  340

questions.text:
A network technician is selecting a replacement for a damaged fiber cable that goes directly to an SFP transceiver on a network switch.
Which of the following cable connectors should be used?
questions.explanation: SFP transceivers typically use LC connectors for fiber connections. RJ45 and F-type are copper connectors, and MT is a fiber connector type used for ribbon cables, not typical SFP terminations.

questions.text:
A company is deploying a SAN at headquarters and a branch office 1,000mi (1,609km) away that will access small amounts of data.
Which of the following types of connections would be MOST cost effective to implement?
questions.explanation: iSCSI runs SAN traffic over standard IP/Ethernet networks, making it far more cost-effective over long distances than Fibre Channel (FC) or FCoE, which require dedicated fiber infrastructure.

questions.text:
A company wants to add a local redundant data center to its network in case of failure at its primary location.
Which of the following would give the LEAST amount of redundancy for the company's network?
questions.explanation: A cold site has minimal equipment and requires significant setup time before it can take over operations, giving the least redundancy compared to warm or hot sites.

questions.text:
A new student is given credentials to log on to the campus Wi-Fi. The student stores the password in a laptop and is able to connect; however, the student is not able to connect with a phone when only a short distance from the laptop. Given the following information:
Which of the following is MOST likely causing this connection failure?
questions.explanation: The EAPOL msg2 MIC failure followed by a 4-way handshake timeout indicates the phone is presenting an incorrect passphrase/PSK, causing authentication to fail despite good signal strength. Signal strength and data rate are not the issue since RSSI is strong (-51 dBm) and association succeeded.

questions.text:
A technician manages a DHCP scope but needs to allocate a portion of the scope’s subnet for statically assigned devices.
Which of the following DHCP concepts would be BEST to use to prevent IP address conflicts?
questions.explanation: An exclusion range removes a set of addresses from the DHCP pool so they won't be handed out dynamically, preventing conflicts with statically assigned devices. Address reservation instead ties a specific IP to a MAC within the pool, not the best fit for a whole static range.

questions.text:
Due to a surge in business, a company is onboarding an unusually high number of salespeople. The salespeople are assigned desktops that are wired to the network. The last few salespeople to be onboarded are able to access corporate materials on the network but not sales-specific resources.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause?
options: The switch was configured with port security.
Newly added machines are running into DHCP conflicts.
The IPS was not configured to recognize the new users.
Recently added users were assigned to the wrong VLAN
questions.explanation: Access to only general corporate resources but not sales-specific resources indicates the new desktops were placed on the wrong VLAN, missing access to the sales network segment. Port security or DHCP conflicts would typically block connectivity entirely rather than allow partial access.

questions.text:
A technician wants to monitor and provide traffic segmentation across the network. The technician would like to assign each department a specific identifier.
Which of the following will the technician MOST likely use?
questions.explanation: VLAN tagging assigns each department a unique identifier for traffic segmentation and monitoring across switches. Traffic shaping and flow control manage bandwidth, not logical segmentation.

questions.text:
Network users reported that a recent firmware upgrade to a firewall did not resolve the issue that prompted the upgrade.
Which of the following should be performed NEXT?
options: Reopen the service ticket, request a new maintenance window, and roll back to the anterior firmware version.
Verify the reported issue actually matches the original problem and isn't a separate issue with similar symptoms
Employ a divide-and-conquer troubleshooting methodology by engaging the firewall vendor's support.
Escalate the issue to the IT management team in order to negotiate a new SLA with the user's manager.
questions.explanation: Before rolling back or escalating, the technician should verify the reported issue actually matches the original problem and isn't a separate issue with similar symptoms, following proper troubleshooting methodology.

questions.text:
An administrator would like to allow Windows clients from outside the office to access workstations without using third-party software.
Which of the following access methods would meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: Remote Desktop Gateway allows external Windows clients to connect to internal workstations using native RDP without third-party software. VNC requires third-party client software, which is excluded here.

questions.text:
A client who shares office space and an IT closet with another company recently reported connectivity issues throughout the network. Multiple third-party vendors regularly perform on-site maintenance in the shared IT closet.
Which of the following security techniques would BEST secure the physical networking equipment?
questions.explanation: With untrusted vendors physically in the shared closet, shutting down unused switchports stops unauthorized devices from being plugged into the network equipment. Role-based access controls administrative accounts, not physical port access in a shared closet.

questions.text:
A network engineer is investigating issues on a Layer 2 switch. The department typically shares a switchport during meetings for presentations, but after the first user shares, no other users can connect.
Which of the following is MOST likely related to this issue?
options: Spanning Tree Protocol is enabled on the switch.
VLAN trunking is enabled on the switch.
Port security is configured on the switch.
Dynamic ARP inspection is configured on the switch.
questions.explanation: Port security configured to allow only one MAC address per port would lock out additional devices after the first user connects, exactly matching the described symptom. STP or trunking wouldn't cause this specific single-device restriction.

questions.text:
A company's primary ISP is experiencing an outage. However, the network administrator notices traffic continuing to flow through a secondary connection to the same ISP.
Which of the following BEST describes this configuration?
questions.explanation: Having two separate physical connections to the same ISP so traffic can continue if one path fails describes diverse paths (path redundancy). Load balancing and multipathing describe distributing traffic across active links rather than failover redundancy.

questions.text: A company's web server is hosted at a local ISP. This is an example of:
questions.explanation: Hosting a company's own server equipment at a third-party ISP facility is colocation. A cloud provider would involve using the provider's virtualized services rather than hosting owned hardware.

questions.text:
A network administrator is preparing answers for an annual risk assessment that is required for compliance purposes.
Which of the following would be an example of an internal threat?
options: An approved vendor with on-site offices
An infected client that pulls reports from the firm
A malicious attacker from within the same country
A malicious attacker attempting to socially engineer access into corporate offices
questions.explanation: An infected client within the organization pulling reports represents an internal threat originating from inside the network. A vendor with on-site offices or an external attacker are external threats even if physically present or nearby.

questions.text: Classification using labels according to information sensitivity and impact in case of unauthorized access or leakage is a mandatory component of:
questions.explanation: Data loss prevention programs require classifying data by sensitivity labels to determine appropriate handling and protection. Acceptable use policies and NDAs govern behavior and confidentiality agreements, not data classification.

questions.text:
A technician is trying to install a VoIP phone, but the phone is not turning on. The technician checks the cable going from the phone to the switch, and the cable is good.
Which of the following actions is needed for this phone to work?
questions.explanation: Since the cable is confirmed good but the phone won't power on, adding a PoE injector supplies the electrical power the switch port isn't providing. Reconfiguring the port or changing cable type wouldn't address lack of power.

questions.text: Which of the following is MOST appropriate for enforcing bandwidth limits when the performance of an application is not affected by the use of buffering but is heavily impacted by packet drops?
questions.explanation: Traffic shaping buffers excess packets to smooth bursts and enforce bandwidth limits without dropping packets, ideal when packet drops severely impact performance. Traffic policing instead drops or remarks excess traffic immediately, which is worse here.

questions.text:
A client utilizes mobile tablets to view high-resolution images and videos via Wi-Fi within a corporate office building. The previous administrator installed multiple high-density APs with Wi-Fi 5, providing maximum coverage, but the measured performance is still below expected levels.
Which of the following would provide the BEST solution?
questions.explanation: Wi-Fi 5 supports 40/80/160MHz channel bonding, which raises per-client throughput for high-resolution image and video streaming when coverage is already adequate. A directional antenna would narrow coverage rather than increase the throughput the tablets need.

questions.text:
A network technician is troubleshooting a new web server connectivity issue. The network technician discovers the following on the support ticket:

• The server’s IP address can be pinged from the client PCs.
• Access to the web resource works correctly when on the server's console.
• No clients can access the server’s data via URL.
• The server does not have a firewall configured.
• No ACLs are preventing connectivity from the client's network.
• All services on the server are operating normally, which was confirmed by the server team.

Which of the following actions will resolve the issue?
options: Reset port security on the switchport connecting the server.
Adjust the web server's NTP setting to match the client settings.
Configure A records for the web server.
Install the correct MIB on the web server.
questions.explanation: Clients access the server by URL, so a missing or incorrect A record prevents DNS from resolving the hostname to the server's IP, even though pings and console access work fine. Port security, NTP, and MIB installation would not cause a URL-only access failure.

questions.text: Which of the following layers of the OSI model has new protocols activated when a user moves from a wireless to a wired connection?
questions.explanation: The data link layer protocols differ between wireless (802.11) and wired (Ethernet) connections, so switching media activates new data link layer protocols. Network layer addressing (IP) typically remains unchanged.

questions.text: A technician is assisting a user who cannot connect to a website. The technician attempts to ping the default gateway and DNS server of the workstation. According to troubleshooting methodology, this is an example of:
questions.explanation: Pinging the default gateway and DNS server tests lower-layer connectivity before moving up to application-level issues, characteristic of a bottom-up approach. A top-to-bottom approach would start at the application layer instead.

questions.text: Which of the following is the NEXT step to perform network troubleshooting after identifying an issue?
questions.explanation: After identifying the problem, the next step in the troubleshooting methodology is to establish a theory of probable cause. Implementing a solution comes later, after testing the theory.

questions.text:
A network team is getting reports that air conditioning is out in an IDF. The team would like to determine whether additional network issues are occurring.
Which of the following should the network team do?
options: Confirm that memory usage on the network devices in the IDF is normal.
Access network baseline data for references to an air conditioning issue.
Verify severity levels on the corporate syslog server.
Check for SNMP traps from a network device in the IDF.
Review interface statistics looking for cyclic redundancy errors.
questions.explanation: Checking for SNMP traps from network devices in the IDF can reveal environmental alerts (like high temperature) tied to the air conditioning failure, indicating additional network issues. Baseline data would not contain environmental alert references.

questions.text: Which of the following is the MOST cost-effective alternative that provides proper cabling and supports gigabit Ethernet devices?
options: Twisted cable with a minimum Cat 5e certification
Multimode fiber with an SC connector
Twinaxial cabling using an F-type connector
questions.explanation: Cat 5e twisted-pair cabling is the most cost-effective option that still supports gigabit Ethernet. Fiber and twinaxial solutions are more expensive and unnecessary for this requirement.

questions.text:
A technician is installing the Wi-Fi infrastructure for legacy industrial machinery at a warehouse. The equipment only supports 802.11a and 802.11b standards. Speed of transmission is the top business requirement.
Which of the following is the correct maximum speed for this scenario?
questions.explanation: 802.11a supports a maximum data rate of 54Mbps, which is higher than 802.11b's 11Mbps, so the maximum achievable speed in this scenario is 54Mbps. 11Mbps is only the 802.11b limit, not the maximum for the mixed environment.

questions.text: Which of the following would be the BEST choice to connect branch sites to a main office securely?
questions.explanation: A VPN headend terminates multiple site-to-site VPN tunnels, providing secure encrypted connectivity between branch sites and the main office. A proxy server or load balancer does not provide this secure tunneling function.

questions.text:
Due to concerns around single points of failure, a company decided to add an additional WAN to the network. The company added a second MPLS vendor to the current MPLS WAN and deployed an additional WAN router at each site. Both MPLS providers use OSPF on the WAN network, and EIGRP is run internally. The first site to go live with the new WAN is successful, but when the second site is activated significant network issues occur.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause for the WAN instability?
questions.explanation: Running OSPF on both MPLS WAN links with EIGRP internally can create asymmetrical routing paths between sites, causing instability when the second WAN link becomes active. A switching loop wouldn't be specific to routing protocol design changes.

questions.text:
During the troubleshooting of an E1 line, the point-to-point link on the core router was accidentally unplugged and left unconnected for several hours. However, the network management team was not notified.
Which of the following could have been configured to allow early detection and possible resolution of the issue?
questions.explanation: SNMP traps proactively notify network management systems of state changes, such as an interface going down, enabling early detection. Baselines only provide historical comparison data, not real-time alerts.

questions.text: Which of the following layers of the OSI model receives data from the application layer and converts it into syntax that is readable by other devices on the network?
questions.explanation: The presentation layer (Layer 6) takes data from the application layer and translates it into a standardized format readable across the network. Layer 7 is the application layer itself, which generates the data rather than converting its syntax.

questions.text: Which of the following topologies is designed to fully support applications hosted in on-premises data centers, public or private clouds, and SaaS services?
questions.explanation: SD-WAN is designed to intelligently route traffic across multiple connection types to support applications hosted on-premises, in the cloud, or as SaaS. MPLS is a single transport technology and doesn't inherently provide this application-aware flexibility.

questions.text:
A Chief Executive Officer and a network administrator came to an agreement with a vendor to purchase new equipment for the data center. A document was drafted so all parties would be informed about the scope of the project before it started.
Which of the following terms BEST describes the document used?
questions.explanation: A memorandum of understanding documents a mutual, generally non-binding statement of intent and scope among parties before work begins, which matches the described document. A project charter is not a Network+ objective term, and a contract would be the binding purchase instrument, not a scope notification.

questions.text: ARP spoofing would normally be a part of:
questions.explanation: ARP spoofing is commonly used to redirect traffic through an attacker's device, forming the basis of an on-path (man-in-the-middle) attack. DNS poisoning targets name resolution, not ARP tables.

questions.text:
A corporation is looking for a method to secure all traffic between a branch office and its data center in order to provide a zero-touch experience for all staff members who work there.
Which of the following would BEST meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: A site-to-site VPN automatically encrypts all traffic between the branch office and data center without requiring any user interaction, providing a zero-touch experience. VNC and remote desktop gateway require user-initiated sessions.

questions.text:
A company cell phone was stolen from a technician's vehicle. The cell phone has a passcode, but it contains sensitive information about clients and vendors.
Which of the following should also be enabled?
questions.explanation: Enabling encryption ensures that even if the passcode is bypassed, the sensitive data on the stolen phone remains unreadable. Autolock alone doesn't protect data if the device is later compromised.

questions.text:
An organization is interested in purchasing a backup solution that supports the organization's goals.
Which of the following concepts would specify the maximum duration that a given service can be down before impacting operations?
questions.explanation: Recovery Time Objective (RTO) defines the maximum acceptable downtime for a service before it impacts operations. MTBF measures average time between failures, not acceptable downtime.

questions.text:
During an annual review of policy documents, a company decided to adjust its recovery time frames. The company agreed that critical applications can be down for no more than six hours, and the acceptable amount of data loss is no more than two hours.
Which of the following should be documented as the RPO?
questions.explanation: RPO defines the maximum acceptable amount of data loss, which is stated as two hours in this scenario. The six-hour figure corresponds to RTO, the maximum downtime for critical applications.

questions.text:
A network administrator is given the network 80.87.78.0/26 for specific device assignments.
Which of the following describes this network?
questions.explanation: A /26 subnet has 64 addresses with a usable host range of 80.87.78.1 to 80.87.78.62, excluding the network and broadcast addresses. The other ranges don't match the /26 subnet boundaries.

questions.text:
An organization set up its offices so that a desktop is connected to the network through a VoIP phone. The VoIP vendor requested that voice traffic be segmented separately from non-voice traffic.
Which of the following would allow the organization to configure multiple devices with network isolation on a single switch port?
questions.explanation: Subinterfaces, combined with VLAN tagging (802.1Q), allow a single switch port to carry isolated voice and data VLANs to separate devices like a VoIP phone and desktop. Link aggregation combines links for bandwidth, not traffic isolation.

questions.text:
An attacker targeting a large company was able to inject malicious A records into internal name resolution servers.
Which of the following attack types was MOST likely used?
questions.explanation: Injecting malicious A records into name resolution servers is DNS poisoning, which redirects users to attacker-controlled sites. An on-path attack intercepts traffic between two parties but doesn't involve altering DNS records directly.

questions.text:
The following DHCP scope was configured for a new VLAN dedicated to a large deployment of 325 IoT sensors:
The first 244 IoT sensors were able to connect to the TFTP server, download the configuration file, and register to an IoT management system. The other sensors are being shown as offline.
Which of the following should be performed to determine the MOST likely cause of the partial deployment of the sensors?
options: Check the gateway connectivity to the TFTP server.
Check whether the NTP server is online.
Check the IoT devices for a hardware failure.
questions.explanation: The DHCP scope shows 244 addresses in use and 0 available out of a pool designed for only 244 usable addresses (.10-.253), meaning the scope is too small for 325 sensors and is exhausted, leaving the remaining sensors unable to obtain an IP. Checking TFTP or NTP wouldn't explain devices failing before even registering.

questions.text:
A network technician receives a report from the server team that a server's network connection is not working correctly. The server team confirms the server is operating correctly except for the network connection. The technician checks the switchport connected to the server and reviews the following data:
Which of the following should the network technician perform to correct the issue?
options: Replace the Cat 5 patch cable with a Cat 6 cable.
Install a crossover cable between the server and the switch.
Use NetFlow data from the switch to isolate the issue.
Disable MDIX on the switchport and reboot the server.
questions.explanation: The server NIC advertises 1000Mb/s but the link settled at 100Mb/s with rising CRC errors, and the record shows a Cat 5 patch cable in the channel, which cannot support Gigabit reliably; replacing it with Cat 6 fixes the speed and errors. Resetting the switchport configuration would not change the cable's bandwidth limitation.

questions.text: Which of the following would be BEST to install to find and block any malicious users within a network?
questions.explanation: An IPS both detects and actively blocks malicious traffic, whereas an IDS only detects and alerts without blocking. SCADA and ICS are industrial control systems, not security monitoring tools.

questions.text: Which of the following can be used to validate domain ownership by verifying the presence of pre-agreed content contained in a DNS record?
questions.explanation: TXT records store arbitrary text data, commonly used to verify domain ownership by requiring a specific string to be published. SOA records define zone authority information, not ownership verification content.

questions.text:
Network traffic is being compromised by DNS poisoning every time a company's router is connected to the internet. The network team detects a non-authorized DNS server being assigned to the network clients and remediates the incident by setting a trusted DNS server, but the issue occurs again after internet exposure.
Which of the following best practices should be implemented on the router?
questions.explanation: If a rogue DNS server keeps getting assigned after every internet exposure, the router itself was likely compromised via default credentials, so changing the default password prevents unauthorized reconfiguration. Disabling unneeded services wouldn't stop an attacker who already has admin access.

questions.text:
A network administrator installed a new data and VoIP network. Users are now experiencing poor call quality when making calls.
Which of the following should the administrator do to increase VoIP performance?
options: Configure LACP on all VoIP phones.
Configure jumbo frames on the network.
questions.explanation: Configuring a voice VLAN separates and prioritizes VoIP traffic from data traffic, improving call quality through proper QoS treatment. Configuring jumbo frames helps large data transfers, not latency-sensitive voice traffic.

questions.text:
A Wi-Fi network was originally configured to be able to handle interference from a microwave oven. The microwave oven was recently removed from the office. Now the network administrator wants to optimize the system to maximize the range of the signal. The main sources of signal degradation are the numerous cubicles and wooden walls between the WAP and the intended destination.
Which of the following actions should the administrator take?
questions.explanation: Since the microwave interference issue is gone, switching to a frequency (like 5GHz to 2.4GHz or vice versa) with better penetration through walls and cubicles can improve range; specifically, lower frequency (2.4GHz) penetrates walls better than 5GHz. Changing to directional antennas would reduce coverage area rather than maximize overall range through obstacles in multiple directions.

questions.text: Which of the following issues are present with RIPv2? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: RIPv2 suffers from slow convergence time and poor scalability due to its 15-hop limit and periodic full-table updates. Route poisoning is actually a mechanism RIP uses to prevent loops, not a weakness.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols can be used to change device configurations via encrypted and authenticated sessions? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: SNMPv3 and SSH both provide encrypted, authenticated sessions for managing device configurations. Telnet sends data in cleartext, and IPSec/ESP secure IP traffic generally rather than serving as device configuration protocols.

questions.text:
An administrator wants to increase the availability of a server that is connected to the office network.
Which of the following allows for multiple NICs to share a single IP address and offers maximum performance while providing fault tolerance in the event of a NIC failure?
questions.explanation: Multipathing allows multiple NICs to share a single IP and provide load balancing plus fault tolerance for a single server. First Hop Redundancy Protocol provides gateway redundancy for routers, not NIC-level server redundancy.

questions.text:
A network administrator has received calls every day for the past few weeks from three users who cannot access the network. The administrator asks all the users to reboot their PCs, but the same users still cannot access the system. The following day, three different users report the same issue, and the administrator asks them all to reboot their PCs; however, this does not fix the issue.
Which of the following is MOST likely occurring?
questions.explanation: Recurring failures affecting different sets of users each day, unresolved by rebooting, suggests DHCP scope exhaustion where some clients fail to obtain new leases. Hardware failure would typically affect the same users consistently, not rotate among different ones.

questions.text:

The network administrator is unable to use SSH to connect to the switch but is able to gain access using the serial console port. While monitoring port statistics, the administrator sees the following:
Which of the following is MOST likely causing the network outage?
questions.explanation: Broadcasts are saturating three ports at nearly 100% utilization and the same MAC address is flapping between Gi0/1 and Gi0/3, which is the signature of a bridging loop broadcast storm. A duplicate IP address would not flood every port, and the counters show zero collisions and zero CRC errors.

questions.text:
A network technician recently installed 35 additional workstations. After installation, some users are unable to access network resources. Many of the original workstations that are experiencing the network access issue were offline when the new workstations were turned on.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of this issue?
questions.explanation: Adding 35 new workstations likely exhausted the DHCP scope, so when new devices took addresses, previously offline original workstations couldn't get leases upon reconnecting. Incorrect VLAN settings wouldn't cause intermittent failures tied to workstation count and offline status.

questions.text:
A WAN technician reviews activity and identifies newly installed hardware that is causing outages over an eight-hour period.
Which of the following should be considered FIRST?
questions.explanation: When new hardware causes outages, reviewing its device configuration first identifies misconfigurations introduced during installation. Checking network performance baselines is useful for comparison but doesn't directly investigate the new device's setup.

questions.text: Which of the following would enable a network technician to implement dynamic routing?
questions.explanation: A Layer 3 switch supports dynamic routing protocols like OSPF or EIGRP, enabling routing between VLANs and networks. A hub and bridge operate at Layer 1/2 and cannot perform routing functions.

questions.text: Which of the following would be BEST suited for a long cable run with a 40Gbps bandwidth?
questions.explanation: Cat 8 cable supports up to 40Gbps over short distances but is rated for long runs at reduced speeds better than lower categories; among the options, Cat 8 supports the highest bandwidth needed for 40Gbps. Cat 6a only supports up to 10Gbps, insufficient for this requirement.

questions.text: Which of the following is a valid and cost-effective solution to connect a fiber cable into a network switch without available SFP ports?
options: Use a media converter and a UTP cable
Install an additional transceiver module and use GBICs
Change the type of connector from SC to F-type
Use a loopback adapter to make the connection
questions.explanation: A media converter allows a fiber cable to connect to a switch's UTP port when SFP ports aren't available, providing a cost-effective solution. Installing additional transceiver modules requires available SFP slots, which the switch lacks.

questions.text:
A network device needs to discover a server that can provide it with an IPv4 address.
Which of the following does the device need to send the request to?
questions.explanation: A device seeking an IPv4 address via DHCP sends a discover message to the broadcast address since it has no IP configuration yet. It cannot use a default gateway or unicast address because it doesn't know the DHCP server's location.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of on-demand scalable hardware that is typically housed in the vendor's data center?
questions.explanation: IaaS provides on-demand scalable infrastructure hardware (compute, storage, networking) hosted in the provider's data center. SaaS delivers software applications, not raw scalable hardware.

questions.text:
A network security engineer locates an unapproved wireless bridge connected to the corporate LAN that is broadcasting a hidden SSID, providing unauthenticated access to internal resources.
Which of the following types of attacks BEST describes this finding?
questions.explanation: An unapproved wireless access point connected to the corporate LAN providing unauthenticated access is a rogue access point. An evil twin mimics a legitimate SSID to trick users, but this device uses a hidden SSID, not an impersonation of a legitimate network name.

questions.text:
While setting up a new workstation, a technician discovers that the network connection is only 100 full duplex (FD), although it is connected to a gigabit switch. While reviewing the interface information in the switch CLI, the technician notes the port is operating at 100FD but shows many RX and TX errors. The technician moves the computer to another switchport and experiences the same issues.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause of the low data rate and port errors?
questions.explanation: A cable wired with an incorrect pin-out (only two usable pairs plus split pairs) forces 100FD negotiation and generates RX/TX errors, and the fault follows the cable to another port. Excessive cable length would typically cause intermittent loss rather than a consistent 100FD link with this error pattern.

questions.text:
A technician is contracted to install a redundant cluster of devices from the ISP in case of hardware failure within the network.
Which of the following would provide BEST redundant solution in Layer 2 devices?
questions.explanation: Switches operate at Layer 2 and can be deployed in redundant pairs using protocols like STP for failover. Routers and firewalls operate at Layer 3, and bridges are largely obsolete for this purpose.

questions.text: Which of the following documents is MOST likely to be associated with identifying and documenting critical applications?
questions.explanation: A business continuity plan identifies critical applications and systems needed to maintain operations during a disruption. Change management policy governs how changes are approved, not application criticality.

questions.text:
A security vendor needs to add a note to the DNS to validate the ownership of a company domain before services begin.
Which of the following records did the security company MOST likely ask the company to configure?
questions.explanation: TXT records are commonly used for domain ownership verification since they can hold arbitrary text tokens issued by the verifying service. CNAME and AAAA records serve aliasing and IPv6 addressing purposes, not verification.

questions.text:
A help desk engineer needs to configure two servers to have the same public IP addresses.
Which of the following technologies should the engineer use?
questions.explanation: A virtual IP (VIP) allows multiple servers to share the same public-facing IP address, typically for load balancing or failover. NAT translates addresses but doesn't inherently make two servers share one IP for clients.

questions.text:
A switch is connected to another switch. Incompatible hardware causes a surge in traffic on both switches.
Which of the following configurations will cause traffic to pause, allowing the switches to drain buffers?
questions.explanation: Flow control (802.3x/PAUSE frames) allows a switch to signal the sender to pause transmission, letting buffers drain and preventing drops from congestion. Speed and duplex settings don't provide this pause mechanism.

questions.text: Which of the following records can be used to track the number of changes on a DNS zone?
questions.explanation: The SOA record contains a serial number that increments with each change to the DNS zone, allowing tracking of zone updates. NS records simply list authoritative name servers without change tracking.

questions.text:
A network administrator is investigating a performance issue on a dual-link connection — VPN and MPLS — to a partner network. The MPLS is the primary path, and the VPN is used as a backup. While communicating, the delay is measured at 18ms, which is higher than the 6ms expected when the MPLS link is operational but lower than the 30ms expected for the VPN connection.
Which of the following will MOST likely point to the root cause of the issue?
options: Checking the routing tables on both sides to ensure there is no asymmetric routing
Checking on the partner network for a missing route pointing to the VPN connection
Running iPerf on both sides to confirm the delay that is measured is accurate
Checking for an incorrect VLAN assignment affecting the MPLS traffic
questions.explanation: A latency between the expected MPLS and VPN values suggests traffic may be taking an asymmetric path across both links, so checking routing tables for asymmetric routing is the logical troubleshooting step. Running iPerf only confirms the measurement, not the cause.

questions.text: Which of the following is a requirement when certifying a network cabling as Cat 7?
options: Ensure the patch panel is certified for the same category.
Use F-type connectors on the network terminations.
Ensure the termination standard is TIA/EIA-568-A.
questions.explanation: Cat 7 certification requires that all components in the channel, including the patch panel, be rated for Cat 7 performance to ensure end-to-end compliance. F-type connectors are used for coax, not twisted-pair Cat 7 cabling.

questions.text: Which of the following architectures is used for FTP?
questions.explanation: FTP uses a client-server architecture, where a client connects to an FTP server to transfer files. It is not primarily described as service-oriented or data-centric in Network+ terminology.

questions.text: Which of the following bandwidth management techniques uses butters at the client side to prevent TCP retransmissions from occurring when the ISP starts to drop packets of specific types that exceed the agreed traffic rate?
questions.explanation: Traffic shaping buffers packets at the client/sender side to smooth bursts and avoid exceeding rate limits, preventing drops and retransmissions. Traffic policing instead drops or remarks excess packets rather than buffering them.

questions.text:
An engineer needs to verify the external record for SMTP traffic. The engineer logged in to the server and entered the nslookup command.
Which of the following commands should the engineer send before entering the DNS name?
questions.explanation: Setting querytype=MX before entering the domain name tells nslookup to look up mail exchange records, which is needed to verify SMTP-related DNS entries. Setting type=A would only return address records, not mail server info.

questions.text:
A security engineer is trying to determine whether an internal server was accessed by hosts on the internet. The internal server was shut down during the investigation.
Which of the following will the engineer review to determine whether the internal server had an unauthorized access attempt?
options: The audit logs on the core switch
questions.explanation: Firewall logs record inbound and outbound connection attempts, including unauthorized access attempts from the internet, even after the server is shut down. The ARP table and audit logs on the core switch would not capture external access attempts.

questions.text:
A company is reviewing ways to cut the overall cost of its IT budget. A network technician suggests removing various computer programs from the IT budget and only providing these programs on an as-needed basis.
Which of the following models would meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: SaaS provides software applications on an as-needed, subscription basis without requiring upfront licensing costs, fitting the cost-cutting goal. IaaS provides infrastructure, not application software.

questions.text:
An IP address is maintained despite a failing UPS that causes a workstation to restart several times.
Which of the following would allow this to occur?
questions.explanation: A DHCP reservation ensures a specific device always receives the same IP address based on its MAC address, maintaining the address across reboots. A DHCP scope just defines the address pool, not a guaranteed static assignment.

questions.text: A network administrator wants to control new router deployments via the use of application programming interfaces (APIs). This would be an example of:
questions.explanation: Software-defined networking uses APIs to programmatically control and automate network device configuration and deployment. A three-tiered architecture and collapsed backbone describe physical/logical topology, not API-driven control.

questions.text:
A technician is equipped with a tablet, a smartphone, and a laptop to troubleshoot a switch with the help of support over the phone. However, the technician is having issues interconnecting all these tools in troubleshooting the switch.
Which of the following should the technician use to gain connectivity?
questions.explanation: A personal area network (PAN), such as Bluetooth, is used to interconnect nearby personal devices like a tablet, smartphone, and laptop for short-range connectivity. LAN and WAN describe larger-scale networks, not device-to-device pairing.

questions.text:
Users within a corporate network need to connect to the internet, but corporate network policy does not allow direct connections.
Which of the following is MOST likely to be used?
questions.explanation: A proxy server sits between users and the internet, forwarding requests on their behalf so users never connect directly, enforcing policy restrictions. A VPN client is used for remote access to a private network, not for blocking direct internet connections.

questions.text:
A network is secured and is only accessible via TLS and IPSec VPNs.
Which of the following would need to be present to allow a user to access network resources on a laptop without logging in to the VPN application?
questions.explanation: A site-to-site IPSec tunnel is always on between locations, so a laptop on that network reaches resources without launching a client VPN. In-band management describes administering devices over the production network and does not grant user access across the secured boundary.

questions.text:
A technician is checking network devices to look for opportunities to improve security.
Which of the following tools would BEST accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: Nmap can scan network devices for open ports and services, revealing potential security weaknesses and misconfigurations. A Wi-Fi analyzer and IP scanner focus on wireless signals or address discovery, not security posture.

questions.text: Which of the following describes when an active exploit is used to gain access to a network?
questions.explanation: Penetration testing involves actively exploiting vulnerabilities to gain access and demonstrate real-world risk. Vulnerability testing only identifies weaknesses without actively exploiting them.

questions.text:
A homeowner frequently has guests visit and would like to install a wireless router for their personal devices. The homeowner wants to ensure that the wireless router is compatible with the widest range of devices possible.
Which of the following standards should a technician suggest?
questions.explanation: 802.11n operates in both 2.4GHz and 5GHz and is backward compatible with 802.11a/b/g, giving the widest device support of the listed standards. 802.11g is 2.4GHz only and excludes 802.11a and 5GHz-only clients.

questions.text:
A GRE tunnel has been configured between two remote sites.
Which of the following features, when configured, ensures the GRE overhead does not affect payload?
questions.explanation: Jumbo frames increase the maximum frame size, accommodating the additional GRE encapsulation overhead without fragmenting or reducing the payload. The other options relate to physical link negotiation, not encapsulation overhead.

questions.text: Which of the following attacks MOST likely utilizes a botnet to disrupt traffic?
questions.explanation: A DDoS attack uses a botnet of compromised devices to flood traffic and disrupt services. Deauthentication and DNS poisoning don't typically rely on botnets for traffic disruption.

questions.text:
A network administrator is looking at switch features and is unsure whether to purchase a model with PoE.
Which of the following devices that commonly utilize PoE should the administrator consider? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: VoIP phones and cameras commonly draw power over Ethernet via PoE-enabled switches. Printers, cable modems, and laptops typically use their own power sources.

questions.text:
All packets arriving at an interface need to be fully analyzed.
Which of the following features should be used to enable monitoring of the packets?
questions.explanation: Port mirroring copies traffic from one port to another so it can be fully analyzed, such as with a packet sniffer. LACP and flow control manage link aggregation and congestion, not analysis.

questions.text: Which of the following record types would be used to define where SIP is found?
questions.explanation: SRV records specify the location (host and port) of services like SIP. A, CNAME, and MX records serve different purposes such as IP mapping, aliasing, and mail routing.

questions.text: Which of the following is an advanced distance vector routing protocol that automates routing tables and also uses some features of link-state routing protocols?
questions.explanation: EIGRP is an advanced distance-vector protocol that incorporates link-state features like partial updates and topology tables. OSPF is purely link-state, RIP is basic distance-vector, and BGP is a path-vector protocol.

questions.text:
A network resource was accessed by an outsider as a result of a successful phishing campaign.
Which of the following strategies should be employed to mitigate the effects of phishing?
questions.explanation: Multifactor authentication limits the damage from stolen credentials obtained via phishing, since a password alone won't grant access. Single sign-on and RADIUS don't specifically address credential compromise from phishing.

questions.text:
A PC user who is on a local network reports very slow speeds when accessing files on the network server. The user's PC is connecting, but file downloads are very slow when compared to other users' download speeds. The PC's NIC should be capable of Gigabit Ethernet.
Which of the following will MOST likely fix the issue?
options: Releasing and renewing the PC's IP address
Reseating the NIC inside the PC
questions.explanation: A damaged or low-category patch cable is the most common cause of a gigabit-capable PC negotiating a slow link while still connecting; swapping the cable is the likely fix. Reseating the NIC is far less likely when the link is up and other users are fine.

questions.text:
A network administrator is configuring logging on an edge switch. The requirements are to log each time a switch port goes up or down.
Which of the following logging levels will provide this information?
questions.explanation: Notifications level logging typically captures normal but significant events like interface up/down state changes. Warnings and errors are reserved for more serious conditions.

questions.text:

Which of the following firewall rules is MOST likely causing the issue?
questions.explanation: Rule 2 denies all traffic to 224.0.0.0/4, the multicast range that includes the 239.10.10.25 group, and it is matching thousands of hits before the permit rules below it. The permit on UDP 5004 in Rule 3 shows zero hits because the deny above it is processed first.

questions.text: Which of the following would be the MOST likely attack used to bypass an access control vestibule?
questions.explanation: Tailgating involves following an authorized person through a secured entry point like a mantrap/access control vestibule. Phishing, evil twin, and brute-force attacks target credentials or wireless networks, not physical entry.

questions.text:
A company is considering shifting its business to the cloud. The management team is concerned about the availability of the third-party cloud service.
Which of the following should the management team consult to determine the promised availability of the cloud provider?
questions.explanation: A service-level agreement specifies the provider's guaranteed uptime and availability commitments. An MOU, business continuity plan, and disaster recovery plan don't define a vendor's promised availability.

questions.text:
A new company recently moved into an empty office space. Within days, users in the next office began noticing increased latency and packet drops with their Wi-Fi-connected devices.
Which of the following is the MOST likely reason for this issue?
questions.explanation: New Wi-Fi equipment operating on overlapping channels with the neighboring office's network causes interference, increasing latency and packet drops. Distance from AP or disabled WPS wouldn't explain a new company's equipment affecting neighbors.

questions.text:
A company is designing a SAN and would like to use STP as its medium for communication.
Which of the following protocols would BEST suit the company's needs?
questions.explanation: STP here means shielded twisted pair copper, and iSCSI carries SCSI storage traffic over standard Ethernet copper cabling. Fibre Channel requires fiber/FC HBAs, and SFTP/FTP are file transfer protocols, not SAN transports.

questions.text:
A technician notices that equipment is being moved around and misplaced in the server room, even though the room has locked doors and cabinets.
Which of the following would be the BEST solution to identify who is responsible?
questions.explanation: Installing cameras allows visual identification of who is moving equipment, providing accountability. Motion detection and tamper detection alert to activity but don't identify the individual responsible.

questions.text:
A computer engineer needs to ensure that only a specific workstation can connect to port 1 on a switch.
Which of the following features should the engineer configure on the switch interface?
questions.explanation: Port security restricts a switch port to a specific MAC address, ensuring only the designated workstation can connect. Port mirroring and aggregation serve monitoring and bandwidth purposes, not access restriction.

questions.text:
A cafeteria is facing lawsuits related to criminal internet access that was made over its guest network. The marketing team, however, insists on keeping the cafeteria's phone number as the wireless passphrase.
Which of the following actions would improve wireless security while accommodating the marketing team and accepting the terms of use?
options: Setting WLAN security to use EAP-TLS
Deploying a captive portal for user authentication
Using geofencing to limit the area covered by the WLAN
questions.explanation: A captive portal requires users to authenticate and accept terms of use before accessing the guest network, improving accountability while keeping the existing passphrase. EAP-TLS requires certificates unsuitable for guest use, and geofencing/isolation don't address the legal/terms requirement.

questions.text:
An administrator would like to have two servers at different geographical locations provide fault tolerance and high performance while appearing as one URL to users.
Which of the following should the administrator implement?
questions.explanation: Load balancing distributes traffic across geographically dispersed servers while presenting a single URL, providing fault tolerance and performance. NIC teaming and multipathing operate at the local server/network level, not across distinct sites.

questions.text:
An IT technician successfully connects to the corporate wireless network at a bank. While performing some tests, the technician observes that the physical address of the DHCP server has changed even though the network connection has not been lost.
Which of the following would BEST explain this change?
questions.explanation: A rogue DHCP server with a different MAC address can respond to lease renewals, causing the observed physical address change without connection loss. A server upgrade wouldn't happen unnoticed, and duplicate IP or scope exhaustion wouldn't change the DHCP server's MAC.

questions.text:
An ISP is providing internet to a retail store and has terminated its point of connection using a standard Cat 6 pin-out.
Which of the following terminations should the technician use when running a cable from the ISP's port to the front desk?
questions.explanation: Since the ISP handed off using standard Cat 6 pin-out (copper), the run to the front desk should use TIA/EIA-568-B termination standard for twisted-pair cabling. F-type, LC, and SC connectors are for coaxial or fiber, not copper Ethernet.

questions.text:
A company needs to virtualize a replica of its internal physical network without changing the logical topology and the way that devices behave and are managed.
Which of the following technologies meets this requirement?
questions.explanation: Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) virtualizes network devices and services while preserving the logical topology and management behavior. SD-WAN changes how traffic is routed rather than replicating the existing topology.

questions.text:
A network technician needs to ensure the company’s external mail server can pass reverse lookup checks.
Which of the following records would the technician MOST likely configure?
questions.explanation: A PTR record enables reverse DNS lookups, mapping an IP address back to a hostname, which is required for mail servers to pass reverse lookup checks. SPF relates to sender authorization, not reverse lookups.

Which of the following are the BEST ways for the administrator to secure this type of traffic? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The capture shows SNMP version-1 with the default community string "public" readable in clear text on UDP 161, so replacing the default with a private community string and moving to SNMPv3 (which adds authentication and encryption) secures it. SSL encryption does not apply to SNMP's UDP management traffic, and 802.1X only controls port access.

questions.text:
A network technician is troubleshooting a network issue for employees who have reported issues with speed when accessing a server in another subnet. The server is in another building that is 410ft (125m) away from the employees' building. The 10GBASE-T connection between the two buildings uses Cat 5e.
Which of the following BEST explains the speed issue?
options: The connection type is not rated for that distance.
A broadcast storm is occurring on the subnet.
The cable run has interference on it.
The connection should be made using a Cat 6 cable.
questions.explanation: 10GBASE-T over Cat 5e is only rated for up to about 37-55 meters depending on conditions, far short of 125m, causing degraded speeds. The issue is distance limitation, not cable interference or broadcast storms.

questions.text: Which of the following is a security flaw in an application or network?
questions.explanation: A vulnerability is a weakness or flaw in a system or application that could be exploited. A threat is a potential danger, an exploit is the method used to take advantage of a vulnerability, and risk is the potential impact.

questions.text:
An administrator is investigating reports of network slowness in a building. While looking at the uplink interface statistics in the switch's CLI, the administrator discovers the uplink is at 100% utilization. However, the administrator is unsure how to identify what traffic is causing the saturation.
Which of the following tools should the administrator utilize to identify the source and destination addresses of the traffic?
questions.explanation: NetFlow provides detailed traffic flow data including source and destination addresses, allowing identification of what is saturating the link. SNMP and syslog provide device status and events but not per-flow traffic detail.

questions.text:
Two new network switches located in different buildings are connected together with single-mode fiber. However, no link exists between the two switches.
Which of the following steps should the technician perform FIRST to troubleshoot the issue?
options: Reverse TX/RX on the fiber patch cord at one building.
Replace the fiber patch cords in both buildings.
Clean the fiber patch cord connectors in both buildings.
Connect the fiber patch cord to an OTDR at one building.
questions.explanation: With single-mode fiber links, a common cause of no link is transmit/receive fibers being crossed incorrectly; reversing TX/RX at one end is a quick first troubleshooting step before replacing cables or using an OTDR.

questions.text: Which of the following OSI model layers would allow a user to access and download files from a remote computer?
questions.explanation: The Application layer provides network services directly to end-user applications, such as file transfer protocols used to access and download files. Session and Presentation layers support but don't directly provide this user-facing function.

questions.text:
A new office space is being designed. The network switches are up, but no services are running yet. A network engineer plugs in a laptop configured as a DHCP client to a switch.
Which of the following IP addresses should be assigned to the laptop?
questions.explanation: With no DHCP server running yet, the client will self-assign an APIPA address in the 169.254.0.0/16 range. The other addresses are private ranges requiring a DHCP server or static configuration.

questions.text:
An organization requires the ability to send encrypted email messages to a partner from an email server that is hosted on premises. The organization prefers to use the standard default ports when creating firewall rules.
Which of the following ports should be open to satisfy the requirements?
questions.explanation: Port 587 is the standard default port for secure SMTP submission (SMTPS/STARTTLS) used to send encrypted email. Ports 110 and 143 are for receiving mail (POP3/IMAP), and 636 is for secure LDAP.

questions.text: Which of the following BEST describes a split-tunnel client-to-server VPN connection?
options: The client sends all network traffic down the VPN tunnel.
The client has two different IP addresses that can be connected to a remote site from two different ISPs to ensure availability.
The client sends some network traffic down the VPN tunnel and other traffic to the local gateway.
The client connects to multiple remote sites at the same time.
questions.explanation: A split-tunnel VPN sends only traffic destined for the corporate network through the tunnel while other traffic goes directly to the local gateway/internet. Sending all traffic through the tunnel describes a full-tunnel VPN.

questions.text: Which of the following is the MOST secure connection used to inspect and provide controlled internet access when remote employees are connected to the corporate network?
questions.explanation: A full-tunnel VPN routes all remote employee traffic through the corporate network, allowing full inspection and controlled internet access. A split-tunnel VPN lets some traffic bypass inspection, making it less secure.

questions.text:
An engineer is troubleshooting poor performance on the network that occurs during work hours.
Which of the following should the engineer do to improve performance?
options: Create separation rules on the firewall.
Create subinterfaces on the existing port.
questions.explanation: Link aggregation combines multiple physical links to increase available bandwidth, addressing performance issues during peak work hours. Replacing patch cables or creating subinterfaces would not resolve bandwidth congestion.

questions.text:
A customer reports there is no access to resources following the replacement of switches. A technician goes to the site to examine the configuration and discovers redundant links between two switches.
Which of the following is the reason the network is not functional?
options: The ARP cache has become corrupt.
questions.explanation: Without Spanning Tree Protocol configured, redundant links between switches create a Layer 2 loop, causing broadcast storms and network failure. This is unrelated to ARP corruption or CSMA/CD, which handles collision detection.

questions.text:
Users are reporting poor wireless performance in some areas of an industrial plant. The wireless controller is measuring a low EIRP value compared to the recommendations noted on the most recent site survey.
Which of the following should be verified or replaced for the EIRP value to meet the site survey's specifications? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: EIRP is calculated from AP transmit power plus antenna gain, so verifying or replacing these components addresses a low EIRP measurement. Channel utilization and ARP tables don't affect EIRP calculations directly.

questions.text:
A coffee shop owner hired a network consultant to provide recommendations for installing a new wireless network. The coffee shop customers expect high speeds even when the network is congested.
Which of the following standards should the consultant recommend?
questions.explanation: 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) uses OFDMA and other technologies designed to maintain high speeds and efficiency even in congested, high-density environments like a coffee shop. 802.11ac lacks these congestion-handling improvements.

questions.text:
A network technician is hired to review all the devices within a network and make recommendations to improve network efficiency.
Which of the following should the technician do FIRST before reviewing and making any recommendations?
questions.explanation: Capturing a network baseline first establishes normal performance metrics, providing a reference point before making recommendations. Reading logs or running bandwidth tests without a baseline lacks context for comparison.

questions.text:
A company has multiple offices around the world. The computer rooms in some office locations are too warm. Dedicated sensors are in each room, but the process of checking each sensor takes a long time.
Which of the following options can the company put in place to automate temperature readings with internal resources?
options: Hire a programmer to write a script to perform the checks.
Utilize ping to measure the response.
Use SNMP with an existing collector server.
questions.explanation: Using SNMP with an existing collector server allows automated polling of temperature sensors using internal resources without new development. Hiring a programmer requires external effort, and ping/NetFlow don't monitor environmental sensors.

questions.text: Which of the following architectures reduces network latency by enforcing a limit on the number of switching devices on the frame's path between any internal hosts?
questions.explanation: A spine-and-leaf architecture ensures any two hosts are always separated by the same limited number of hops (through one spine switch), reducing and standardizing latency. Three-tiered designs allow more variable, longer paths.

questions.text:
A network administrator is decommissioning a server.
Which of the following will the network administrator MOST likely consult?
questions.explanation: Decommissioning a server alters the production environment, so it must follow the change management process, including approval, documentation, and rollback planning. Onboarding and offboarding policies address employee or user account lifecycle events, not the retirement of hardware or services.

questions.text:
A technician is investigating an issue with connectivity at customer's location. The technician confirms that users can access resources locally but not over the internet. The technician theorizes that the local router has failed and investigates further. The technician’s testing results show that the router is functional; however, users still are unable to reach resources on the internet.
Which of the following describes what the technician should do NEXT?
questions.explanation: When testing disproves the theory, CompTIA's methodology says to establish a new theory or escalate; since re-theorizing is not offered, escalation is the correct next step. Identifying symptoms was already completed at the start of the process.

questions.text:
On a network with redundant switches, a network administrator replaced one of the switches but was unable to get a connection with another switch.
Which of the following should the administrator check after successfully testing the cable that was wired for TIA/EIA-568A on both ends?
options: If MDIX is enabled on the new switch
If a plenum cable is being used
If STP is disabled on the switches
questions.explanation: Auto-MDIX allows a switch port to automatically detect and adjust for straight-through vs crossover wiring; if disabled on the new switch, a direct switch-to-switch link may fail. STP would block traffic but still show link connectivity, so it's less likely the cause of no connection at all.

questions.text:
The lack of a formal process to grant network permissions to different profiles of employees and contractors is leading to an increasing number of security incidents. Non-uniform and overly permissive network accesses are being granted.
Which of the following would be the MOST appropriate method to improve the security of the environment?
options: Change the default permissions to implicit deny.
Configure uniform ACLs to employees and NAC for contractors.
Deploy an RDP server to centralize the access to the network.
questions.explanation: Role-based access control assigns permissions based on job function, ensuring consistent, appropriately scoped access for employees and contractors. Configuring uniform ACLs and NAC separately doesn't address the root cause of inconsistent permission assignment tied to roles.

questions.text: Which of the following types of planes propagates routing information in an SDWAN solution?
questions.explanation: The control plane is responsible for propagating routing information and making forwarding decisions in an SD-WAN architecture. The data plane merely forwards traffic based on those decisions, not propagate routes.

questions.text:
A technician is running new Cat 5e cables to a server room.
Which of the following tools should the technician use to terminate the cables at the patch panel?
questions.explanation: A punchdown tool is used to terminate twisted-pair cables into a patch panel's IDC connectors. A cable crimper is used for terminating cables with RJ45 connectors on patch cords, not patch panels.

questions.text:
A disaster recovery team needs a solution that would best meet the following requirements:

• The server infrastructure has been pre-installed
• The fail-over location offers basic life support.
• The fail-over location provides basic network connectivity.
• Minimizing cost is preferred over quicker business recovery times
• The expected time for services to be fully operational is days.

Which of the following sites would meet the requirements?
questions.explanation: A warm site has pre-installed server infrastructure and basic connectivity/utilities but requires additional setup, taking days rather than hours to become fully operational, balancing cost and recovery time. A cold site has no pre-installed infrastructure, and a hot site would be operational much faster.

questions.text:
A technician troubleshoots a computer that has intermittent network connectivity and notices the termination point is loose. The technician also observes that the patch cable has already been replaced.
Which of the following should the technician do NEXT?
options: Use a tone generator to trace the cable
Use a multimeter to determine if PoE is available on the switchport
Use a cable crimper to replace the RJ45 connector on the patch cable
Use a punchdown tool to reseat the copper in the wall jack
questions.explanation: Since the patch cable was already replaced and the termination point (wall jack) is loose, the technician should use a punchdown tool to reseat the copper connection at the jack. A tone generator is used for tracing cables, not fixing loose terminations.

questions.text:
A company wants to invest in new hardware for the core network infrastructure. The management team requires that the infrastructure be capable of being repaired in less than 60 minutes if any major part fails.
Which of the following metrics is MOST likely associated with this requirement?
questions.explanation: Mean Time To Repair (MTTR) measures how quickly a failed component can be repaired, directly matching the 60-minute repair requirement. MTBF measures the average time between failures, not repair speed.

questions.text: Which of the following devices and encapsulations are found at the data link layer? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Frames are the Layer 2 PDU encapsulation, and switches are the primary Layer 2 devices that forward traffic based on MAC addresses. Packets are Layer 3 PDUs, and firewalls typically operate above Layer 2.

questions.text:
After rebooting an AP, a user is no longer able to connect to the enterprise LAN. A technician plugs a laptop in to the same network jack and receives the IP 169.254.0.200.
Which of the following is MOST likely causing the issue?
questions.explanation: An IP address in the 169.254.x.x range indicates APIPA, meaning the device failed to receive a DHCP lease, likely due to DHCP scope exhaustion after the AP reboot caused new lease requests. Signal attenuation or channel overlap would not prevent IP assignment entirely.

questions.text:
A network administrator is concerned about a rainbow table being used to help access network resources.
Which of the following must be addressed to reduce the likelihood of a rainbow table being effective?
questions.explanation: Rainbow tables are used to crack weak or short hashed passwords, so enforcing a strong password policy reduces their effectiveness. Remote access or acceptable use policies don't directly address password strength or hashing complexity.

questions.text: Which of the following describes the ability of a corporate IT department to expand its cloud-hosted VM environment with minimal effort?
questions.explanation: Scalability describes the ability to expand a cloud environment's resources easily as demand grows. Multitenancy refers to multiple customers sharing the same infrastructure, not the ability to expand resources.

questions.text:
A user from a remote office is reporting slow file transfers.
Which of the following tools will an engineer MOST likely use to get detailed measurement data?
questions.explanation: iPerf is a tool specifically designed to measure detailed network throughput and performance metrics like bandwidth, jitter, and packet loss between two points. A basic internet speed test doesn't provide the granular data needed for troubleshooting file transfer issues.

questions.text: Which of the following can be used to decrease latency during periods of high utilization of a firewall?
questions.explanation: An HA (high-availability) pair allows load to be distributed across multiple firewalls, reducing latency during high utilization periods. A hot site is for disaster recovery, not performance improvement during normal high-load operation.

questions.text:
A customer calls the help desk to report that a Windows PC is unable to open any websites or access any server shares. The help desk technician suspects there is an issue with the configuration.
Which of the following commands should the technician issue FIRST to troubleshoot the issue?
questions.explanation: Running ipconfig first checks the PC's IP configuration (address, subnet, gateway, DNS) to rule out basic misconfiguration before deeper network troubleshooting. Tracert or netstat are used later for path or connection troubleshooting, not initial configuration checks.

questions.text:
A network technician needs to select an AP that will support at least 1.3Gbps and 5GHz only.
Which of the following wireless standards must the AP support to meet the requirements?
questions.explanation: 802.11ac operates only in the 5GHz band and supports data rates exceeding 1.3Gbps, matching both requirements. 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) can also meet these speeds but typically supports both 2.4GHz and 5GHz, not 5GHz only, making 802.11ac the standard requirement fit.

questions.text: Which of the following devices would be used to extend the range of a wireless network?
questions.explanation: A wireless repeater receives and rebroadcasts a wireless signal to extend network range. A router or switch does not specifically function to extend wireless coverage.

questions.text: Which of the following redundant devices creates broadcast storms when connected together on a high-availability network?
questions.explanation: Redundant switches connected without proper loop prevention (like STP) create broadcast storms due to Layer 2 loops. Routers operate at Layer 3 and don't forward broadcasts in the same loop-prone manner.

questions.text:
A technician is investigating a misconfiguration on a Layer 3 switch. When the technician logs in and runs a command, the following data is shown:
Which of the following commands generated this output?
questions.explanation: The output lists destination networks with source codes (C, S, O), administrative distance/metric values such as [110/20], next-hop addresses, and a gateway of last resort "- that is a routing table produced by show route. show interface would instead display link state, duplex, speed, and packet counters.
