questions.text:
A user stores large graphic files. The time required to transfer the files to the server is excessive due to network congestion. The user's budget does not allow for the current switches to be replaced.
Which of the following can be used to provide FASTER transfer times?
questions.explanation: Jumbo frames increase the payload size per frame, reducing overhead and improving throughput for large file transfers without requiring new switches (as long as switches support them). Half duplex would decrease, not increase, performance.

questions.text:
A sales team at a company uses a SaaS solution primarily for videoconferencing and a CRM application that connects to a database server in the corporate data center.
Which of the following VPN solutions would allow secure, remote access for sales staff to the CRM application without impacting videoconferencing traffic?
questions.explanation: A split tunnel VPN routes only the CRM application traffic through the secure tunnel while allowing videoconferencing (SaaS) traffic to go directly to the internet, preserving performance. A full tunnel would route all traffic through the VPN, impacting videoconferencing.

questions.text: Which of the following would a network administrator configure to set NTP settings for a specific subnet within DHCP?
questions.explanation: Scope options in DHCP allow administrators to configure settings like NTP servers for a specific subnet's DHCP scope. Reservations assign fixed IPs to specific devices, not subnet-wide settings.

questions.text:
A network administrator creates a new network, 10.10.0.0/24, on a DHCP server. The administrator wants to ensure that 10.10.0.10-10.10.0.15 are not allocated to other devices.
Which of the following features should the administrator configure?
questions.explanation: An exclusion range prevents a specified range of addresses within a DHCP scope from being handed out to clients. A reservation assigns a specific address to one device rather than blocking a range.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols uses Dijkstra's algorithm to calculate the LOWEST cost between routers?
questions.explanation: OSPF uses Dijkstra's Shortest Path First algorithm to calculate the lowest-cost path between routers. RIP uses hop count with the Bellman-Ford algorithm instead.

questions.text:
An on-call network technician receives an automated email alert stating that a power supply on a firewall has just powered down.
Which of the following protocols would BEST allow for this level of detailed device monitoring?
questions.explanation: SNMP allows detailed monitoring of device hardware components, such as power supply status, through traps and MIB polling. TFTP is used for file transfers, not monitoring.

questions.text:
A technician is investigating a SAN switch that has a high number of CRC errors.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the errors?
questions.explanation: CRC errors on fiber SAN links are commonly caused by physical layer issues like a break, bend, or dirty connector in the fiber cable. Mismatched duplex settings typically cause errors on copper Ethernet, not fiber SAN connections.

questions.text:
A customer runs a DNS lookup service and needs a network technician to reconfigure the network to improve performance. The customer wants to ensure that servers are accessed based on whichever one is topographically closest to the destination. If the server does not respond, then the next topographically closest server should respond.
Which of the following does the technician need to configure to meet the requirements?
questions.explanation: Anycast allows multiple servers to share the same IP address, with routing directing traffic to the topographically nearest one, and failing over to the next closest if unavailable. Unicast only addresses a single specific destination.

questions.text: Which of the following would MOST likely be used to review disaster recovery information for a system?
questions.explanation: A business continuity plan documents disaster recovery procedures and processes to keep operations running during and after an incident. Standard operating procedures cover routine tasks, not disaster recovery.

questions.text:
A network technician is troubleshooting a connection to a web server. The technician is unable to ping the server but is able to verify connectivity to the web service using Telnet.
Which of the following protocols is being blocked by the firewall?
questions.explanation: Ping relies on ICMP, so an inability to ping while Telnet (TCP) still works to the web service indicates ICMP is being blocked by the firewall.

questions.text:
A network administrator is configuring a firewall to allow for a new cloud-based email server. The company standard is to use SMTP to route email traffic.
Which of the following ports, by default, should be reserved for this purpose?
questions.explanation: SMTP uses port 25 by default for routing email traffic. Port 110 is for POP3, port 53 for DNS, and port 23 for Telnet.

questions.text: Which of the following demarcation connections would be MOST appropriate to use with a cable modem being installed in a SOHO situation?
questions.explanation: Cable modems connect to the ISP demarcation point via coaxial cable, which uses RG6 connectors. RJ11 is for telephone/DSL lines, not cable.

questions.text:
A technician needs to allow a device to maintain the same IP address lease based on the physical address of a network card.
Which of the following should the technician use?
questions.explanation: MAC address reservation ties a specific IP lease in DHCP to a device's physical (MAC) address, ensuring it always receives the same IP. A static IP address would be configured manually on the device rather than through DHCP based on MAC.

questions.text:
A network technician is investigating why a core switch is logging excessive amounts of data to the syslog server. The running configuration of the switch showed the following logging information:
Which of the following changes should the technician make to BEST fix the issue?
questions.explanation: "logging trap debugging" is severity level 7, so every message from emergencies down to debugging is forwarded, which explains the 1,842,156 lines sent. Raising the trap to warnings or errors fixes the volume. Updating the logging host IP is wrong because 10.20.30.40 is up and receiving all of the messages.
questions.exhibit:
core-sw01#show running-config | include logging
logging buffered 32768 debugging
logging console debugging
logging monitor debugging
logging trap debugging
logging facility local7
logging source-interface Vlan10
logging host 10.20.30.40

core-sw01#show logging | include Trap|Syslog
    Trap logging: level debugging (7), 1842156 message lines logged
    Logging to 10.20.30.40 (udp port 514, audit disabled,
      link up), 1842156 message lines logged, 0 message lines dropped

questions.text:
A network technician wants to find the shortest path from one node to every other node in the network.
Which of the following algorithms will provide the FASTEST convergence time?
questions.explanation: Link-state algorithms (like OSPF) converge faster than distance-vector protocols because routers have full topology knowledge and calculate shortest paths independently using Dijkstra's algorithm.

questions.text:
After upgrading to a SOHO router that supports Wi-Fi 6, the user determines throughput has not increased.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the issue?
options: The wireless router is using an incorrect antenna type.
The user's workstation does not support 802.11ax.
questions.explanation: If the user's workstation network adapter does not support 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6), it cannot take advantage of the new router's higher throughput capabilities regardless of router upgrades.

questions.text:
A network administrator is troubleshooting a connection to a remote site. The administrator runs a command and sees the following output:
Which of the following is the cause of the connection issue?
questions.explanation: The trace bounces between 172.16.1.1 and 172.16.2.1 over and over until the 30-hop TTL limit is reached and never gets closer to 203.0.113.25, which is the signature of a routing loop. Asymmetrical routing would still deliver the packets to the destination rather than repeating the same two hops.

questions.text:
While using a secure conference call connection over a corporate VPN, a user moves from a cellular connection to a hotel wireless network. Although the wireless connection and the VPN show a connected status, no network connectivity is present.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of this issue?
options: MAC filtering is configured on the wireless connection.
The VPN and the WLAN connection have an encryption protocol mismatch.
The WLAN is using a captive portal that requires further authentication.
Wireless client isolation is enforced on the WLAN settings.
questions.explanation: A captive portal on the hotel Wi-Fi typically requires additional web-based authentication before allowing full internet access, blocking VPN traffic even though Wi-Fi shows connected. This is a classic hotel/guest network issue.

questions.text:
An engineer was asked to update an MX record for an upcoming project.
Which of the following server types is MOST likely to be in scope for the project?
questions.explanation: MX (Mail Exchanger) records specify the mail servers responsible for receiving email for a domain, making an email server the relevant system for this project.

questions.text:
A customer has an attached USB printer that needs to be shared with other users. The desktop team set up printer sharing. Now, the network technician needs to obtain the necessary information about the PC and share it with other users so they can connect to the printer.
Which of the following commands should the technician use to get the required information? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: ipconfig provides the PC's IP address and hostname reveals the computer's network name, both needed for other users to locate and connect to the shared printer. netstat and route do not provide this identifying information.

questions.text:
A help desk supervisor reviews the following excerpt of a call transcript:
Which of the following was the agent trying to accomplish with this exchange?
options: The agent was questioning the obvious.
The agent was verifying full system functionality.
The agent was identifying potential effects.
The agent was trying to duplicate the problem.
questions.explanation: The agent asks the user to repeat the exact steps, performs them on another workstation, and then repeats them again to confirm consistency, which is duplicating the problem if possible. Verifying full system functionality happens only after a fix is applied, and nothing has been changed or repaired yet.
questions.exhibit:
Call transcript excerpt - Ticket 44819

Agent: Before I change anything, I would like to see the error myself.
Agent: Please close the application, open it again, and sign in exactly
       the way you did this morning while I stay on the line.
User:  OK... I clicked the icon, typed my password, and there it is
       again - "server not found."
Agent: Thank you. I am performing those same steps on my workstation
       now... I get the same message.
Agent: Let's run through it one more time so I can confirm it happens
       every single time and not just once.
User:  Same result on the second try.

questions.text:
A technician received a report that some users in a large, 30-floor building are having intermittent connectivity issues. Users on each floor have stable connectivity, but do not have connectivity to other floors.
Which of the following devices is MOST likely causing the issue?
questions.explanation: Since each floor has stable local connectivity but floors cannot reach each other, the core switch that interconnects the floor (access) switches is the most likely point of failure. An access switch failure would only affect its own floor.

questions.text:
A help desk technician discovers the following note while reviewing tickets in a customer's account:

• Was able to confirm customer's problem with the system.
• Will upgrade system to latest version and monitor for further connectivity problems per developer's instructions.

Which of the following describes what the technician was documenting with this note?
options: The technician was approaching multiple problems individually.
The technician was establishing a plan of action and identifying potential effects.
The technician was testing a theory to determine the cause.
The technician was identifying the problem by gathering information.
questions.explanation: Confirming the problem and upgrading the system while monitoring for further issues reflects establishing a plan of action and identifying potential effects of the fix, per the troubleshooting methodology.

questions.text:
The results of a recently completed site survey indicate a significant, undesired RSSI in the parking lot and other exterior areas near the main building. The wireless technician would like to mitigate access to the wireless network in exterior access areas. The current access point settings are listed in the following table:
Which of the following is the BEST step for the technician to take to resolve the issue?
options: Reconfigure AP2 and AP3 for non-overlapping channels.
Implement directional antennas on AP1 and AP2.
Raise the power settings on AP2 and AP3.
Change the SSID on AP1 and AP2.
questions.explanation: AP1 and AP2 sit on exterior walls with omnidirectional antennas at full power, which is why strong signal reaches the parking lot and loading dock; directional antennas aim that energy back inside. Reconfiguring AP2 and AP3 for non-overlapping channels does nothing, as 1, 6, and 11 already do not overlap and channels do not change coverage area.
questions.exhibit:
AP    Location                Antenna          Channel  Power   Band
----  ----------------------  ---------------  -------  ------  ------
AP1   North exterior wall     Omnidirectional  1        100mW   2.4GHz
AP2   South exterior wall     Omnidirectional  6        100mW   2.4GHz
AP3   Interior core hallway   Omnidirectional  11       50mW    2.4GHz

Site survey results (exterior):
  North parking lot, 150ft from building: -62dBm (SSID CORP, AP1)
  South loading dock, 120ft from building: -65dBm (SSID CORP, AP2)
  Interior coverage from all three APs: -55dBm or better

questions.text:
A network technician is selecting new network hardware, and availability is the main concern.
Which of the following availability concepts should the technician consider?
questions.explanation: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) measures the expected reliability and availability of hardware, making it the key metric when selecting equipment based on availability. RTO and RPO relate to disaster recovery objectives, not hardware selection.

questions.text:
A new company moved into a corporate center. Users in the shared lobby are experiencing disconnects on their mobile devices.
Which of the following is the BEST tool a network technician could use to troubleshoot the issue?
questions.explanation: A Wi-Fi analyzer helps identify channel overlap, interference, and signal strength issues causing mobile device disconnects in a shared area with potentially multiple overlapping wireless networks. A protocol analyzer examines packet-level data, not RF conditions.

questions.text:
Two companies want to build an encrypted tunnel between them and use a PSK for initial authentication.
Which of the following is the BEST protocol for the companies to use?
questions.explanation: IPSec supports building encrypted tunnels between sites and can use a pre-shared key (PSK) for initial authentication during IKE negotiation. VPN is a general concept, not a specific protocol, while SSL/TLS are typically used for individual sessions, not site-to-site tunnels.

questions.text:
While troubleshooting a network, a VoIP systems engineer discovers a significant inconsistency in the amount of time required for data to reach its destination and return.
Which of the following terms BEST describes this issue?
questions.explanation: Jitter is the variation in packet delay/latency over time, which is the exact issue described. Latency refers to a consistent delay amount, not inconsistency between packets.

questions.text:
A network technician is configuring a wireless access point and wants to only allow company-owned devices to associate with the network. The access point uses PSKs, and a network authentication system does not exist on the network.
Which of the following should the technician implement?
questions.explanation: MAC filtering allows only devices with approved MAC addresses (company-owned devices) to associate, working with PSK authentication without requiring a network authentication server. A captive portal only redirects browser traffic and doesn't restrict association.

questions.text: Which of the following network topologies BEST describes a central device connected to multiple independent devices?
questions.explanation: Hub-and-spoke describes a central device connected individually to multiple independent devices, with no direct connections between the spokes. Mesh implies interconnections among all devices, which is not the case here.

questions.text:
A network administrator is reviewing north-south traffic to determine whether a security threat exists.
Which of the following explains the type of traffic the administrator is reviewing?
options: Data flowing between the perimeter network and application servers
Data flowing in and out of the data center
Data flowing between local on-site support and backup servers
questions.explanation: North-south traffic refers to data flowing in and out of the data center (client-to-server across the perimeter), while east-west traffic flows between servers inside the data center. Traffic between application servers would be east-west, not north-south.

questions.text:
A network technician is installing a wireless network in an office building. After performing a site survey, the technician determines the area is very saturated on the 2.4GHz and the 5GHz bands.
Which of the following wireless standards should the network technician implement?
questions.explanation: 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) includes OFDMA and better channel utilization, improving performance in saturated environments on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands. Older standards like 802.11ac and 802.11n lack these efficiency improvements for congested spectrum.

questions.text:
A network technician discovered multiple failed logins on a production server. Upon investigation, the technician determined that a client plugged a personal laptop in to the corporate LAN, which allowed malware on the laptop to probe the network.
Which of the following would have prevented this unauthorized device?
questions.explanation: Port security restricts which devices can connect to a switch port based on MAC address, preventing unauthorized personal laptops from joining the LAN. A BYOD policy is administrative guidance, not a technical control that would have blocked the connection.

questions.text:
Following a fire in a data center, an executive is concerned about the amount of data that must be reentered.
Which of the following describes the executive's concern?
questions.explanation: RPO (Recovery Point Objective) defines the maximum acceptable amount of data loss measured in time, directly addressing concern over data that must be reentered. RTO instead measures how long recovery takes, not data loss amount.

questions.text:
A customer needs to distribute Ethernet to multiple computers in an office. The customer would like to use non-proprietary standards.
Which of the following blocks does the technician need to install?
questions.explanation: 110 blocks are an open, non-proprietary punch-down standard widely used for Ethernet cabling distribution. 66 blocks are older and used mainly for telephone wiring, while Bix and Krone are proprietary/regional standards.

questions.text:
A network engineer turned on logging to assist with troubleshooting a suspected configuration issue.
Which of the following would provide the network engineer with the most informative log information?
questions.explanation: DEBUG logging level provides the most detailed and informative output, useful for troubleshooting configuration issues. ERROR and WARN levels only capture problems, not the granular detail needed for diagnosis.

questions.text: Which of the following cloud deployment models involves servers that are hosted at a company’s property and are only used by that company?
questions.explanation: A private cloud is hosted on-premises (or dedicated) and used exclusively by one organization. Public cloud is shared multi-tenant infrastructure, which does not fit the description.

questions.text:
A technician needs to find the MAC address of a connecting router.
Which of the following commands should the technician use?
questions.explanation: The arp command displays the ARP cache, which maps IP addresses to MAC addresses for locally connected devices like a router. Traceroute, nslookup, and ping do not reveal MAC addresses.

questions.text: A network engineer is installing hardware in a newly renovated data center. Major concerns that were addressed during the renovation included air circulation, building power redundancy, and the need for continuous monitoring. The network engineer is creating alerts based on the following operation specifications:
options: Environmental monitoring alerts for humidity greater than 95%
SIEM to parse syslog events for a failed power supply
SNMP traps to report when the chassis temperature exceeds 95°F (35°C)
UPS monitoring to report when input voltage drops below 220VAC
questions.explanation: The chassis has 1+1 redundant supplies that report faults as severity 2 syslog messages to the SIEM, so parsing syslog is the only listed alert that matches the hardware's capabilities and the power-redundancy concern. An SNMP trap at 95F fails twice: SNMP is disabled and 95F is still inside the 41F-113F operating range.
questions.exhibit:
Operating specifications - Core chassis CS-4800

Operating temperature . . . : 41F to 113F (5C to 45C)
Operating humidity. . . . . : 20% to 80%, non-condensing
Input voltage . . . . . . . : 100-127VAC (rack circuits supply 120VAC)
Power supplies. . . . . . . : 2 x 1100W, 1+1 redundant, hot-swappable
PSU fault reporting . . . . : syslog facility local0, severity 2
Thermal/humidity sensors. . : syslog facility local0, severity 4
Management. . . . . . . . . : SSH and syslog enabled; SNMP disabled
Syslog collector. . . . . . : SIEM at 10.50.4.20, UDP 514

questions.text:
A technician needs to set up a wireless connection that utilizes MIMO on non-overlapping channels.
Which of the following would be the best choice?
questions.explanation: 802.11n introduced MIMO technology and can operate on the 5GHz band with non-overlapping channels. Earlier standards like 802.11a, b, and g do not support MIMO.

questions.text:
Users have reported an issue connecting to a server over the network. A workstation was recently added to the network and configured with a shared USB printer.
Which of the following is most likely causing the issue?
options: The switch is oversubscribed and cannot handle the additional throughput.
The printer is tying up the server with DHCP discover messages.
The web server's back end was designed for only single-threaded applications.
The workstation was configured with a static IP that is the same as the server.
questions.explanation: A duplicate static IP address matching the server's would cause IP conflicts and connectivity issues, which commonly arise right after adding a new workstation. Switch oversubscription or printer DHCP requests are less likely to specifically disrupt server connectivity in this scenario.

questions.text: Which of the following routing protocols uses an autonomous system number?
questions.explanation: BGP uses autonomous system numbers to identify and route between distinct networks on the internet. EIGRP, OSPF, and IS-IS are interior gateway protocols that do not use AS numbers in this way.

questions.text:
A network administrator is designing a new network for a company that has frequent power spikes. The company wants to ensure that employees can keep working and the server will remain operational.
Which of the following is the best solution for the administrator to recommend?
questions.explanation: A UPS provides immediate battery backup during power spikes/outages, allowing employees to keep working and the server to stay operational without interruption. A generator takes time to start and doesn't provide the instantaneous protection a UPS does.

questions.text: Which of the following OSI model layers are responsible for handling packets from the sources to the destination and checking for errors? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The Data Link layer handles error checking (via CRC) on frames between directly connected nodes, while the Network layer handles routing packets from source to destination. Physical layer only deals with raw bit transmission, not packet handling or error checking.

questions.text: Which of the following fiber connector types is the most likely to be used on a network interface card?
questions.explanation: LC connectors have a small form factor that is commonly used on network interface cards due to their compact design allowing higher port density. SC connectors are larger and less common on modern NICs.

questions.text: Which of the following is the most cost-effective way for a network administrator to establish a persistent, secure connection between two facilities?
questions.explanation: A site-to-site VPN uses existing internet connectivity to establish a persistent, secure, encrypted tunnel between locations at low cost. A dedicated line provides guaranteed bandwidth but is far more expensive to lease and maintain.

questions.text: Which of the following would most likely be considered for an IDF installation in a secure facility?
questions.explanation: RFID badge readers are a common, cost-appropriate access control method for an IDF (Intermediate Distribution Frame), a smaller secured space compared to a data center. Full-size body scanners and iris scanners are typically reserved for higher-security areas like data centers.

questions.text: Which of the following is the most secure way to provide site-to-site connectivity?
questions.explanation: IPSec provides authentication and encryption for site-to-site connectivity, making it the most secure choice. GRE and VXLAN are tunneling protocols without built-in encryption, while IKE is only the key exchange protocol used within IPSec, not a standalone connectivity solution.

questions.text: Which of the following security methods uses physical characteristics of a person to authorize access to a location?
questions.explanation: A palm scanner uses biometrics, a physical characteristic of a person, for authentication. PIN pads and card readers rely on something you know or have, not physical traits.

questions.text: Which of the following are environmental factors that should be considered when installing equipment in a building? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Fire suppression and humidity control are environmental factors affecting equipment safety and operation. Power load and UPS location relate to electrical/power planning, not environmental conditions.

questions.text:
A network administrator requires redundant routers on the network, but only one default gateway is configurable on a workstation.
Which of the following will allow for redundant routers with a single IP address?
questions.explanation: VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) provides a virtual IP shared by redundant routers, allowing a single default gateway. EIGRP and STP address routing and loop prevention, not gateway redundancy.

questions.text: Which of the following antenna types would most likely be used in a network repeater that is housed in a central point in a home office?
questions.explanation: An omnidirectional antenna radiates signal in all directions, ideal for a centrally located repeater serving a home office. Directional types like parabolic or patch focus signal in one direction.

questions.text:
A network administrator received reports that a 40Gb connection is saturated. The only server the administrator can use for data collection in that location has a 10GB connection to the network.
Which of the following is the best method to use on the server to determine the source of the saturation?
questions.explanation: Flow data (e.g., NetFlow) can summarize traffic patterns across the 40Gb link without requiring the collecting server to handle full 40Gb throughput. Packet capture and port mirroring would require matching link speed capacity, which the 10GB server can't handle.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to implement routing capabilities in a hypervisor.
Which of the following should the administrator most likely implement?
questions.explanation: Network Functions Virtualization (NFV) allows implementing routing (and other network functions) as software within a hypervisor. IaaS and VPC are cloud service/networking models, not the mechanism for virtualized routing itself.

questions.text:
A network technician crimped a length of UTP with TIA\EIA-568A on one end and TIA\EIA-568B on the other.
Which of the following cable types did the technician create?
questions.explanation: Using 568A on one end and 568B on the other creates a crossover cable, used to connect like devices directly. A patch cable uses the same standard on both ends.

questions.text:
A network engineer designed and implemented a new office space with the following characteristics:
One month after the office space was implemented, users began reporting dropped signals when entering another room and overall poor connections to the 5GHz network.
Which of the following should the engineer do to best resolve the issue?
questions.explanation: At 80MHz width, channels 36, 40, 44, and 48 are all inside the same bonded 36-48 block, so all four APs transmit on overlapping frequencies, causing co-channel interference and failed roams between rooms. Moving to non-overlapping 5GHz channels such as 36, 52, 100, and 149 fixes it. Directional antennas would shrink coverage and worsen the dead spots.
questions.exhibit:

Access points . . . . : 4 x 802.11ax dual-band, ceiling mounted
Antennas. . . . . . . : Internal omnidirectional
Security. . . . . . . : WPA2-Enterprise (802.1X)
5GHz channel width. . : 80MHz
5GHz primary channels : AP1=36  AP2=40  AP3=44  AP4=48
2.4GHz channels . . . : AP1=1   AP2=6   AP3=11  AP4=1
Transmit power. . . . : 5GHz 17dBm, 2.4GHz 14dBm
Roaming . . . . . . . : 802.11r enabled, single SSID on both bands

questions.text: Which of the following security concepts is related to ensuring that encrypted data is not edited while in transit?
questions.explanation: Integrity ensures data is not altered in transit. Confidentiality protects data from unauthorized viewing, and availability ensures access, neither of which addresses tampering.

questions.text:
A network technician is troubleshooting internet connectivity issues with users in a subnet. From a host, the technician runs tcpdump and then attempts to navigate to a website using a web browser. The technician receives the following output:
Afterward, the browser displays an error.
Which of the following explains this issue?
options: A routing loop is within the network.
The host is configured with incorrect DNS settings.
A broadcast storm is occurring on the subnet.
The host is missing a route to the website.
questions.explanation: Every name query goes to 172.16.99.53 and the gateway answers "host unreachable," so the configured resolver is invalid and no name is ever resolved. The host is not missing a route to the website: it successfully pings and completes a TCP handshake with 203.0.113.50 by IP address.

questions.text:
After running a Cat 8 cable using passthrough plugs, an electrician notices that connected cables are experiencing a lot of cross talk.
Which of the following troubleshooting steps should the electrician take first?
options: Inspect the connectors for any wires that are touching or exposed.
Restore default settings on the connected devices.
Check for radio frequency interference in the area.
questions.explanation: Crosstalk from passthrough plugs is often caused by untwisted or touching wire pairs at the connector; checking connectors is the simplest first troubleshooting step. Re-terminating or checking RFI should follow only if physical inspection doesn't resolve it.

questions.text:
A user took a laptop on a trip and made changes to the network parameters while at the airport. The user can access all internet websites but not corporate intranet websites.
Which of the following is the most likely cause of the issue?
questions.explanation: Incorrect DNS settings would resolve public internet names but fail to resolve internal intranet hostnames, matching the symptom. A duplicate IP or subnet mask issue would typically cause broader connectivity problems.

questions.text: Which of the following best describe the functions of Layer 2 of the OSI model? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Layer 2 handles local (MAC) addressing and error detection via frame check sequences. Logical addressing and port addressing occur at Layer 3 and Layer 4, respectively.

questions.text:
A network administrator wants to implement an authentication process for temporary access to an organization’s network.
Which of the following technologies would facilitate this process?
questions.explanation: A captive portal provides a web-based authentication page for temporary or guest network access. Enterprise authentication and WPA3 are for persistent, credentialed access rather than temporary guest use.

questions.text: Which of the following would be best suited for use at the access layer in a three-tier architecture system?
questions.explanation: Access layer connects end devices with inexpensive Layer 2 switches (port security, PoE, VLAN assignment). Multilayer switches belong at distribution/collapsed core. APs attach to the access layer but the standard access-layer device is the Layer 2 switch.

questions.text:
Following the implementation of a BYOD policy, some users in a high-density environment report slowness over the wireless connection. Some wireless controller reports indicate high latency and airttime contention.
Which of the following is the most probable root cause?
options: The AP is configured with 2.4GHz frequency, which the new personal devices do not support.
The AP is configured with 2.4GHz frequency without band-steering capabilities.
The AP is configured with 5Ghz frequency with band-steering capabilities.
The AP is configured with 5Ghz frequency, which the new personal devices do not support
questions.explanation: 2.4GHz without band-steering forces many BYOD devices onto a congested, limited-channel band, causing high latency and airtime contention in high-density environments. 5GHz configurations typically offer more capacity and less contention.

questions.text:
A company’s VoIP phone connection is cutting in and out.
Which of the following should be configured to resolve this issue?
questions.explanation: 802.1Q VLAN tagging with proper QoS prioritizes voice traffic, reducing jitter and dropouts. Jumbo frames and link aggregation address throughput/frame size issues, not voice quality prioritization.

questions.text:
A network technician is configuring a wireless network that consists of multiple APs for better coverage and allows roaming between the APs.
Which of the following types of SSIDs should the technician configure?
questions.explanation: An Extended Service Set (ESS) uses multiple APs sharing the same SSID to allow seamless roaming. A Basic Service Set involves only a single AP, limiting roaming.

questions.text:
A network engineer performed a migration to a new mail server. The engineer changed the MX record, verified the change was accurate, and confirmed the new mail server was reachable via the IP address in the A record. However, users are not receiving email.
Which of the following should the engineer have done to prevent the issue from occurring?
options: Change the email client configuration to match the MX record.
Reduce the TTL record prior to the MX record change.
Perform a DNS zone transfer prior to the MX record change.
Update the NS record to reflect the IP address change.
questions.explanation: Reducing the TTL before the MX record change would have ensured faster propagation of the update, preventing cached old records from causing mail delivery failures. Zone transfers and NS record updates don't address MX record caching delays.

questions.text: Which of the following network topologies contains a direct connection between every node in the network?
questions.explanation: A mesh topology connects every node directly to every other node. Star and hub-and-spoke topologies rely on a central connecting point rather than direct node-to-node links.

questions.text: Which of the following layers of the OSI model is responsible for end-to-end encryption?
questions.explanation: The Presentation layer handles data formatting, compression, and encryption before data reaches the Application layer. Application layer deals with user-facing protocols, not the encryption mechanism itself.

questions.text:
A company, which is located in a coastal town, retrofitted an office building for a new data center. The underground fiber optics were brought in and connected to the switches in the basement network MDF. A server data center was built on the fifth floor with the two rooms vertically connected by fiber optics.
Which of the following types of environmental sensors is most needed?
options: Temperature sensor in the network MOF
Water sensor in the network MDF
Temperature sensor in the data center
Water sensor in the data center
questions.explanation: Since the network MDF is in the basement of a coastal building where underground fiber enters, it is most at risk of water intrusion from flooding or groundwater seepage. The data center on the fifth floor is less exposed to water risk.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to monitor traffic on a specific port on a switch.
Which of the following should the administrator configure to accomplish the task?
questions.explanation: Port mirroring copies traffic from a specified port to another port for monitoring/analysis. Port security restricts which MAC addresses can use a port rather than monitoring traffic.

questions.text:
A company is designing a new complex. The primary and alternate data centers will be in separate buildings 6.2mi (10km) apart and will be connected via fiber.
Which of the following types of SFP is the best choice?
questions.explanation: 10GBASE-LR uses single-mode fiber and supports distances up to 10km, matching the 6.2mi requirement. 10GBASE-SR and 1000BASE-SX use multimode fiber limited to a few hundred meters.

questions.text: Which of the following should a junior security administrator recommend implementing to mitigate malicious network activity?
questions.explanation: An intrusion prevention system actively blocks malicious traffic in real time. Access logging only records activity and does not mitigate threats.

questions.text:
A client wants to increase overall security after a recent breach.
Which of the following would be best to implement? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Least privilege network access limits exposure by restricting user permissions, and central policy management ensures consistent security enforcement across the network. Dynamic inventories and zero-touch provisioning relate to automation, not directly to security hardening after a breach.

questions.text: Which of the following passwords would provide the best defense against a brute-force attack?
questions.explanation: Longer passphrases like this increase the keyspace exponentially, making brute-force attacks far more time-consuming than shorter complex passwords. Shorter passwords with special characters, even if complex, are cracked faster due to reduced length.

questions.text: Which of the following is most likely to be implemented to actively mitigate intrusions on a host device?
questions.explanation: A host intrusion prevention system (HIPS) actively blocks malicious activity on an individual host, while HIDS only detects and alerts without taking action. NIPS/NIDS operate at the network level, not the host.

questions.text:
A network administrator wants to know which systems on the network are at risk of a known vulnerability.
Which of the following should the administrator reference?
questions.explanation: A CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) entry identifies known vulnerabilities and affected systems. An SLA or NDA are contractual documents unrelated to vulnerability tracking.

questions.text:
A network engineer is upgrading an existing edge gateway. The company currently uses a router and needs to be able to filter on all OSI layers.
Which of the following should the engineer use to upgrade the gateway?
questions.explanation: A next-generation firewall (NGFW) can perform deep packet inspection and filter traffic across all OSI layers, unlike a standard router. A Layer 3 switch only handles routing and switching functions, not full-layer filtering.

questions.text: Which of the following architectures would allow the network-forwarding elements to adapt to new business requirements with the least amount of operating effort?
questions.explanation: Software-defined networking separates the control plane from the data plane, allowing forwarding devices to be reprogrammed centrally with minimal manual effort. Spine and leaf and three-tier are physical topologies, not adaptive control architectures.

questions.text:
A customer lost the connection to the telephone system. The administration console is configured with multiple network interfaces and is connected to multiple switches. The network administrator troubleshoots and verifies the following:

• The support team is able to connect remotely to the administration console.
• Rebooting the switch shows solid link and activity lights even on unused ports.
• Rebooting the telephone system does not bring the system back online.
• The console is able to connect directly to individual modules successfully.

Which of the following is the most likely reason the customer lost the connection?
options: The console software needs to be reinstalled.
The cables to the modules need to be replaced.
questions.explanation: Solid link and activity lights on unused ports after a reboot is classic evidence of a failed switch, and the console still reaching modules directly proves the modules and cabling are fine. A module failure would not explain lights on ports with nothing connected, nor the loss of the whole system.

questions.text:
A network security technician is designing a solution for a secure remote access scheme with the following requirements:

• The solution must allow for users at multiple locations to access corporate resources.
• The on-premises equipment will not handle non-corporate, resource-bound traffic.

Which of the following should the network security technician consider when designing the solution? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Client-to-site VPN allows individual remote users at multiple locations to securely reach corporate resources, and clientless VPN provides browser-based access without requiring on-premises handling of unrelated traffic. Full-tunnel VPN would route all non-corporate traffic through on-premises equipment, violating the requirement.

questions.text: Which of the following uses an automated script to make configuration changes when interacting with a web application?
questions.explanation: An API allows automated scripts to interact programmatically with a web application to make configuration changes. GUI requires manual interaction, not automated scripting.

questions.text: Which of the following ports is used for secure email?
questions.explanation: Port 587 is used for secure email submission (SMTP with STARTTLS). Port 25 is unencrypted SMTP relay traffic between servers.

questions.text: Which of the following is the next step to take after successfully confirming a theory?
options: Duplicate the problem in a lab.
Implement the solution to the problem.
questions.explanation: In the CompTIA troubleshooting methodology, once a theory of probable cause is confirmed, the next step is to establish a plan of action to resolve the problem, that is, determine resolution steps. Implementing the solution comes afterward, only once the plan and any potential effects are identified.

questions.text:
A network administrator is configuring a new switch and wants to ensure that only assigned devices can connect to the switch.
Which of the following should the administrator do?
questions.explanation: Port security restricts switch port access to specific authorized MAC addresses. ACLs control traffic based on IP/protocol rules, not device connection to a switch port.

questions.text: Which of the following does OSPF use to communicate routing updates?
questions.explanation: OSPF uses multicast addresses (224.0.0.5 and 224.0.0.6) to send routing updates to neighboring routers. It does not rely on broadcast or unicast for standard updates.

questions.text:
A user notifies a network administrator about losing access to a remote file server. The network administrator is able to ping the server and verifies the current firewall rules do not block access to the network fileshare.
Which of the following tools would help identify which ports are open on the remote file server?
questions.explanation: Nmap performs port scanning to identify open ports and services on a remote host. Tracert and dig/nslookup are used for path tracing and DNS resolution, not port scanning.

questions.text:
A security team would like to use a system in an isolated network to record the actions of potential attackers.
Which of the following solutions is the security team implementing?
questions.explanation: A honeypot is a decoy system placed in an isolated network to attract and record attacker behavior. A perimeter network separates internal networks from untrusted ones but does not serve this deceptive monitoring purpose.

questions.text:
An organization has a factory automation solution that requires accurate timing between devices.
Which of the following should the network administrator implement?
questions.explanation: PTP (Precision Time Protocol) provides sub-microsecond timing accuracy needed for industrial automation, far more precise than NTP. NTS is a secure extension of NTP and DoT (DNS over TLS) is unrelated to timing.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to set up a file server to allow user access. The organization uses DHCP to assign IP addresses.
Which of the following is the best solution for the administrator to set up?
options: A separate scope for the file server using a /32 subnet
A reservation for the server based on the MAC address
A static IP address within the DHCP IP range
questions.explanation: A DHCP reservation based on MAC address ensures the file server always receives the same IP while still using DHCP. A static IP within the DHCP range risks address conflicts since DHCP is unaware of it being taken.

questions.text: Which of the following ports is a secure protocol?
questions.explanation: Port 443 is used for HTTPS, a secure encrypted protocol. Ports 20, 23, and 445 correspond to FTP data, Telnet, and SMB, none of which are inherently secure.

questions.text:
A systems administrator needs to improve WiFi performance in a densely populated office tower and use the latest standard. There is a mix of devices that use2.4 GHz and 5 GHz.
Which of the following should the systems administrator select to meet this requirement?
questions.explanation: 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) is the latest standard supporting both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands with improved performance in dense environments via OFDMA. 802.11ac only operates on 5 GHz and is an older standard.

questions.text: Which of the following would be BEST to use to detect a MAC spoofing attack?
questions.explanation: Reverse Address Resolution Protocol maps MAC addresses to IP addresses, making it useful to detect mismatches indicating MAC spoofing. ICMP and DHCP do not directly verify MAC-to-IP legitimacy in this way.

questions.text:
A technician receives feedback that some users are experiencing high amounts of jitter while using the wireless network. While troubleshooting the network, the technician uses the ping command with the IP address of the default gateway and verifies large variations in latency. The technician thinks the issue may be interference from other networks and non-802.11 devices.
Which of the following tools should the technician use to troubleshoot the issue?
questions.explanation: A spectrum analyzer detects RF interference from non-802.11 devices and overlapping networks causing jitter. A protocol analyzer examines packet-level data, not RF interference.

questions.text:
Wireless users are reporting intermittent internet connectivity. Connectivity is restored when the users disconnect and reconnect, utilizing the web authentication process each time. The network administrator can see the devices connected to the APs at all times.
Which of the following steps will MOST likely determine the cause of the issue?
options: Verify the session time-out configuration on the captive portal settings
Check for encryption protocol mismatch on the client's wireless settings
Confirm that a valid passphrase is being used during the web authentication
Investigate for a client's disassociation caused by an evil twin AP
questions.explanation: Intermittent connectivity restored only by re-authenticating suggests the captive portal session is timing out, dropping users after a set interval even though the AP association remains active. Encryption mismatches or evil twin issues would cause disassociation, not periodic re-auth prompts.

questions.text:
A network administrator walks into a datacenter and notices an unknown person is following closely. The administrator stops and directs the person to the security desk.
Which of the following attacks did the network administrator prevent?
questions.explanation: Tailgating occurs when an unauthorized person follows an authorized person into a secure area without consent, which the administrator stopped. Piggybacking implies the authorized person knowingly allows access, which did not happen here.

questions.text: A network is experiencing a number of CRC errors during normal network communication. At which of the following layers of the OSI model will the administrator MOST likely start to troubleshoot?
questions.explanation: CRC errors indicate physical-layer issues such as bad cabling, connectors, or interference, so troubleshooting starts at Layer 1. Layer 2 issues involve framing/switching problems, not the physical signal corruption CRC errors reflect.

questions.text:
A client recently added 100 users who are using VMs. All users have since reported slow or unresponsive desktops. Reports show minimal network congestion, zero packet loss, and acceptable packet delay.
Which of the following metrics will MOST accurately show the underlying performance issues? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Since network metrics are fine, the bottleneck likely lies in host resource exhaustion—CPU usage and memory are key indicators of VM performance issues. Bandwidth and latency are network-related metrics already ruled out.

questions.text:
Client devices cannot enter a network, and the network administrator determines the DHCP scope is exhausted. The administrator wants to avoid creating a new DHCP pool.
Which of the following can the administrator perform to resolve the issue?
questions.explanation: Reducing the DHCP lease time allows addresses to be reclaimed and reused more quickly, alleviating scope exhaustion without creating a new pool. Installing load balancers or switches does not address IP address shortage.

questions.text:
An administrator is writing a script to periodically log the IPv6 and MAC addresses of all the devices on a network segment.
Which of the following switch features will MOST likely be used to assist with this task?
questions.explanation: Neighbor Discovery Protocol is used in IPv6 to discover neighboring devices' MAC and IPv6 addresses, making it ideal for this logging task. ARP performs a similar function but only for IPv4.

questions.text: Which of the following DNS records works as an alias to another record?
questions.explanation: A CNAME record acts as an alias, pointing one domain name to another canonical name. AAAA records map hostnames to IPv6 addresses, not aliases.

questions.text:
A company built a new building at its headquarters location. The new building is connected to the company's LAN via fiber-optic cable. Multiple users in the new building are unable to access the company's intranet site via their web browser, but they are able to access internet sites.
Which of the following describes how the network administrator can resolve this issue?
options: Correct the DNS server entries in the DHCP scope
Correct the external firewall gateway address
Correct the NTP server settings on the clients
Correct a TFTP Issue on the company's server
questions.explanation: If internet sites work but the intranet does not resolve, the issue is likely incorrect internal DNS server entries in the DHCP scope pointing clients to the wrong DNS server. An external firewall gateway issue would typically block internet access too.

questions.text:
A technician is installing a new fiber connection to a network device in a datacenter. The connection from the device to the switch also traverses a patch panel connection. The chain of connections is in the following order:

• Device
• LC/LC patch cable
• Patch panel
• Cross-connect fiber cable
• Patch panel
• LC/LC patch cable
• Switch

The connection is not working. The technician has changed both patch cables with known working patch cables. The device had been tested and was working properly before being installed.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the issue?
questions.explanation: Since known-good patch cables were swapped in and the device tested fine before installation, a reversed TX/RX pair on the cross-connect is the most likely remaining cause of a fiber link failure. An incorrect cable type would typically prevent any signal, but polarity mismatch is more consistent with a working device that fails only after installation.

questions.text:
A technician is searching for a device that is connected to the network and has the device's physical network address.
Which of the following should the technician review on the switch to locate the device's network port?
questions.explanation: The MAC address table on a switch maps MAC addresses to physical switch ports, allowing the technician to locate the device. VLAN tags and QoS tags do not provide port-to-MAC mapping.

questions.text: Which of the following provides redundancy on a file server to ensure the server is still connected to a LAN even in the event of a port failure on a switch?
questions.explanation: NIC teaming allows a server to use multiple physical NICs connected to different switch ports, maintaining connectivity if one port fails. RAID protects data redundancy, not network connectivity.

questions.text:
An IT organization needs to optimize speeds for global content distribution and wants to reduce latency in high-density user locations.
Which of the following technologies BEST meets the organization's requirements?
questions.explanation: A content delivery network caches content closer to users in high-density locations, reducing latency for global content distribution. Load balancing distributes traffic across servers but doesn't inherently reduce geographic latency.

questions.text:
A user reports being unable to access network resources after making some changes in the office.
Which of the following should a network technician do FIRST?
options: Do a ping test against the servers
Reseat the cables into the back of the PC
questions.explanation: Following the troubleshooting methodology, gathering information by asking what changes were made should occur first before testing. Checking IP addresses or pinging servers are later steps once the cause is identified.

questions.text:
A new cabling certification is being requested every time a network technician rebuilds one end of a Cat 6 (vendor-certified) cable to create a crossover connection that is used to connect switches.
Which of the following would address this issue by allowing the use of the original cable?
questions.explanation: MDIX (Auto-MDIX) allows switches to automatically detect and adjust for straight-through vs. crossover cabling, eliminating the need for a physical crossover cable. LACP is for link aggregation, unrelated to cable type.

questions.text:
A company hired a technician to find all the devices connected within a network.
Which of the following software tools would BEST assist the technician in completing this task?
questions.explanation: An IP scanner discovers all active devices on a network by scanning IP address ranges. A port scanner identifies open ports on specific hosts rather than discovering all devices.

questions.text:
A technician is installing a high-density wireless network and wants to use an available frequency that supports the maximum number of channels to reduce interference.
Which of the following standard 802.11 frequency ranges should the technician look for while reviewing WAP specifications?
questions.explanation: The 6GHz band used by Wi-Fi 6E offers the most non-overlapping channels of any Wi-Fi frequency, making it ideal for high-density deployments to reduce interference. The 5GHz band has fewer available channels, and 2.4GHz has the fewest and most interference-prone channels.

questions.text:
A technician is configuring a network switch to be used in a publicly accessible location.
Which of the following should the technician configure on the switch to prevent unintended connections?
questions.explanation: Port security restricts which MAC addresses can connect to a switchport, preventing unauthorized devices from gaining network access in a publicly accessible location. DHCP snooping protects against rogue DHCP servers, not unauthorized physical connections.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to track and document various types of known vulnerabilities?
questions.explanation: CVE (Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures) is the standardized dictionary used to track and document publicly known vulnerabilities. Penetration testing actively probes for weaknesses rather than cataloging known ones.

questions.text:
The network administrator is informed that a user's email password is frequently hacked by brute-force programs.
Which of the following policies should the network administrator implements to BEST mitigate this issue? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Two-factor authentication adds a second verification step that blocks access even if a password is brute-forced, and complex passwords make brute-force attacks significantly harder to succeed. Captive portals and geofencing address different access control concerns, not password-cracking attempts.

questions.text:
A network engineer performs the following tasks to increase server bandwidth:

• Connects two network cables from the server to a switch stack
• Configure LACP on the switchportsVerifies the correct configurations on the switch interfaces

Which of the following needs to be configured on the server?
questions.explanation: NIC teaming on the server combines multiple physical NICs into one logical interface to work with the LACP-configured switch link aggregation. Multipathing applies to storage paths, not network bandwidth aggregation.

questions.text:
A network technician is manually configuring the network settings for a new device and is told the network block is 192.168.0.0/20.
Which of the following subnets should the technician use?
questions.explanation: A /20 network provides 4096 addresses with a subnet mask of 255.255.240.0, since 20 bits are used for the network portion. The other masks correspond to different prefix lengths (/17, /18, /21).

questions.text: Which of the following is the LARGEST MTU for a standard Ethernet frame?
questions.explanation: The standard Ethernet frame supports a maximum MTU of 1500 bytes for the payload. 2304 relates to 802.11 wireless frames, and 1492 is used with PPPoE encapsulation which reduces the standard MTU.

questions.text: According to troubleshooting methodology, which of the following should the technician do NEXT after determining the most likely probable cause of an issue?
options: Establish a plan of action to resolve the issue and identify potential effects
Verify full system functionality and, if applicable, implement preventive measures
Implement the solution or escalate as necessary
Test the theory to determine the cause
questions.explanation: After establishing a theory of probable cause, the next step in troubleshooting methodology is to test that theory to confirm it before creating a plan of action. Establishing a plan of action comes only after the theory is confirmed.

questions.text: Which of the following BEST describes a network appliance that warns of unapproved devices that are accessing the network?
questions.explanation: An IDS (Intrusion Detection System) monitors network traffic and alerts administrators to unapproved or suspicious devices and activity. A firewall blocks traffic based on rules but doesn't specifically warn of unapproved devices accessing the network.

questions.text:
A technician is installing a cable modem in a SOHO.
Which of the following cable types will the technician MOST likely use to connect a modem to the ISP?
questions.explanation: Cable modems connect to the ISP over the existing coaxial cable infrastructure used for cable television service. Fiber and Cat 6e are not typical last-mile connections for cable modem service.

questions.explanation: The 18,397 CRC errors show frames arriving corrupted, which points to a damaged or noisy cable. Giants stay at 0, so oversized frames are not the problem, and last cleared and packets/multicasts output are just normal volume and timing statistics.

questions.text: Which of the following is the physical topology for an Ethernet LAN?
questions.explanation: Modern Ethernet LANs physically connect devices to a central switch, forming a star topology, even though logically they may behave like a bus. Bus and ring describe older or logical topologies, not the physical wiring used today.

questions.text:
An IT director is setting up new disaster and HA policies for a company. Limited downtime is critical to operations. To meet corporate requirements, the director set up two different datacenters across the country that will stay current on data and applications. In the event of an outage, the company can immediately switch from one datacenter to another.
Which of the following does this BEST describe?
questions.explanation: A hot site is a fully operational, geographically separate datacenter that stays current with data and applications, allowing immediate failover with minimal downtime. A warm site requires additional setup time before it can take over operations.

questions.text:
The management team needs to ensure unnecessary modifications to the corporate network are not permitted and version control is maintained.
Which of the following documents would BEST support this?
questions.explanation: A change management policy formalizes the process for reviewing, approving, and documenting network modifications, including version control. An acceptable use policy governs user behavior, not network change control.

questions.text: Which of the following is MOST likely to generate significant East-West traffic in a datacenter?
options: A backup of a large video presentation to cloud storage for archival purposes
A duplication of a hosted virtual server to another physical server for redundancy
A download of navigation data to a portable device for offline access
A query from an IoT device to a cloud-hosted server for a firmware update
questions.explanation: East-West traffic refers to data moving between servers within the same datacenter, such as replicating a virtual server to another physical host for redundancy. The other options describe North-South traffic flowing between the datacenter and external clients or the internet.

questions.text:
A technician is troubleshooting a network switch that seems to stop responding to requests intermittently whenever the logging level is set for debugging.
Which of the following metrics should the technician check to begin troubleshooting the issue?
questions.explanation: Debug-level logging is resource-intensive and can spike CPU utilization, causing a switch to become unresponsive intermittently. CRC errors relate to physical cabling issues, not logging load.

questions.text:
A technician wants to deploy a new wireless network that comprises 30 WAPs installed throughout a three-story office building. All the APs will broadcast the same SSID for client access.
Which of the following BEST describes this deployment?
questions.explanation: An extended service set consists of multiple access points broadcasting the same SSID to provide seamless roaming coverage across a larger area like a multi-story building. A basic service set involves only a single access point.

questions.text:
A user tries to ping 192.168.1.100 from the command prompt on the 192.168.2.101 network but gets the following response:
Which of the following needs to be configured for these networks to reach each other?
questions.explanation: The U.U.U.U response indicates the destination is unreachable because the host lacks a route to the other subnet, which requires configuring a default gateway to reach networks outside its own. NAT and routing protocols are unnecessary for this simple two-subnet connectivity issue.
questions.exhibit: U.U.U.U.

Which of the following describes the issue?

The incorrect IP address was configured

questions.text: Within the realm of network security, Zero Trust ________________.
options: prevents attackers from moving laterally through a system.
allows a server to communicate with outside networks without a firewall.
block malicious software that is too new to be found in virus definitions.
stops infected files from being downloaded via websites.
questions.explanation: Zero Trust enforces strict verification and segmentation so a compromised user or device cannot freely move laterally across the network. It does not specifically address antivirus signature gaps or website downloads.

questions.text: Which of the following service models would MOST likely be used to replace on-premises servers with a cloud solution?
questions.explanation: Infrastructure as a Service provides virtualized compute, storage, and networking resources, directly replacing physical on-premises servers. PaaS and SaaS abstract away infrastructure management, which doesn't match replacing servers.

questions.text: Which of the following factors should be considered when evaluating a firewall to protect a datacenter's east-west traffic?
options: Replication traffic between an on-premises server and a remote backup facility
Traffic between VMs running on different hosts
Concurrent connections generated by Internet DDoS attacks
VPN traffic from remote offices to the datacenter's VMs
questions.explanation: East-west traffic refers to traffic moving laterally within the datacenter, such as between VMs on different hosts. North-south traffic includes client-to-server or VPN/Internet traffic entering/leaving the datacenter, which the other options describe.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to prioritize Internet usage per application and per user on the network?
questions.explanation: Bandwidth management (QoS/traffic shaping) allows prioritization of Internet usage per application and per user. BGP and administrative distance relate to routing decisions, not per-user/application prioritization.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to query the NSs for a remote application.
Which of the following commands would BEST help the administrator accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: The dig command queries DNS name servers (NS records) for domain information. arp resolves MAC addresses, and the other commands don't query DNS records.

questions.text: Which of the following would MOST likely be used to review previous upgrades to a system?
questions.explanation: Change management maintains records of past changes and upgrades, allowing review of what was implemented. A business continuity plan and standard operating procedures don't track historical change records.

questions.text:
A technician is deploying a new switch model and would like to add it to the existing network monitoring software. The technician wants to know what metrics can be gathered from a given switch.
Which of the following should the technician utilize for the switch?
questions.explanation: A Management Information Base (MIB) defines the set of manageable objects and metrics that can be polled via SNMP from a device like a switch. Traps are unsolicited alerts, not a catalog of available metrics.

questions.text:
A network device is configured to send critical events to a syslog server; however, the following alerts are not being received:
Which of the following describes the reason why the events are not being received?
options: The network device is not configured to log that level to the syslog server
The network device was down and could not send the event
The syslog server is not compatible with the network device
The syslog server did not have the correct MIB loaded to receive the message
questions.explanation: If the device isn't configured to log severity level 5 events to the syslog server, those messages won't be forwarded even though the interface state changes occurred. The device is clearly still operational since it sends other messages.
questions.exhibit:
Severity 5 LINK-UPDOWN: Interface 1/1, changed state to down
Severity 5 LINK-UPDOWN: Interface 1/3, changed state to down

questions.text:
A network administrator is implementing OSPF on all of a company's network devices.
Which of the following will MOST likely replace all the company's hubs?
questions.explanation: A Layer 3 switch provides routing capability (needed for OSPF) while also replacing hubs with switched, full-duplex ports at each connection. Proxy servers, NGFWs, and WLAN controllers don't replace hub functionality.

questions.text:
A network administrator discovers that users in an adjacent building are connecting to the company's guest wireless network to download inappropriate material.
Which of the following can the administrator do to MOST easily mitigate this issue?
questions.explanation: Reducing wireless power levels limits the signal's range so it doesn't reach the adjacent building, easily mitigating unauthorized access. Client isolation and port security control what connected devices can do, not who can connect based on range.

questions.text:
A network administrator is designing a new datacenter in a different region that will need to communicate to the old datacenter with a secure connection.
Which of the following access methods would provide the BEST security for this new datacenter?
questions.explanation: A site-to-site VPN creates an encrypted tunnel between two networks, providing secure ongoing connectivity between datacenters. VNC and SSH are for remote device/session access, not site-to-site network connectivity.

questions.text:
An attacker is attempting to find the password to a network by inputting common words and phrases in plaintext to the password prompt.
Which of the following attack types BEST describes this action?
questions.explanation: A dictionary attack uses a list of common words and phrases to guess passwords. A brute-force attack instead tries all possible character combinations rather than known words/phrases.

questions.text: Which of the following technologies provides a failover mechanism for the default gateway?
questions.explanation: First Hop Redundancy Protocol (e.g., HSRP/VRRP) provides a virtual default gateway that fails over between routers if one goes down. LACP is for link aggregation, and STP prevents loops, neither providing gateway redundancy.

questions.text:

There are 300 non-concurrent sales representatives who log in for one hour a day to upload reports, and 252 of these representatives are able to connect to the VPN without any Issues. The remaining sales representatives cannot connect to the VPN over the course of the day.
Which of the following can be done to resolve the issue without utilizing additional resources?
questions.explanation: Since reps only need an address for about one hour but the lease lasts 8 days, addresses remain reserved long after use, exhausting the pool; shortening the lease duration frees addresses faster without adding resources. Rebooting the server or adding hardware would not fix the underlying lease exhaustion.

questions.text:
A network engineer is investigating reports of poor network performance. Upon reviewing a device configuration, the engineer finds that duplex settings are mismatched on both ends.
Which of the following would be the MOST likely result of this finding?
questions.explanation: Duplex mismatches typically cause late collisions and CRC errors due to one side expecting full duplex operation while the other doesn't detect collisions properly. Switching loops and temperature increases are unrelated to duplex mismatch symptoms.

questions.text: Which of the following devices would be used to manage a corporate WLAN?
questions.explanation: A wireless controller centrally manages multiple access points that make up a corporate WLAN, handling configuration, channel assignment, and roaming. A wireless router or bridge is not designed for centralized enterprise WLAN management.

questions.text: Which of the following types of devices can provide content filtering and threat protection, and manage multiple IPSec site-to-site connections?
questions.explanation: A next-generation firewall combines content filtering, threat protection (IPS/antimalware), and VPN termination capabilities for managing multiple IPSec site-to-site tunnels. A VPN headend only handles VPN connections, lacking integrated content filtering and threat protection.

questions.text:
An engineer notices some late collisions on a half-duplex link. The engineer verifies that the devices on both ends of the connection are configured for half duplex.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of this issue?
options: One of the devices is misconfigured
One of the devices has a hardware issue
questions.explanation: Excessive cable length beyond specification causes propagation delay that leads to late collisions even when duplex settings are correctly matched. Misconfiguration is ruled out since both devices were verified to be set to half duplex.

questions.text:
A network administrator is configuring a load balancer for two systems.
Which of the following must the administrator configure to ensure connectivity during a failover?
questions.explanation: A Virtual IP (VIP) is configured on the load balancer so clients continue reaching the service through a consistent address even if one backend system fails over to another. NAT, APIPA, and broadcast IP don't provide this failover-transparent addressing.

questions.text:
A technician is troubleshooting a wireless connectivity issue in a small office located in a high-rise building. Several APs are mounted in this office. The users report that the network connections frequently disconnect and reconnect throughout the day.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of this issue?
options: The AP association time is set too low
questions.explanation: In a high-rise with multiple APs mounted closely, overlapping channels cause interference and clients to disconnect and reconnect as they hop between APs. Association timers and EIRP boosting are less likely root causes of frequent flapping in a dense AP environment.

questions.text:
A network engineer configured new firewalls with the correct configuration to be deployed to each remote branch. Unneeded services were disabled, and all firewall rules were applied successfully.
Which of the following should the network engineer perform NEXT to ensure all the firewalls are hardened successfully?
options: Ensure an implicit permit rule is enabled
Configure the log settings on the firewalls to the central syslog server
Update the firewalls with current firmware and software
Use the same complex passwords on all firewalls
questions.explanation: After disabling unneeded services and applying firewall rules, ensuring firmware and software are up to date closes known vulnerabilities and completes the hardening process. Log centralization and password policies are good practices but don't directly harden the device against exploits.

questions.text: At which of the following OSI model layers would a technician find an IP header?
questions.explanation: The IP header is added at Layer 3 (Network layer) of the OSI model, where logical addressing and routing occur.

questions.text:
An engineer is configuring redundant network links between switches.
Which of the following should the engineer enable to prevent network stability issues?
questions.explanation: Spanning Tree Protocol prevents Layer 2 loops that occur with redundant switch links, avoiding broadcast storms and instability. 802.1Q is for VLAN tagging, not loop prevention.

questions.text:
Several WIFI users are reporting the inability to connect to the network. WLAN users on the guest network are able to access all network resources without any performance issues. The following table summarizes the findings after a site survey of the area in question:
Which of the following should a wireless technician do NEXT to troubleshoot this issue?
options: Reconfigure the channels to reduce overlap
Replace the omni antennas with directional antennas
Update the SSIDs on all the APs
Decrease power in AP 3 and AP 4
questions.explanation: The four CORP radios sit on 2.4 GHz channels 1, 2, 3 and 5, whose 20 MHz spectrum overlaps, producing a raised noise floor and 30%+ retries, while the GUEST radios on non-overlapping 5 GHz channels 36 and 44 perform fine. Power is identical on every AP and signal levels are strong, so lowering AP3/AP4 power would only shrink coverage.
