questions.text: Which of the following routing protocols is used to exchange route information between public autonomous systems?
questions.explanation: BGP is the exterior gateway protocol used to exchange routing information between public autonomous systems on the internet. OSPF, EIGRP, and RIP are interior gateway protocols used within a single AS.

questions.text:
A fiber link connecting two campus networks is broken.
Which of the following tools should an engineer use to detect the exact break point of the fiber link?
questions.explanation: An OTDR (Optical Time Domain Reflectometer) sends light pulses down the fiber and measures reflections to pinpoint the exact location of a break. A tone generator and cable tester are used for copper cabling, not fiber fault location.

questions.text: Which of the following can be used to centrally manage credentials for various types of administrative privileges on configured network devices?
questions.explanation: TACACS+ provides centralized authentication, authorization, and accounting for administrative access to network devices, including granular privilege management. SSO addresses user login convenience across applications, not device administration.

questions.text:
A network technician is installing new software on a Windows-based server in a different geographical location.
Which of the following would be BEST for the technician to use to perform this task?
questions.explanation: RDP provides a full remote graphical desktop session, ideal for installing software on a remote Windows server. SSH is typically used for command-line access to Linux/Unix systems, not GUI-based Windows installations.

questions.text:
Branch users are experiencing issues with videoconferencing.
Which of the following will the company MOST likely configure to improve performance for these applications?
questions.explanation: Quality of service prioritizes latency-sensitive traffic like videoconferencing over other network traffic, improving performance. Load balancing and static IPs don't address the prioritization needed for real-time media.

questions.text: A technician is assisting a user who cannot connect to a network resource. The technician first checks for a link light. According to troubleshooting methodology, this is an example of:
questions.explanation: Checking the physical link light first before investigating higher-layer issues represents a bottom-to-top troubleshooting approach, starting at the Physical layer. This is not simply questioning the obvious, which refers to verifying basic assumptions rather than following a structured OSI-based method.

questions.text: Which of the following transceiver types can support up to 40Gbps?
questions.explanation: QSFP+ transceivers support data rates up to 40Gbps. SFP+ supports up to 10Gbps, and QSFP (without the plus) supports lower rates like 4x1Gbps.

questions.text: Which of the following TCP ports is used by the Windows OS for file sharing?
questions.explanation: TCP port 445 is used by SMB for Windows file and printer sharing. Port 389 is LDAP and 1433 is SQL Server, neither related to file sharing.

questions.text:
A network administrator redesigned the positioning of the APs to create adjacent areas of wireless coverage. After project validation, some users still report poor connectivity when their devices maintain an association to a distanced AP.
Which of the following should the network administrator check FIRST?
options: Validate the roaming settings on the APs and WLAN clients
Verify that the AP antenna type is correct for the new layout
Check to see if MU-MIMO was properly activated on the APs
Deactivate the 2.4GHz band on the APS
questions.explanation: When devices remain associated with a distant AP instead of roaming to a closer one, checking roaming settings (such as signal thresholds) on APs and clients is the first step. Antenna type or MU-MIMO issues would cause different symptoms like weak signal rather than sticky client behavior.

questions.text: Which of the following connector types would have the MOST flexibility?
questions.explanation: An SFP is a hot-swappable modular transceiver, so the same port can be adapted to copper, multimode, or single-mode fiber at various distances and speeds, giving the greatest deployment flexibility. RJ45 is fixed to twisted-pair copper only.

questions.text: Which of the following ports is commonly used by VoIP phones?
questions.explanation: Port 5060 is commonly used by SIP for VoIP signaling. Ports 20, 143, and 445 are used for FTP data, IMAP, and SMB, respectively.

questions.text:
A network engineer is investigating reports of poor network performance. Upon reviewing a report, the engineer finds that jitter at the office is greater than 10ms on the only WAN connection available.
Which of the following would be MOST affected by this statistic?
options: A VoIP sales call with a customer
An in-office video call with a coworker
questions.explanation: Jitter, or variation in packet arrival times, most severely impacts real-time VoIP calls, causing choppy or garbled audio. An in-office video call would use the LAN, not the affected WAN link.

questions.text:
A network technician needs to ensure outside users are unable to telnet into any of the servers at the datacenter.
Which of the following ports should be blocked when checking firewall configuration?
questions.explanation: Telnet uses TCP port 23, which should be blocked to prevent outside users from telnetting into datacenter servers. Port 22 is SSH, a secure alternative that would typically remain allowed.

questions.text:
A technician is writing documentation regarding a company's server farm. The technician needs to confirm the server name for all Linux servers.
Which of the following commands should the technician run?
questions.explanation: With no hostname command offered, nslookup is the only listed tool that resolves and confirms server names through DNS. ipconfig is Windows-only and shows local interface data, while arp and route reveal neither DNS names nor server identities.

questions.text:
A technician is connecting multiple switches to create a large network for a new office. The switches are unmanaged Layer 2 switches with multiple connections between each pair. The network is experiencing an extreme amount of latency.
Which of the following is MOST likely occurring?
questions.explanation: Multiple redundant connections between unmanaged Layer 2 switches without STP create loops, causing broadcast frames to circulate endlessly and resulting in a broadcast storm and extreme latency. Routing loops don't apply since these are Layer 2 switches, not routers.

questions.text:
A store owner would like to have secure wireless access available for both business equipment and patron use.
Which of the following features should be configured to allow different wireless access through the same equipment?
questions.explanation: Configuring multiple SSIDs on the same access points allows separate wireless networks (business and patron) with different security settings using shared hardware. MIMO and LTE relate to radio technology, not network segmentation.

questions.text: Which of the following systems would MOST likely be found in a screened subnet?
questions.explanation: FTP is a public-facing service commonly placed in a screened subnet (DMZ) to allow external access while protecting internal networks; RADIUS, SQL, and LDAP are internal services not exposed externally.

questions.text: Which of the following would need to be configured to ensure a device with a specific MAC address is always assigned the same IP address from DHCP?
questions.explanation: A DHCP reservation binds a specific MAC address to a specific IP address, ensuring consistent assignment; static assignment refers to manually configuring the device itself, not the DHCP server.

questions.text:
Access to a datacenter should be individually recorded by a card reader even when multiple employees enter the facility at the same time.
Which of the following allows the enforcement of this policy?
questions.explanation: Access control vestibules only allow one person through at a time, forcing individual card reads even during simultaneous entry attempts; cameras and motion detection only record but do not enforce individual authentication.

questions.explanation: The 255.255.255.224 mask is a /27, so 10.1.2.23 belongs to the 10.1.2.0/27 subnet spanning 10.1.2.0 through 10.1.2.31; its directed broadcast is the last address, 10.1.2.31. 10.1.2.255 would only be the broadcast if the mask were 255.255.255.0, and 10.1.2.0 is the network ID.

questions.text:
After the A record of a public website was updated, some visitors were unable to access the website.
Which of the following should be adjusted to address the issue?
questions.explanation: TTL determines how long DNS resolvers cache the old A record; adjusting it lower before changes and ensuring propagation resolves access issues from cached stale records. MX and TXT records are unrelated to A record caching issues.

questions.text:
A network administrator is installing a wireless network at a client's office.
Which of the following IEEE 802.11 standards would be BEST to use for multiple simultaneous client access?
questions.explanation: CSMA/CA is the media access method used by 802.11 wireless standards to manage multiple simultaneous client access and avoid collisions; CSMA/CD is used in wired Ethernet, not wireless.

questions.text:
A technician is installing multiple UPS units in a major retail store. The technician is required to keep track of all changes to new and old equipment.
Which of the following will allow the technician to record these changes?
questions.explanation: Asset tags allow tracking of equipment changes, ownership, and location throughout its lifecycle; smart lockers and access control vestibules are physical security measures, not asset tracking tools.

questions.text: Which of the following attacks encrypts user data and requires a proper backup implementation to recover?
questions.explanation: Ransomware encrypts user data and demands payment for decryption, making backups essential for recovery; DDoS and MAC spoofing do not involve data encryption.

questions.text:
A network administrator wants to analyze attacks directed toward the company's network.
Which of the following must the network administrator implement to assist in this goal?
questions.explanation: A honeypot is a decoy system designed to attract and analyze attacker behavior, helping administrators study attack patterns; network segmentation and antivirus are preventive, not analytical, tools.

questions.text:
A network administrator is configuring a database server and would like to ensure the database engine is listening on a certain port.
Which of the following commands should the administrator use to accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation: netstat -a displays active connections and listening ports, confirming whether the database engine is listening on the correct port; nslookup and arp -a do not show port status.

questions.text:
A technician is implementing a new wireless network to serve guests at a local office. The network needs to provide Internet access but disallow associated stations from communicating with each other.
Which of the following would BEST accomplish this requirement?
questions.explanation: Wireless client isolation prevents associated wireless stations from communicating with each other while still allowing Internet access; port security and DHCP snooping address different security concerns unrelated to client-to-client communication.

questions.text:
A company requires a disaster recovery site to have equipment ready to go in the event of a disaster at its main datacenter. The company does not have the budget to mirror all the live data to the disaster recovery site.
Which of the following concepts should the company select?
questions.explanation: A warm site has equipment ready but does not require continuous live data mirroring, balancing cost and recovery time; a hot site requires full live data replication which exceeds the budget.

questions.text:
An IT technician suspects a break in one of the uplinks that provides connectivity to the core switch.
Which of the following command-line tools should the technician use to determine where the incident is occurring?
questions.explanation: show interface displays link status, errors, and physical layer information to help pinpoint where a break in an uplink is occurring; netstat and nslookup are host-based tools unrelated to switch interface status.

questions.text:
A technician is connecting DSL for a new customer. After installing and connecting the on-premises equipment, the technician verifies DSL synchronization. When connecting to a workstation, however, the link LEDs on the workstation and modem do not light up.
Which of the following should the technician perform during troubleshooting?
options: Identify the switching loops between the modem and the workstation.
Check for asymmetrical routing on the modem.
Look for a rogue DHCP server on the network.
Replace the cable connecting the modem and the workstation.
questions.explanation: Since the modem shows DSL sync but the link LEDs on both devices are off, the Ethernet cable between modem and workstation is likely faulty and should be replaced; switching loops and rogue DHCP servers would not cause link LED failure.

questions.text: Which of the following services can provide data storage, hardware options, and scalability to a third-party company that cannot afford new devices?
questions.explanation: IaaS provides virtualized hardware, storage, and scalable infrastructure without requiring the customer to purchase physical devices; SaaS delivers software applications, not infrastructure.

questions.text:
A network administrator is talking to different vendors about acquiring technology to support a new project for a large company.
Which of the following documents will MOST likely need to be signed before information about the project is shared?
questions.explanation: An NDA (non-disclosure agreement) must be signed to protect confidential project information shared with vendors; an SLA defines service expectations but does not address confidentiality.

questions.text:
Two remote offices need to be connected securely over an untrustworthy MAN. Each office needs to access network shares at the other site.
Which of the following will BEST provide this functionality?
questions.explanation: A site-to-site VPN securely connects two networks over an untrusted link, allowing continuous access to shared resources at both locations; a client-to-site VPN is designed for individual remote users, not office-to-office connectivity.

questions.text:
A network requirement calls for segmenting departments into different networks. The campus network is set up with users of each department in multiple buildings.
Which of the following should be configured to keep the design simple and efficient?
questions.explanation: Port tagging (802.1Q VLAN tagging) allows traffic from multiple departments across buildings to be logically segmented over shared switch infrastructure efficiently; jumbo frames and flow control do not address network segmentation.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols will a security appliance that is correlating network events from multiple devices MOST likely rely on to receive event messages?
questions.explanation: Syslog is the standard protocol used to collect and centralize event and log messages from multiple network devices for correlation and analysis; SFTP and SMB are file transfer protocols, not logging protocols.

questions.text: Which of the following is MOST commonly used to address CVEs on network equipment and/or operating systems?
questions.explanation: Firmware updates patch known vulnerabilities (CVEs) in network equipment and operating systems; a vulnerability assessment identifies weaknesses but does not remediate them.

questions.text:
A network technician is investigating an issue with handheld devices in a warehouse. Devices have not been connecting to the nearest APs, but they have been connecting to an AP on the far side of the warehouse.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of this issue?
options: The nearest APs are configured for 802.11g.
An incorrect channel assignment is on the nearest APs.
The power level is too high for the AP on the far side.
Interference exists around the AP on the far side.
questions.explanation: Excessive transmit power on the far AP can overpower the closer AP's signal, causing devices to associate with the stronger but farther AP. Incorrect channel assignment would cause interference, not preferential connection to a distant AP.

questions.text: Which of the following uses the destination IP address to forward packets?
questions.explanation: Routers use the destination IP address to make Layer 3 forwarding decisions. Switches and bridges use Layer 2 MAC addresses instead.

questions.text: Which of the following OSI model layers is where conversations between applications are established, coordinated, and terminated?
questions.explanation: The Session layer establishes, manages, and terminates connections between applications. The Presentation layer handles data formatting/encryption, not session control.

questions.text:
A business is using the local cable company to provide Internet access.
Which of the following types of cabling will the cable company MOST likely use from the demarcation point back to the central office?
questions.explanation: Cable providers typically use RG-6 coaxial cable for the last-mile connection to the central office. Cat 5e/6 and multimode fiber are used for LAN, not cable ISP distribution.

questions.text:
A network administrator decided to use SLAAC in an extensive IPv6 deployment to alleviate IP address management. The devices were properly connected into the LAN but autoconfiguration of the IP address did not occur as expected.
Which of the following should the network administrator verify?
options: The network gateway is configured to send router advertisements.
A DHCP server is present on the same broadcast domain as the clients.
The devices support dual stack on the network layer.
The local gateway supports anycast routing.
questions.explanation: SLAAC relies on router advertisements from the gateway to provide the network prefix; if RAs are not enabled, autoconfiguration fails. DHCP is unrelated since SLAAC does not require a DHCP server.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to provide networking capability for VMs at Layer 2 of the OSI model?
questions.explanation: A vSwitch provides Layer 2 switching functionality for virtual machines within a hypervisor. VPN, VRRP, and VIP operate at different layers or serve different purposes.

questions.text:
A network administrator is required to ensure that auditors have read-only access to the system logs, while systems administrators have read and write access to the system logs, and operators have no access to the system logs. The network administrator has configured security groups for each of these functional categories.
Which of the following security capabilities will allow the network administrator to maintain these permissions with the LEAST administrative effort?
questions.explanation: Role-based access control assigns permissions based on predefined roles (auditor, admin, operator), matching the groups already configured with minimal ongoing administration. User-based permissions would require managing each individual account separately.

questions.text: Which of the following would be used to expedite MX record updates to authoritative NSs?
questions.explanation: Lowering the Time to Live value causes DNS records to propagate faster to authoritative name servers and resolvers. DNS caching and recursive lookup relate to how records are retrieved, not update speed.

questions.text:
A client moving into a new office wants the IP network set up to accommodate 412 network-connected devices that are all on the same subnet. The subnet needs to be as small as possible.
Which of the following subnet masks should be used to achieve the required result?
questions.explanation: A /23 mask (255.255.254.0) provides 510 usable addresses, enough for 412 devices while being smaller than a /22. A /24 (255.255.255.0) only offers 254 addresses, which is insufficient.

questions.text:
A company is being acquired by a large corporation. As part of the acquisition process, the company's address should now redirect clients to the corporate organization page.
Which of the following DNS records needs to be created?
questions.explanation: A CNAME record aliases one domain name to another, allowing the old address to redirect to the corporate site. SOA and NS records manage zone authority, not redirection.

questions.text:
A user is having difficulty with video conferencing and is looking for assistance.
Which of the following would BEST improve performance?
questions.explanation: Quality of service prioritizes real-time traffic like video conferencing to reduce latency and jitter. Packet shaping controls bandwidth usage but doesn't prioritize traffic types the way QoS does.

questions.text:
A network technician is configuring a new firewall for a company with the necessary access requirements to be allowed through the firewall.
Which of the following would normally be applied as the LAST rule in the firewall?
questions.explanation: An implicit deny rule is placed last to block any traffic not explicitly permitted by prior rules. The other options are security features unrelated to firewall rule ordering.

questions.text:
A technician wants to install a WAP in the center of a room that provides service in a radius surrounding a radio.
Which of the following antenna types should the AP utilize?
questions.explanation: An omnidirectional antenna radiates signal equally in all directions, ideal for coverage in a radius around a centrally placed AP. Directional and Yagi antennas focus signal in one direction, unsuitable for radial coverage.

questions.text:
A systems administrator is running a VoIP network and is experiencing jitter and high latency.
Which of the following would BEST help the administrator determine the cause of these issues?
options: Configuring SNMP traps on the network
questions.explanation: SNMP traps allow proactive monitoring of network performance metrics like jitter and latency, helping pinpoint the cause of VoIP quality issues. RADIUS, LDAP, and NTP relate to authentication and time sync, not performance monitoring.

questions.text:
The following instructions were published about the proper network configuration for a videoconferencing device:

• Configure a valid static RFC1918 address for your network.
• Check the option to use a connection over NAT.

Which of the following is a valid IP address configuration for the device?
questions.explanation: 172.19.0.2 falls within the RFC1918 private address range (172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255), matching the required static private address behind NAT. The other addresses are link-local, CGN, or multicast, not valid RFC1918 addresses.

questions.text:
A network administrator is reviewing interface errors on a switch.
Which of the following indicates that a switchport is receiving packets in excess of the configured MTU?
questions.explanation: Giants are frames larger than the configured MTU, indicating oversized packets. Runts are undersized frames, and CRC errors indicate corruption, not size violations.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to implement an HDMI over IP solution.
Which of the following will the network administrator MOST likely use to ensure smooth video delivery?
questions.explanation: Jumbo frames reduce overhead and support the large data payloads required for smooth HDMI over IP video transmission. Link aggregation and port tagging address bandwidth and VLAN segmentation, not frame size for video streams.

questions.text:
A network administrator wants to reduce overhead and increase efficiency on a SAN.
Which of the following can be configured to achieve these goals?
questions.explanation: Jumbo frames increase payload size per frame, reducing overhead and improving efficiency for SAN traffic. Traffic shaping and flow control manage bandwidth and congestion but don't reduce per-frame overhead.

questions.text:
A rogue AP was found plugged in and providing Internet access to employees in the break room.
Which of the following would be BEST to use to stop this from happening without physically removing the WAP?
questions.explanation: Port security can disable the switchport the rogue AP is plugged into by restricting or shutting down unauthorized MAC addresses, without physically removing the device. Wireless client isolation only affects wireless clients on a legitimate network, not rogue APs.

questions.text:
A company's network is set up so all Internet-bound traffic from all remote offices exits through a main datacenter.
Which of the following network topologies would BEST describe this setup?
questions.explanation: A hub-and-spoke topology routes all remote office traffic through a central datacenter, matching the described setup. Mesh topology would instead have direct interconnections between all sites.

questions.text:
To comply with industry requirements, a security assessment on the cloud server should identify which protocols and weaknesses are being exposed to attackers on the Internet.
Which of the following tools is the MOST appropriate to complete the assessment?
options: Use tcpdump and parse the output file in a protocol analyzer.
Use an IP scanner and target the cloud WAN network addressing.
Run netstat in each cloud server and retrieve the running processes.
Use nmap and set the servers' public IPs as the targets.
questions.explanation: Nmap can scan public IP targets to identify open ports, running services, and protocol weaknesses exposed to the Internet. tcpdump and netstat require internal access to the server, not an external attacker's perspective.

questions.text:
A systems administrator is configuring a firewall using NAT with PAT.
Which of the following would be BEST suited for the LAN interface?
questions.explanation: 172.23.0.0/16 falls entirely within the RFC1918 private range of 172.16.0.0–172.31.255.255, making it valid for a NAT/PAT LAN interface. The /8 and /10 options extend outside the private block into public address space, and 172.15.0.0/18 is not part of the private range at all.

questions.text:
A packet is assigned a value to ensure it does not traverse a network indefinitely.
Which of the following BEST represents this value?
questions.explanation: Time to live (TTL) is decremented at each hop and causes the packet to be discarded once it reaches zero, preventing infinite loops. Zero Trust and caching are unrelated security/performance concepts.

questions.text: Which of the following policies should be referenced when a user wants to access work email on a personal cell phone?
questions.explanation: A BYOD policy governs the use of personally owned devices for accessing corporate resources like email. An acceptable use policy covers general usage rules, not device ownership specifics.

questions.text:
After a firewall replacement, some alarms and metrics related to network availability stopped updating on a monitoring system relying on SNMP.
Which of the following should the network administrator do FIRST?
options: Modify the device's MIB on the monitoring system.
Configure syslog to send events to the monitoring system.
Use port mirroring to redirect traffic to the monitoring system.
Deploy SMB to transfer data to the monitoring system.
questions.explanation: After replacing the firewall, the monitoring system's MIB likely doesn't recognize the new device's OIDs, so updating the MIB should be checked first. Syslog and SMB are unrelated to SNMP polling failures.

questions.text: At the destination host, which of the following OSI model layers will discard a segment with a bad checksum in the UDP header?
questions.explanation: UDP operates at the Transport layer, and checksum validation/discarding of malformed segments happens there. The Network layer handles IP addressing and routing, not UDP checksum validation.

questions.text:
A voice engineer is troubleshooting a phone issue. When a call is placed, the caller hears echoes of the receiver's voice.
Which of the following are the causes of this issue? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Echo and other voice-quality defects stem from timing/delay problems: jitter and missing or misconfigured QoS that fails to prioritize RTP traffic. Speed or protocol mismatches would break the link or prevent the call entirely rather than produce echo.

questions.text: Which of the following VPN configurations should be used to separate Internet and corporate traffic?
questions.explanation: Split-tunnel VPN routes only corporate traffic through the VPN while Internet traffic goes directly out, separating the two. Site-to-site VPNs connect entire networks, not user Internet/corporate traffic separation.

questions.text: Which of the following is required when connecting an endpoint device with an RJ45 port to a network device with an ST port?
questions.explanation: A media converter is needed to bridge the electrical RJ45 (copper) connection to the optical ST (fiber) connection. A bridge or load balancer does not perform physical media conversion.

questions.text:
The management team has instituted a 48-hour RTO as part of the disaster recovery plan.
Which of the following procedures would meet the policy's requirements?
options: Recover all systems to a loss of 48 hours of data.
Limit network downtime to a maximum of 48 hours per year.
Require 48 hours of system backup maintenance.
questions.explanation: Recovery Time Objective (RTO) defines the maximum acceptable time to restore systems after a disruption, so recovering all systems within 48 hours meets this policy. Recovery Point Objective (RPO), not RTO, relates to acceptable data loss.

questions.text: Which of the following cable types would MOST likely be used to provide high-speed network connectivity between nearby buildings?
questions.explanation: Fiber optic cable supports high-speed, long-distance connectivity between buildings without the distance limitations or EMI susceptibility of copper cabling like UTP or Cat 5.

questions.text: Which of the following is the physical security mechanism that would MOST likely be used to enter a secure site?
questions.explanation: An access control vestibule (mantrap) is a physical security mechanism that controls entry into a secure site by allowing only one person through at a time. A firewall is a network security device, not physical.

questions.text: Which of the following BEST describes a North-South traffic flow?
options: A public Internet user accessing a published web server
A database server communicating with another clustered database server
A Layer 3 switch advertising routes to a router
A management application connecting to managed devices
questions.explanation: North-South traffic refers to data flowing between an external network (like the Internet) and the internal datacenter, such as a public user accessing a web server. Server-to-server traffic within the datacenter is East-West traffic.

questions.text:
A network switch was installed to provide connectivity to cameras monitoring wildlife in a remote location. The organization is concerned that intruders could potentially leverage unattended equipment in the remote location to connect rogue devices and gain access to the organization's resources.
Which of the following techniques would BEST address the concern?
options: Configure port security using MAC filtering.
Manually register the cameras on the switch address table.
Activate PoE+ on the active switchports.
Disable Neighbor Discovery Protocol on the switch.
questions.explanation: Port security with MAC filtering restricts which devices can connect to the switchport, preventing rogue devices from gaining network access. Manually registering cameras on the address table doesn't prevent rogue device connections to the same port.

questions.text:
A technician is documenting an application that is installed on a server and needs to verify all existing web and database connections to the server.
Which of the following tools should the technician use to accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: Netstat displays active network connections, including established web and database sessions on the server. Tracert and nslookup are used for path tracing and DNS lookups, not connection listing.

questions.text: A technician is assisting a user who cannot access network resources when the workstation is connected to a VoIP phone. The technician identifies the phone as faulty and replaces it. According to troubleshooting methodology, which of the following should the technician do NEXT?
questions.explanation: After implementing the solution (replacing the phone), the technician should verify full system functionality to confirm the fix resolved the issue. Documenting findings comes only after verification is complete.

questions.text: Which of the following OSI model layers contains IP headers?
questions.explanation: IP headers are added at the Network layer (Layer 3) of the OSI model, which handles logical addressing and routing. The Transport layer handles TCP/UDP headers, not IP headers.

questions.text:
A small office is running WiFi 4 APs, and neighboring offices do not want to increase the throughput to associated devices.
Which of the following is the MOST cost-efficient way for the office to increase network performance?
questions.explanation: Enabling channel bonding increases throughput on existing WiFi 4 APs without adding new equipment or upgrading hardware, making it the most cost-efficient option. Upgrading to WiFi 5 or adding APs involves additional cost.

questions.text: A network technician is troubleshooting an application issue. The technician is able to recreate the issue in a virtual environment. According to the troubleshooting methodology, which of the following actions will the technician most likely perform NEXT?
options: Gather information from the initial report.
Escalate the issue to a supervisor.
Implement a solution to resolve the issue.
Establish a theory of probable cause.
questions.explanation: After successfully duplicating the issue, the next step in troubleshooting methodology is to establish a theory of probable cause. Escalating or implementing a solution comes later in the process.

questions.text: Which of the following types of datacenter architectures will MOST likely be used in a large SDN and can be extended beyond the datacenter?
questions.explanation: Spine and leaf architecture provides the scalability and low-latency east-west traffic handling needed for large SDN environments and can extend beyond a single datacenter. Three-tiered networks are traditional and less suited for SDN scalability.

questions.text:

Which of the following is MOST likely the cause of the issue?
questions.explanation: The client sits on channel 6 while strong neighbors occupy channels 4, 7 and 8, whose 20 MHz spectrum overlaps channel 6; that raises the noise floor to -63 dBm, leaving only 16 dB SNR and a 41% retry rate. Poor signal is not the cause because RSSI is a strong -47 dBm.

questions.text:
A network technician reviews an entry on the syslog server and discovers the following message from a switch:
Which of the following describes the issue?
options: A loop was discovered, and the impact was mitigated.
An incorrectly pinned cable was disconnected.
The link-local address on the port is incorrect.
The port was shut down, and it needs to be reactivated.
questions.explanation: A spanning-tree blocked port indicates STP detected a potential loop and placed the port in a blocking state to prevent it, mitigating the impact rather than requiring reactivation or indicating a physical cable issue.
questions.exhibit: SPANNING-TREE Port 1/1 BLOCKED

questions.text:
A company just migrated its email service to a cloud solution. After the migration, two-thirds of the internal users were able to connect to their mailboxes, but the connection fails for the other one-third of internal users. Users working externally are not reporting any issues. The network administrator identifies the following output collected from an internal host: c:\user> nslookup newmail.company.comNon-Authoritative answer:
Name: newmail.company.com -IPs: 3.219.13.186, 64.58.225.184, 184.168.131.243
Which of the following verification tasks should the network administrator perform NEXT?
options: Check the firewall ACL to verify all required IP addresses are included.
Verify the required router PAT rules are properly configured.
Confirm the internal DNS server is replying to requests for the cloud solution.
Validate the cloud console to determine whether there are unlicensed requests.
questions.explanation: Name resolution succeeds and returns three cloud IP addresses, but only some of them respond from inside, which matches roughly one-third of clients failing as they round-robin to a blocked address; the next step is checking the firewall ACL for all required IPs. Confirming internal DNS is pointless because DNS already answered correctly.

questions.text:
A network technician was hired to harden the security of a network. The technician is required to enable encryption and create a password for AP security through the web browser.
Which of the following would BEST support these requirements?
questions.explanation: WPA2 provides encryption and password-based security configurable through an AP's web interface, whereas ESP and IPSec are used for VPN tunnels and ACLs control traffic filtering, not wireless encryption.

questions.text: Which of the following ports are associated with IMAP? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: IMAP uses port 143 unencrypted and port 993 for IMAP over SSL/TLS; port 110 is POP3, port 25 is SMTP, and port 587 is SMTP submission.

questions.text:
A network administrator is trying to identify a device that is having issues connecting to a switchport.
Which of the following would BEST help identify the issue?
questions.explanation: A syslog server aggregates real-time device logs, including port status and error messages, making it the best tool to identify connectivity issues on a switchport, unlike change management records or rack diagrams which don't show live status.

questions.text:
A company with multiple routers would like to implement an HA network gateway with the least amount of downtime possible. This solution should not require changes on the gateway setting of the network clients.
Which of the following should a technician configure?
options: Automate a continuous backup and restore process of the system's state of the active gateway.
Use a static assignment of the gateway IP address on the network clients.
Configure DHCP relay and allow clients to receive a new IP setting.
Configure a shared VIP and deploy VRRP on the routers.
questions.explanation: VRRP with a shared virtual IP provides gateway redundancy without requiring client-side gateway changes, achieving high availability with minimal downtime, unlike DHCP relay or static reconfiguration which require client changes.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols would allow a secure connection to a Linux-based system?
questions.explanation: SSH provides encrypted remote command-line access commonly used to securely manage Linux systems, while RDP is used for Windows GUI access and SMB/FTP are not secure remote access protocols.

questions.text:
A network administrator is troubleshooting the communication between two Layer 2 switches that are reporting a very high runt count. After trying multiple ports on both switches, the issue persists.
Which of the following should the network administrator perform to resolve the issue?
options: Increase the MTU size on both switches.
Recertify the cable between both switches.
Perform a factory reset on both switches.
Enable debug logging on both switches.
questions.explanation: High runt counts persisting across multiple ports point to a physical layer issue like a faulty or out-of-spec cable, so recertifying the cable is the appropriate troubleshooting step rather than adjusting MTU or resetting switches.

questions.text:
Users attending security training at work are advised not to use single words as passwords for corporate applications.
Which of the following does this BEST protect against?
questions.explanation: Dictionary attacks use lists of common words to guess passwords, so avoiding single-word passwords directly mitigates this threat, unlike brute-force attacks which try all possible combinations regardless of word usage.

questions.text:
A network administrator would like to enable NetFlow on a Layer 3 switch but is concerned about how the feature may impact the switch.
Which of the following metrics should the administrator graph using SNMP to BEST measure the feature's impact?
questions.explanation: NetFlow processing consumes switch CPU resources, so monitoring CPU usage via SNMP best measures the performance impact of enabling this feature, rather than temperature or bandwidth which are less directly affected.

questions.text: Which of the following would be used to enforce and schedule critical updates with supervisory approval and include backup plans in case of failure?
questions.explanation: Change management processes formally schedule, approve, and document updates including rollback/backout plans, unlike a business continuity plan which addresses disaster recovery rather than routine update scheduling.

questions.text:
A newly installed VoIP phone is not getting the DHCP IP address it needs to connect to the phone system.
Which of the following tasks need to be completed to allow the phone to operate correctly?
options: Assign the phone's switchport to the correct VLAN
Statically assign the phone's gateway address
Configure a route on the VoIP network router
questions.explanation: VoIP phones typically require a dedicated voice VLAN to receive proper DHCP scope and options for phone system connectivity, so assigning the switchport to the correct VLAN is necessary rather than static addressing or gateway routes.

questions.text:
Users are reporting intermittent WiFi connectivity in specific parts of a building.
Which of the following should the network administrator check FIRST when troubleshooting this issue? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Intermittent coverage issues in specific areas are commonly caused by poor AP placement or coverage gaps, which a site survey and reviewing AP placement would identify first, rather than SSID or captive portal configuration.

questions.text:
A technician is setting up a new router, configuring ports, and allowing access to the Internet. However, none of the users connected to this new router are able to connect to the Internet.
Which of the following does the technician need to configure?
questions.explanation: Without NAT, internal private IP addresses cannot be translated to a public routable address for Internet access, so configuring NAT is required, whereas tunneling and multicast routing are unrelated to basic Internet connectivity.

questions.text:
A network administrator is testing performance improvements by configuring channel bonding on an 802.11ac AP. Although a site survey detected the majority of the 5GHz frequency spectrum was idle, being used only by the company's WLAN and a nearby government radio system, the AP is not allowing the administrator to manually configure a large portion of the 5GHz frequency range.
Which of the following would be BEST to configure for the WLAN being tested?
options: Upgrade the equipment to an AP that supports manual configuration of the EIRP power settings
Switch to 802.11n, disable channel auto-selection, and enforce channel bonding on the configuration
Set up the AP to perform a dynamic selection of the frequency according to regulatory requirements
Deactivate the band 5GHz to avoid interference with the government radio
questions.explanation: Dynamic Frequency Selection (DFS) allows the AP to automatically avoid channels used by radar/government systems while still using the wider 5GHz spectrum, satisfying regulatory requirements without manually restricting bonding.

questions.text: Which of the following options represents the participating computers in a network?
questions.explanation: Nodes refer to any participating device connected to a network, encompassing computers, printers, and other endpoints, whereas servers and clients are specific subtypes of nodes.

questions.text:
An administrator is working with the local ISP to troubleshoot an issue.
Which of the following should the ISP use to define the furthest point on the network that the administrator is responsible for troubleshooting?
questions.explanation: The demarcation point marks the boundary between the ISP's responsibility and the customer's network, defining the furthest point the administrator troubleshoots, unlike a CSU/DSU which is equipment rather than a boundary definition.

questions.text:
To access production applications and data, developers must first connect remotely to a different server. From there, the developers are able to access production data.
Which of the following does this BEST represent?
questions.explanation: A jump box is a hardened intermediary server developers connect to first before accessing production systems, providing controlled access, unlike a proxy server which relays traffic without this security gatekeeping function.

questions.text: Which of the following is conducted frequently to maintain an updated list of a system's weaknesses?
questions.explanation: Vulnerability scans are run frequently and automatically to maintain an updated list of known weaknesses, whereas penetration tests and risk assessments are performed less often and involve deeper manual analysis.

questions.text:
A systems administrator wants to use the least amount of equipment to segment two departments that have cables terminating in the same room.
Which of the following would allow this to occur?
questions.explanation: A Layer 3 switch can segment departments into separate VLANs/subnets using a single device, minimizing equipment, whereas a hub provides no segmentation and a load balancer or proxy server serve different purposes.

questions.text:
An administrator needs to connect two laptops directly to each other using 802. 11ac but does not have an AP available.
Which of the following describes this configuration?
questions.explanation: Two devices connecting directly without an AP form an independent basic service set (ad hoc network). A basic service set requires an AP, and MU-MIMO is a technology feature, not a topology type.

questions.text:
A network administrator is installing a new server in the datacenter. The administrator is concerned the amount of traffic generated will exceed 1GB, and higher- throughput NICs are not available for installation.
Which of the following is the BEST solution for this issue?
options: Install an additional NIC and configure LACP
Remove some of the applications from the server
Configure the NIC to use full duplex
Configure port mirroring to send traffic to another server
Install a SSD to decrease data processing time
questions.explanation: Installing an additional NIC and configuring LACP allows link aggregation to increase overall throughput beyond 1Gb without needing higher-throughput NICs. Full duplex only doubles theoretical throughput in one direction, not aggregate bandwidth.

questions.text:
A malicious user is using special software to perform an on-path attack.
Which of the following best practices should be configured to mitigate this threat?
questions.explanation: Dynamic ARP inspection prevents ARP spoofing, which is commonly used to execute on-path (man-in-the-middle) attacks. MAC filtering and role-based access do not address ARP poisoning.

questions.text: Which of the following can be used to store various types of devices and provide contactless delivery to users?
questions.explanation: Smart lockers provide secure, contactless storage and delivery of devices to users. Access control vestibules control physical entry to a facility, not device storage.

questions.text:
A technician recently set up a small office network for nine users. When the installation was complete, all the computers on the network showed addresses ranging from 169.254.0.0 to 169.254.255.255.
Which of the following types of address ranges does this represent?
questions.explanation: The 169.254.0.0/16 range is Automatic Private IP Addressing (APIPA), assigned when a DHCP server is unreachable. It is not part of the private RFC1918 ranges.

questions.text: Which of the following OSI model layers is where a technician would view UDP information?
questions.explanation: UDP is a transport layer protocol, so its information is viewed at the Transport layer of the OSI model, alongside TCP.

questions.text:
A network technician at a university is assisting with the planning of a simultaneous software deployment to multiple computers in one classroom in a building.
Which of the following would be BEST to use?
questions.explanation: Multicast delivers data efficiently to a specific group of devices simultaneously, ideal for deploying software to multiple computers in one room. Broadcast would send to all devices unnecessarily, wasting bandwidth.

questions.text: Which of the following describes the BEST device to configure as a DHCP relay?
questions.explanation: A router is the best device to configure as a DHCP relay since it forwards DHCP broadcasts between subnets, which Layer 2 switches and hubs cannot do.

questions.text: Which of the following compromises Internet-connected devices and makes them vulnerable to becoming part of a botnet? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Malware infection and use of default credentials are common ways attackers compromise IoT devices to recruit them into botnets. Deauthentication attacks and IP spoofing are attack techniques, not compromise vectors that recruit devices.

questions.text:
A network administrator is planning a WLAN for a soccer stadium and was advised to use MU-MIMO to improve connection performance in high-density areas. The project requires compatibility with clients connecting using 2.4GHz or 5GHz frequencies.
Which of the following would be the BEST wireless standard for this project?
questions.explanation: 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) supports MU-MIMO on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands, making it ideal for high-density stadium deployments. 802.11ac only operates on 5GHz.

questions.text: An organization purchased an allocation of public IPv4 addresses. Instead of receiving the network address and subnet mask, the purchase paperwork indicates the allocation is a /28. This type of notation is referred to as:
questions.explanation: The /28 notation is Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) notation, which specifies the prefix length instead of a traditional subnet mask.

questions.text:
A network technician is reviewing a document that specifies how to handle access to company resources, such as the Internet and printers, when devices are not part of the company's assets.
Which of the following agreements would a user be required to accept before using the company's resources?
questions.explanation: An Acceptable Use Policy (AUP) governs how users may access company resources like internet and printers. BYOD policies specifically address personal device usage, not general resource access rules.

questions.text:
A network administrator is trying to add network redundancy for the server farm.
Which of the following can the network administrator configure to BEST provide this capability?
questions.explanation: VRRP (Virtual Router Redundancy Protocol) provides gateway redundancy for the server farm's network path. DNS and UPS address name resolution and power, not network path redundancy.

questions.text:
A network administrator is adding a new switch to the network.
Which of the following network hardening techniques would be BEST to use once the switch is in production?
questions.explanation: Disabling unneeded ports reduces the attack surface on a new switch, a standard network hardening practice. Disabling SSH, MAC filtering, or port security would weaken security rather than harden the device.

questions.text:
A network administrator is troubleshooting an issue with a new Internet connection. The ISP is asking detailed questions about the configuration of the router that the network administrator is troubleshooting.
Which of the following commands is the network administrator using? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Show config and show route display the router's configuration and routing table details, which the ISP would need to troubleshoot the connection. Tcpdump and netstat show traffic/connections, not router configuration details.

questions.text: Which of the following is the MOST appropriate use case for the deployment of a clientless VPN?
options: Secure web access to internal corporate resources.
Upgrade security via the use of an NFV technology.
Connect two datacenters across the Internet.
Increase VPN availability by using a SDWAN technology.
questions.explanation: A clientless VPN uses a web browser to provide secure access to internal corporate resources without installing client software. It is not designed for site-to-site connections between datacenters.

questions.text: Which of the following security controls indicates unauthorized hardware modifications?
questions.explanation: Tamper-evident seals reveal if hardware has been physically opened or altered without authorization. Biometric authentication and change management policy address access and process control, not physical tampering detection.

questions.text:
A network technician needs to install security updates on several switches on the company's network. The management team wants this completed as quickly and efficiently as possible.
Which of the following should the technician do to perform the updates?
options: Upload the security update onto each switch using a terminal emulator and a console cable.
Configure a TFTP server, SSH into each device, and perform the update.
Replace each old switch with new switches that have the updates already performed.
Connect a USB memory stick to each switch and perform the update.
questions.explanation: Configuring a TFTP server and using SSH allows remote, scripted, efficient updates to multiple switches without physical access. Console cable or USB methods require physically visiting each device, which is slower.

questions.text: Which of the following describes traffic going in and out of a data center from the internet?
questions.explanation: North-South traffic describes data flowing between the data center and external networks like the internet, as opposed to East-West traffic between devices within the data center.

questions.text:
A technician is troubleshooting a connectivity issue with an end user. The end user can access local network shares and intranet pages but is unable to access the internet or remote resources.
Which of the following needs to be reconfigured?
questions.explanation: Access to local resources works but internet/remote access fails, indicating the default gateway address is misconfigured, since traffic destined off-subnet cannot be routed. An incorrect subnet mask would typically also break local network access.

questions.text:
An IT administrator received an assignment with the following objectives:

• Conduct a total scan within the company's network for all connected hosts.
• Detect all the types of operating systems running on all devices.
• Discover all services offered by hosts on the network.
• Find open ports and detect security risks.

Which of the following command-line tools can be used to achieve these objectives?
questions.explanation: Nmap performs network scanning, OS fingerprinting, service discovery, and port scanning for security assessment. Tools like netstat, arp, and tcpdump don't provide full network-wide host and service discovery.

questions.text:
A network manager is configuring switches in IDFs to ensure unauthorized client computers are not connecting to a secure wired network.
Which of the following is the network manager MOST likely performing?
options: Writing ACLs to prevent access to the switch
questions.explanation: Disabling unused switchports prevents unauthorized devices from physically connecting to the network. DHCP snooping and ACLs address different threats, not simple physical connection prevention.

questions.text: At which of the following OSI model layers does routing occur?
questions.explanation: Routing decisions based on IP addresses occur at the Network layer (Layer 3). Data link layer handles switching based on MAC addresses, not routing.

questions.text:
An auditor assessing network best practices was able to connect a rogue switch into a network jack and get network connectivity.
Which of the following controls would BEST address this risk?
options: Activate port security on the switchports providing end user access.
Deactivate Spanning Tree Protocol on network interfaces that are facing public areas.
Disable Neighbor Resolution Protocol in the Layer 2 devices.
Ensure port tagging is in place for network interfaces in guest areas.
questions.explanation: Port security restricts which MAC addresses can connect to a switchport, preventing rogue devices like an unauthorized switch from gaining network access. Disabling STP would actually increase risk of loops, not address unauthorized access.

questions.text:
A technician knows the MAC address of a device and is attempting to find the device's IP address.
Which of the following should the technician look at to find theIP address? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The ARP table maps known MAC addresses to IP addresses on the local segment, and DHCP lease records show which IP was assigned to a given MAC address. The MAC address table only maps MACs to switchports, not IP addresses.

questions.text:
A user in a branch office reports that access to all files has been lost after receiving a new PC. All other users in the branch can access fileshares. The IT engineer who is troubleshooting this incident is able to ping the workstation from the branch router, but the machine cannot, ping the router.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause of the incident?
questions.explanation: Since the router can ping the workstation but the workstation cannot ping back, an incorrect subnet mask likely causes the PC to believe the router is off-subnet, preventing it from routing traffic properly. DNS issues wouldn't block basic ICMP connectivity.

questions.text:
A network administrator would like to purchase a device that provides access ports to endpoints and has the ability to route between networks.
Which of the following would be BEST for the administrator to purchase?
questions.explanation: A Layer 3 switch provides multiple access ports for endpoints while also supporting inter-VLAN routing. A standalone router lacks the multiple switched access ports needed.

questions.text:
A false camera is installed outside a building to assist with physical security.
Which of the following is the device assisting?
questions.explanation: A visible (even fake) camera acts as a deterrent, assisting in prevention by discouraging intrusion attempts. It does not actually detect or identify anything since it's not functional.

questions.text: Which of the following types of attacks can be used to gain credentials by setting up rogue APs with identical corporate SSIDs?
questions.explanation: An evil twin attack involves setting up a rogue access point mimicking a legitimate SSID to trick users into connecting and revealing credentials. VLAN hopping and DNS poisoning don't involve fake wireless access points.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols is widely used in large-scale enterprise networks to support complex networks with multiple routers and balance traffic load on multiple links?
questions.explanation: OSPF is a link-state routing protocol designed for large, complex enterprise networks and supports load balancing across multiple equal-cost paths. RIPv2 is a simpler distance-vector protocol unsuitable for large-scale networks.

questions.text:
A network engineer is investigating reports of poor network performance. Upon reviewing a report, the engineer finds hundreds of CRC errors on an interface.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of these errors?
options: A bad wire on the Cat 5e cable
The wrong VLAN assignment to the switchport
A misconfigured QoS setting on the router
Both sides of the switch trunk set to full duplex
questions.explanation: CRC errors typically indicate physical layer issues like a damaged or faulty cable causing frame corruption. VLAN misconfiguration or QoS settings would not generate CRC errors.

questions.text: Which of the following is considered a physical security detection device?
questions.explanation: Cameras are detection devices that monitor and record activity for later review. Biometric readers and access control vestibules are prevention controls, not detection.

questions.text:
A network is experiencing extreme latency when accessing a particular website.
Which of the following commands will BEST help identify the issue?
questions.explanation: Tracert shows the path packets take and the latency at each hop, helping pinpoint where delay occurs. Ping only shows overall round-trip time without hop-by-hop detail.

questions.text:
A technician needs to configure a routing protocol for an internet-facing edge router.
Which of the following routing protocols will the technician MOST likely use?
questions.explanation: BGP is the routing protocol used for internet-facing edge routers to exchange routes between autonomous systems. OSPF and EIGRP are interior gateway protocols used within a single organization's network.

questions.text:
A technician is monitoring a network interface and notices the device is dropping packets. The cable and interfaces, however, are in working order.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause?
questions.explanation: High CPU usage on a network device can cause it to drop packets even when cabling and interfaces are functioning correctly. OID duplication and MIB mismatches relate to SNMP monitoring issues, not packet drops.

questions.text:
A technician installed an 8-port switch in a user's office. The user needs to add a second computer in the office, so the technician connects both PCs to the switch and connects the switch to the wall jack. However, the new PC cannot connect to network resources. The technician then observes the following:

• The new computer does not get an IP address on the client's VLAN.
• Both computers have a link light on their NICs.
• The new PC appears to be operating normally except for the network issue.
• The existing computer operates normally.

Which of the following should the technician do NEXT to address the situation?
options: Contact the network team to resolve the port security issue.
Contact the server team to have a record created in DNS for the new PC.
Contact the security team to review the logs on the company's SIEM.
Contact the application team to check NetFlow data from the connected switch.
questions.explanation: Since the new PC fails to get an IP address on the correct VLAN despite a working link light, port security violation on the switch (limiting MAC addresses per port) is the likely cause, requiring the network team to resolve it. DNS and NetFlow issues wouldn't prevent DHCP assignment.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to provide remote clients with access to an internal web application.
Which of the following methods provides the HIGHEST flexibility and compatibility while encrypting only the connection to the web application?
questions.explanation: A clientless VPN uses a web browser (via TLS) to secure access to a specific internal web application without requiring installed client software, offering high compatibility. Virtual desktops and VNC encrypt entire sessions, not just the web app connection.

questions.text:
A network engineer receives the following when connecting to a switch to configure a port:
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause for the failure?
options: The network engineer is using the wrong protocol.
The network engineer does not have permission to configure the device.
SNMP has been secured with an ACL.
The switchport the engineer is trying to configure is down.
questions.explanation: A failed connection on port 23 (Telnet) suggests Telnet is disabled or blocked, and the engineer should be using SSH (port 22) instead, indicating the wrong protocol was used. If the switchport itself were down, the engineer likely couldn't reach the management IP at all.
questions.exhibit:
telnet 10.1.200.1
Connecting to 10.1.200.1..
Could not open connection to the host, on port 23: Connect failed.

questions.text:
A network attack caused a network outage by wiping the configuration and logs of the border firewall.
Which of the following sources, in an investigation to determine how the firewall was compromised, can provide the MOST detailed data?
questions.explanation: Syslog messages sent to an external server preserve detailed event logs even if the firewall's local logs are wiped, providing the most detailed forensic data. NetFlow and baseline reports lack the granular event-level detail needed to trace the compromise.

questions.text:
A network engineer needs to reduce the overhead of file transfers.
Which of the following configuration changes would accomplish that goal?
questions.explanation: Jumbo frames increase the payload size per frame, reducing the number of frames and associated header overhead needed for large file transfers. Link aggregation increases bandwidth but doesn't reduce per-frame overhead.

questions.text: Which of the following devices have the capability to allow communication between two different subnetworks? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Routers and Layer 3 switches both perform inter-VLAN/inter-subnet routing based on IP addresses. Layer 2 switches and access points only forward traffic within the same broadcast domain/subnet.

questions.text:
A network technician is implementing a solution that will allow end users to gain access to multiple applications after logging on.
Which of the following authentication methods would allow this type of access?
questions.explanation: Single sign-on (SSO) lets a user authenticate once and gain access to multiple applications without re-entering credentials. LDAP is a directory access protocol, not an authentication access model for multiple apps.

questions.text:
An administrator is attempting to add a new system to monitoring but is unsuccessful. The administrator notices the system is similar to another one on the network; however, the new one has an updated OS version.
Which of the following should the administrator consider updating?
questions.explanation: Management information bases (MIBs) define the objects SNMP can monitor, and they need updating to reflect new OS versions with different monitorable parameters. A system baseline concerns performance metrics, not device compatibility with monitoring software.

questions.text:
A network technician receives a report about a performance issue on a client PC that is connected to port 1/3 on a network switch. The technician observes the following configuration output from the switch:
Which of the following is a cause of the issue on port 1/3?
questions.explanation: Port 1/3 is negotiating at only 10 Mbps (a-10) while the other ports run at 1000 Mbps, and there are no errors, collisions, or duplex mismatches shown, so the mismatched/low speed negotiation is the performance cause. Duplex is full on all ports, ruling out a duplex mismatch.
