questions.text: Which of the following would be used when connecting devices that have different physical characteristics?
questions.explanation: A media converter allows connectivity between devices with different physical media types, such as fiber to copper. Load balancers and proxy servers operate at higher layers and don't address physical media incompatibility.

questions.text:
A Fortune 500 firm is deciding on the kind of data center equipment to install given its five-year budget outlook. The Chief Information Officer is comparing equipment based on the life expectancy of different models.
Which of the following concepts BEST represents this metric?
questions.explanation: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) estimates the expected lifespan/reliability of equipment, which fits comparing life expectancy of different models. MTTR measures repair time, not lifespan.

questions.text:
A network administrator installed an additional IDF during a building expansion project.
Which of the following documents need to be updated to reflect the change? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Adding a new IDF changes the physical layout of network infrastructure, requiring the physical network diagram to be updated, and it also affects failover/recovery procedures documented in the disaster recovery plan. Policies like BYOD or acceptable use are unrelated to physical infrastructure changes.

questions.text: Which of the following BEST describes hosting several businesses on the same physical infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Multitenancy describes multiple separate customers/businesses sharing the same physical infrastructure while remaining logically isolated. IaaS refers to a cloud service model, not the sharing concept itself.

questions.text:
A company streams video to multiple devices across a campus. When this happens, several users report a degradation of network performance.
Which of the following would MOST likely address this issue?
options: Enable IGMP snooping on the switches.
Reconfigure port tagging for the video traffic.
Change the SSID of the APs.
questions.explanation: Enabling IGMP snooping prevents multicast video streams from being flooded to all switch ports, reducing unnecessary bandwidth consumption and performance degradation. Changing the SSID wouldn't affect multicast traffic distribution.

questions.text:
The power company notifies a network administrator that it will be turning off the power to the building over the weekend.
Which of the following is the BEST solution to prevent the servers from going down?
questions.explanation: A generator provides sustained power for an extended outage like a planned weekend shutdown, whereas a UPS only offers short-term battery backup. Redundant power supplies protect against PSU failure, not utility outages.

questions.text:
A technician is trying to determine whether an LACP bundle is fully operational.
Which of the following commands will the technician MOST likely use?
questions.explanation: The show interface command displays the status of bundled interfaces, including LACP port states, confirming if the link aggregation bundle is operational. Show route and show arp don't provide interface/LACP status.

questions.text:
A network administrator wants to check all network connections and see the output in integer form.
Which of the following commands should the administrator run on the command line?
questions.explanation: The netstat -n switch displays addresses and port numbers in numerical (integer) form rather than resolving them to names. netstat -e shows Ethernet statistics, not numerical addressing.

questions.text: Which of the following connectors and terminations are required to make a Cat 6 cable that connects from a PC to a non-capable MDIX switch? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Connecting a PC to a non-MDIX-capable switch requires a crossover cable, wired TIA-568-A on one end and TIA-568-B on the other, using RJ45 connectors for Cat 6 Ethernet. RJ11 and F-type connectors are used for telephone and coax connections, not Ethernet.

questions.text:
A technician is configuring a wireless network and needs to ensure users agree to an AUP before connecting.
Which of the following should be implemented to achieve this goal?
questions.explanation: A captive portal presents a webpage requiring users to accept an Acceptable Use Policy before granting network access. Geofencing and client isolation don't handle policy acknowledgment.

questions.text:
A network technician needs to determine the IPv6 address of a malicious website.
Which of the following record types would provide this information?
questions.explanation: AAAA records map hostnames to IPv6 addresses, unlike A records which map to IPv4 addresses. CNAME and PTR records serve different purposes (aliasing and reverse lookup).

questions.text:
A technician is troubleshooting a report about network connectivity issues on a workstation. Upon investigation, the technician notes the workstation is showing an APIPA address on the network interface. The technician verifies that the VLAN assignment is correct and that the network interface has connectivity.
Which of the following is MOST likely the issue the workstation is experiencing?
questions.explanation: Link and VLAN are confirmed good, so the client reached the segment but got no lease and fell back to APIPA \u2014 the classic symptom of an exhausted DHCP scope. A rogue DHCP server would hand out an address (wrong subnet/gateway), not leave the host self-assigned.

questions.text:
A network technician has determined the cause of a network disruption.
Which of the following is the NEXT step for the technician to perform?
options: Validate the findings in a top-to-bottom approach.
Establish a plan of action to resolve the issue.
questions.explanation: After identifying the cause, the next step in the troubleshooting methodology is to establish a plan of action to resolve the issue. Documenting findings occurs at the end, after resolution and verification.

questions.text: Which of the following types of connections would need to be set up to provide access from the internal network to an external network so multiple satellite offices can communicate securely using various ports and protocols?
questions.explanation: A site-to-site VPN creates a persistent secure tunnel between networks, allowing multiple satellite offices to communicate using various ports and protocols. Client-to-site VPN is for individual remote users, not office-to-office connectivity.

questions.text:
A corporate client is experiencing global system outages. The IT team has identified multiple potential underlying causes throughout the enterprise. Each team member has been assigned an area to troubleshoot.
Which of the following approaches is being used?
questions.explanation: Divide-and-conquer troubleshooting assigns different segments or areas to different people to isolate multiple potential causes simultaneously, matching the scenario of team members each covering an area. Top-to-bottom and bottom-to-top are systematic single-path approaches, not team-divided assignments.

questions.text: Which of the following use cases would justify the deployment of an mGRE hub-and-spoke topology?
options: An increase in network security using encryption and packet encapsulation
A network expansion caused by an increase in the number of branch locations to the headquarters
A mandatory requirement to increase the deployment of an SDWAN network
An improvement in network efficiency by increasing the useful packet payload
questions.explanation: mGRE hub-and-spoke topology (as used in DMVPN) is well suited to scaling networks as branch locations increase, allowing dynamic spoke-to-spoke tunnels from a central hub. It is not primarily about encryption or payload efficiency, which are separate features.

questions.text: Which of the following needs to be tested to achieve a Cat 6a certification for a company's data cabling?
questions.explanation: Cat 6a certification requires testing the entire permanent link, including patch panels, for parameters like insertion loss and crosstalk. RJ11 and F-type connectors relate to telephone and coax cabling, not twisted-pair Ethernet certification.

questions.text: A network technician is responding to an issue with a local company. To which of the following documents should the network technician refer to determine the scope of the issue?
questions.explanation: A Service Level Agreement defines the scope of service and expected support parameters, helping determine issue scope. An MOU is a general agreement of intent, not a detailed scope document.

questions.text:
A company wants to set up a backup data center that can become active during a disaster. The site needs to contain network equipment and connectivity.
Which of the following strategies should the company employ?
questions.explanation: A warm site has some equipment and connectivity pre-installed and can be activated relatively quickly during a disaster, unlike a cold site which lacks equipment. A hot/active-active site would be fully operational already, which exceeds the stated requirement.

questions.text: Which of the following would be used to forward requests and replies between a DHCP server and client?
questions.explanation: A DHCP relay agent forwards DHCP requests and replies between clients and servers on different subnets. Lease, scope, and range are DHCP configuration terms, not forwarding mechanisms.

questions.text:
Network connectivity in an extensive forest reserve was achieved using fiber optics. A network fault was detected, and now the repair team needs to check the integrity of the fiber cable.
Which of the following actions can reduce repair time?
options: Using a tone generator and wire map to determine the fault location
Using a multimeter to locate the fault point
Using an OTDR in one end of the optic cable to get the fiber length information
Using a spectrum analyzer and comparing the current wavelength with a working baseline
questions.explanation: An OTDR sent from one end can pinpoint the fault distance along the fiber, quickly narrowing down the repair location. A multimeter and tone generator are used for copper cabling, not fiber optics.

questions.text:
A small office has a wireless network with several access points that are used by mobile devices. Users occasionally report that the wireless connection drops or becomes very slow. Reports confirm that this only happens when the devices are connected to the office wireless network.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause?
options: The configuration of the encryption protocol
questions.explanation: Interference from other wireless devices (e.g., microwaves, cordless phones) causes intermittent drops and slowdowns specific to wireless connections. Insufficient bandwidth would cause consistent slowness rather than drops tied to wireless use specifically.

questions.text: Which of the following is a benefit of the spine-and-leaf network topology?
questions.explanation: Spine-and-leaf topology provides predictable, consistent latency because every leaf switch is exactly two hops from any other leaf through the spine. It does not eliminate inter-VLAN routing or inherently simplify management more than other benefits.

questions.text:
A technician performed a manual reconfiguration of a firewall, and network connectivity was reestablished. Some connection events that were previously sent to a syslog server are no longer being generated by the firewall.
Which of the following should the technician perform to fix the issue?
options: Adjust the proper logging level on the new firewall.
Tune the filter for logging the severity level on the syslog server.
Activate NetFlow traffic between the syslog server and the firewall.
Restart the SNMP service running on the syslog server.
questions.explanation: After reconfiguration, the firewall's logging level likely reverted to a lower severity, so it needs to be set to log connection events again. The syslog server's filter setting wasn't changed, since the firewall itself stopped generating the logs.

questions.text:
A company rents out a large event space and includes wireless internet access for each tenant. Tenants reserve a two-hour window from the company each week, which includes a tenant-specific SSID. However, all users share the company's network hardware. The network support team is receiving complaints from tenants that some users are unable to connect to the wireless network. Upon investigation, the support team discovers a pattern indicating that after a tenant with a particularly large attendance ends its sessions, tenants throughout the day are unable to connect. The following settings are common to all network configurations:
Which of the following actions would MOST likely reduce this issue? (Choose two.)
options: Reduce the DHCP lease time to four hours.
Change the DHCP scope end to 10.1.10.250.
questions.explanation: The scope offers only 91 addresses and all are leased for eight days, so one large event exhausts the pool for later tenants; shortening the lease to four hours and extending the scope end to 10.1.10.250 return and add addresses. The gateway and DNS at 10.1.10.1 already work, and AP isolation does not stop clients from obtaining an address.

questions.text:
When accessing corporate network resources, users are required to authenticate to each application they try to access.
Which of the following concepts does this BEST represent?
questions.explanation: Requiring authentication for every application access, rather than trusting anything by default, reflects the Zero Trust principle of continuous verification. SSO would instead let users authenticate once for multiple applications.

questions.text:
Logs show an unauthorized IP address entering a secure part of the network every night at 8:00 p.m. The network administrator is concerned that this IP address will cause an issue to a critical server and would like to deny the IP address at the edge of the network.
Which of the following solutions would address these concerns?
options: Changing the VLAN of the web server
Installing a rule on the firewall connected to the web server
questions.explanation: An ACL at the network edge can explicitly deny traffic from the unauthorized IP address before it reaches internal resources. A firewall rule specific to the web server would not stop the traffic at the network edge as requested.

questions.text:
A network administrator is troubleshooting a connectivity performance issue. As part of the troubleshooting process, the administrator performs a traceroute from the client to the server, and also from the server to the client. While comparing the outputs, the administrator notes they show different hops between the hosts.
Which of the following BEST explains these findings?
questions.explanation: Different traceroute paths in each direction indicate asymmetric routing, where traffic takes different paths depending on direction. A routing loop or switch loop would cause repeated hops or connectivity failure, not simply differing paths.

questions.text:
A technician is troubleshooting reports that a networked printer is unavailable. The printer's IP address is configured with a DHCP reservation, but the address cannot be pinged from the print server in the same subnet.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause of the connectivity failure?
questions.explanation: If the printer is on an incorrect VLAN, it would be isolated from the print server despite having a valid IP address, causing the ping to fail. DNS failure or gateway issues wouldn't prevent a same-subnet ping via IP address.

questions.text:
A systems operator is granted access to a monitoring application, configuration application, and timekeeping application. The operator is denied access to the financial and project management applications by the system's security configuration.
Which of the following BEST describes the security principle in use?
questions.explanation: Granting access only to the applications needed for the job function while denying others reflects the principle of least privilege. Separation of duties involves dividing critical tasks among multiple people, not restricting application access based on role need.

questions.text:
A technician is connecting a Cat 6 Ethernet cable to a device that only has LC ports.
Which of the following will the technician MOST likely use to accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: A media converter allows connecting copper Ethernet cabling to fiber LC ports by converting the signal between media types. A bridge or repeater does not perform this copper-to-fiber conversion.

questions.text:
After a critical power issue, the network team was not receiving UPS status notifications. The network team would like to be alerted on these status changes.
Which of the following would be BEST to use for these notifications?
questions.explanation: SNMP traps allow devices like a UPS to proactively send status change notifications to a monitoring system. A MIB is just the database of manageable objects, not the notification mechanism itself.

questions.text:
Users in a branch can access an in-house database server, but it is taking too long to fetch records. The analyst does not know whether the issue is being caused by network latency.
Which of the following will the analyst MOST likely use to retrieve the metrics that are needed to resolve this issue?
questions.explanation: SNMP allows the analyst to poll network devices for performance metrics like latency, bandwidth, and errors to isolate whether the network is causing the slow database access. Syslog provides event logs, not real-time performance metrics.

questions.text: At which of the following OSI model layers does an IMAP client run?
questions.explanation: IMAP is an application-layer protocol, operating at Layer 7 of the OSI model, where email clients interact with mail servers. Layers 2, 4, and 6 correspond to data link, transport, and presentation, none of which run application protocols like IMAP.

questions.text: Which of the following would be the LEAST expensive recovery solution for a company's lower-priority applications?
questions.explanation: A cold site is just space with power and connectivity but no configured equipment or data, making it the cheapest option and acceptable for lower-priority applications that tolerate long recovery times. A warm site keeps hardware and partial data ready, so it costs considerably more.

questions.text: Which of the following network devices can perform routing between VLANs?
questions.explanation: A Layer 3 switch has routing capabilities and can route traffic between VLANs, unlike a Layer 2 switch which only switches within a VLAN. Bridges and load balancers do not perform inter-VLAN routing.

questions.text:
A network administrator wants to test the throughput of a new metro Ethernet circuit to verify that its performance matches the requirements specified in the SLA.
Which of the following would BEST help measure the throughput?
questions.explanation: iPerf is specifically designed to measure network throughput between two endpoints, making it ideal for verifying SLA performance. Ping measures latency and packet loss, not throughput.

questions.text:
A Wi-Fi network was recently deployed in a new, multilevel building. Several issues are now being reported related to latency and drops in coverage.
Which of the following is the FIRST step to troubleshoot the issues?
questions.explanation: A site survey (including heat mapping and spectrum analysis) is the first step to characterize coverage, interference, and multi-floor bleed-through before changing anything. Reviewing AP placement is an action taken based on the survey's findings, not the initial data-gathering step.

questions.text: Which of the following is the primary function of the core layer of the three-tiered model?
questions.explanation: In the three-tiered model the core is the high-speed backbone whose job is to switch/forward traffic as fast as possible with no policy processing; routing, filtering, and policy belong to the distribution layer.

questions.text:
An IT officer is installing a new WAP.
Which of the following must the officer change to connect users securely to the WAP?
options: Channel to the highest frequency within the band
questions.explanation: Enabling AES encryption (used in WPA2/WPA3) is required to securely connect users, replacing the weaker TKIP protocol. Changing channel frequency or DFS settings does not address encryption/security.

questions.text:
To comply with an industry regulation, all communication destined to a secure server should be logged and archived on a storage device.
Which of the following can be configured to fulfill this requirement?
questions.explanation: Port mirroring copies traffic to a monitoring port so it can be logged and archived, fulfilling the compliance requirement. QoS and LACP do not provide traffic capture for logging purposes.

questions.text: Which of the following routing protocols is generally used by major ISPs for handling large-scale internet traffic?
questions.explanation: BGP is the path-vector protocol used by ISPs to route traffic between autonomous systems across the internet. RIP, EIGRP, and OSPF are interior gateway protocols used within a single organization's network.

questions.text:
A technician is consolidating a topology with multiple SSIDs into one unique SSID deployment.
Which of the following features will be possible after this new configuration?
questions.explanation: Consolidating multiple SSIDs into one enables seamless roaming as clients move between access points using the same SSID without re-authenticating. Basic service set and WPA are unrelated to SSID consolidation.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to provide disaster recovery capabilities to spin up all critical devices using internet resources?
questions.explanation: A cloud site uses internet-based resources to spin up critical infrastructure for disaster recovery. Hot, warm, and cold sites refer to physical facility readiness levels, not internet resource-based recovery.

questions.text: Which of the following attack vectors represents a large number of devices sending access requests to a website, making it unavailable to respond?
questions.explanation: A DDoS attack involves numerous devices flooding a target with requests to overwhelm it, matching the description. A botnet is the collection of compromised devices used to carry out such attacks, but the attack itself is the DDoS.

questions.text:
Several end users viewing a training video report seeing pixelated images while watching. A network administrator reviews the core switch and is unable to find an immediate cause.
Which of the following BEST explains what is occurring?
questions.explanation: Pixelation and macroblocking in video playback indicate insufficient bandwidth causing dropped/compressed frames, especially when the switch itself shows no faults. Jitter primarily produces stutter, buffering, and audio breakup rather than image artifacting.

questions.text:
An international company is transferring its IT assets, including a number of WAPs, from the United States to an office in Europe for deployment.
Which of the following considerations should the company research before implementing the wireless hardware?
questions.explanation: Regulatory impacts, such as differing frequency allocations and power limits between the US and Europe, must be researched before deploying wireless hardware internationally. 802.11 standards are generally consistent globally, but regulatory domains differ.

questions.text:
A company is moving to a new building designed with a guest waiting area that has existing network ports.
Which of the following practices would BEST secure the network?
options: Ensure all guests sign an NDA.
Disable unneeded switchports in the area.
Lower the radio strength to reduce Wi-Fi coverage in the waiting area.
Enable MAC filtering to block unknown hardware addresses.
questions.explanation: Disabling unneeded switchports in the guest waiting area prevents unauthorized devices from physically plugging into the network. MAC filtering is easily bypassed by spoofing, making it less effective.

questions.text:
A network technician receives a support ticket about an employee who has misplaced a company-owned cell phone that contains private company information.
Which of the following actions should the network technician take to prevent data loss?
questions.explanation: Executing a remote wipe erases company data from the lost device to prevent data loss. Locking the phone or disabling the account does not remove sensitive data already stored on the device.

questions.text:
A network technician is having issues connecting an IoT sensor to the internet. The WLAN settings were entered via a custom command line, and a proper IP address assignment was received on the wireless interface. However, when trying to connect to the internet, only HTTP redirections are being received when data is requested.
Which of the following will point to the root cause of the issue?
options: Verifying if an encryption protocol mismatch exists.
Verifying if a captive portal is active for the WLAN.
Verifying the minimum RSSI for operation in the device's documentation.
Verifying EIRP power settings on the access point.
questions.explanation: Receiving HTTP redirections instead of actual data strongly indicates a captive portal is intercepting traffic, common on WLANs requiring web-based authentication. Encryption mismatches or RSSI issues would prevent connection entirely, not cause redirects.

questions.text: Which of the following topologies requires the MOST connections when designing a network?
questions.explanation: A full mesh topology requires the most connections since every node connects directly to every other node. Star, bus, and ring topologies require far fewer total connections.

questions.text:
A technician removes an old PC from the network and replaces it with a new PC that is unable to connect to the LAN.
Which of the following is MOST likely the cause of the issue?
questions.explanation: Port security restricts a switchport to specific learned or configured MAC addresses, so a new PC with a different MAC address would be blocked from connecting. Port mirroring and aggregation do not restrict device connectivity.

questions.text:
A medical building offers patients Wi-Fi in the waiting room.
Which of the following security features would be the BEST solution to provide secure connections and keep the medical data protected?
questions.explanation: Isolating the guest network keeps patient Wi-Fi traffic separate from the internal network carrying sensitive medical data, protecting it from guest device threats. MAC filtering is easily circumvented and doesn't isolate traffic.

questions.text:
An administrator notices that after contact with several switches in an MDF they failed due to electrostatic discharge.
Which of the following sensors should the administrator deploy to BEST monitor static electricity conditions in the MDF?
questions.explanation: Humidity sensors monitor conditions related to static electricity, since low humidity increases electrostatic discharge risk. Temperature and smoke sensors do not directly relate to ESD conditions.

questions.text:
A network administrator is reviewing the network device logs on a syslog server. The messages are normal, but the time stamps on the messages are incorrect.
Which of the following actions should the administrator take to ensure the log message time stamps are correct?
options: Change the NTP settings on the network device.
Change the time on the syslog server.
Adjust the timeout settings on the syslog server.
Adjust the SSH settings on the network device.
questions.explanation: Correcting NTP settings on the network device ensures accurate time synchronization, fixing incorrect timestamps in the log messages sent to syslog. Changing the syslog server's time would not fix the source device's incorrect clock.

questions.text:
Two network technicians are installing a fiber-optic link between routers. The technicians used a light meter to verify the correct fibers. However, when they connect the fibers to the router interface, the link does not connect.
Which of the following would explain the issue? (Choose two.)
options: They used the wrong type of fiber transceiver.
Incorrect TX/RX polarity exists on the link.
The connection has duplexing configuration issues.
Halogen light fixtures are causing interference.
One of the technicians installed a loopback adapter.
questions.explanation: Using the wrong transceiver type (e.g., mismatched wavelength or connector) or incorrect TX/RX polarity (fibers swapped) are common causes of a fiber link failing to establish even when individual fiber strands test correctly with a light meter. Duplexing issues and interference are not typical causes for fiber links.

questions.text: Which of the following protocols would enable a company to upgrade its internet connection by acquiring its own public IP prefixes and autonomous system number?
questions.explanation: BGP is required to advertise a company's own public IP prefixes and autonomous system number to multiple upstream providers, enabling multihoming. EIGRP and MPLS are not used for this purpose, and IPv6 is a protocol suite, not a routing solution for AS management.

questions.text:
A network technician is performing tests on a potentially faulty network card that is installed in a server.
Which of the following addresses will MOST likely be used during traffic diagnostic tests?
questions.explanation: The loopback address 127.0.0.1 is used to test the local network stack and NIC functionality without sending traffic onto the physical network. The other addresses are external or subnet addresses not used for local diagnostics.

questions.text:
An administrator would like to create a fault-tolerant ring between three switches within a Layer 2 network.
Which of the following Ethernet features should the administrator employ?
questions.explanation: Spanning Tree Protocol prevents Layer 2 loops while allowing a fault-tolerant redundant ring topology between switches by blocking/unblocking links as needed. OSPF and interior gateway protocols operate at Layer 3, and port mirroring is used for traffic monitoring, not redundancy.

questions.text: During a risk assessment, which of the following should be considered when planning to mitigate high CPU utilization of a firewall?
questions.explanation: Load balancing distributes traffic across multiple firewalls to reduce CPU strain on any single device. Recovery time objective relates to disaster recovery planning, not real-time resource mitigation.

questions.text:
A network engineer is monitoring a fiber uplink to a remote office and notes the uplink has been operating at 100% capacity for a long duration.
Which of the following performance metrics is MOST likely to be impacted with sustained link saturation?
questions.explanation: Sustained link saturation causes packets to queue, increasing latency. Bandwidth and speed are the link's capacity, which is fixed, not directly caused by saturation itself, while jitter is variation in latency but latency increase is the primary direct effect.

questions.text: Which of the following would be used to adjust resources dynamically for a virtual web server under variable loads?
questions.explanation: Elastic computing allows cloud resources to automatically scale up or down based on demand, ideal for variable web server loads. Scalable networking is not a standard cloud characteristic term used in this context.

questions.text:
A technician discovered that some information on the local database server was changed during a file transfer to a remote server.
Which of the following should concern the technician the MOST?
questions.explanation: Unauthorized modification of data during transfer is a violation of integrity, which ensures data remains unaltered. Confidentiality concerns unauthorized viewing, not alteration.

questions.text:
During a client audit, a network analyst is tasked with recommending changes to upgrade the client network and readiness. A field technician has submitted the following report:
Based on this report, which of the following metrics or sensors would be the BEST recommendation to the client?
questions.explanation: The report shows 92F at the rack, fans pinned high and fourteen over-temperature alarms with only one vent and no exhaust, so temperature monitoring is the best addition. Humidity is not a concern at a steady 41% RH, the room is dry with no plumbing, and UPS/power logs are clean.
questions.exhibit:

-----------------------------------------------------------------
Equipment:     42U rack, 2 access switches, 1 router, 1 UPS
Power:         Dedicated 20A circuit; UPS load 35%; no events logged
Water risk:    2nd floor, no plumbing overhead, floor dry, no drains
Hygrometer:    41% RH, stable across the two-day visit
Airflow:       One ceiling vent, door kept closed, no exhaust fan
Observations:  Rack-mounted thermometer read 92F (33C) at midday
               Switch chassis fans running continuously at high speed
Device logs:   %ENVMON-2-OVERTEMP: inlet sensor above threshold (x14)
               UPS log: no input power anomalies in 90 days
Monitoring:    UPS sends SNMP power traps only; no other sensors

questions.text:
After HVAC failures caused network outages, the support team decides to monitor the temperatures of all the devices. The network administrator cannot find a command that will display this information.
Which of the following will retrieve the necessary information?
questions.explanation: SNMP OID values allow retrieval of specific device metrics like temperature via polling, which standard commands cannot provide. NetFlow tracks traffic flow data, not hardware temperature.

questions.text:
Several employees have expressed concerns about the company monitoring their internet activity when they are working from home. The company wants to mitigate this issue and reassure employees that their private internet activity is not being monitored.
Which of the following would satisfy company and employee needs?
questions.explanation: A split tunnel routes only company-related traffic through the VPN while personal internet activity stays outside company monitoring, addressing privacy concerns. A full tunnel routes all traffic through the company network, which would still monitor personal activity.

questions.text:
A company needs a redundant link to provide a channel to the management network in an incident response scenario.
Which of the following remote access methods provides the BEST solution?
questions.explanation: Out-of-band access provides a separate, dedicated management channel independent of the primary network, ensuring access during incidents even if the main network fails. Split-tunnel connections relate to VPN traffic routing, not dedicated management access.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to configure a server to use the most accurate NTP reference available.
Which of the following NTP devices should the administrator select?
questions.explanation: Stratum 1 servers are directly connected to a reference clock, providing the most accurate time source. Higher stratum numbers are further from the reference clock and less accurate.

questions.text: Which of the following devices is used to configure and centrally manage access points installed at different locations?
questions.explanation: A wireless controller centrally manages and configures multiple access points across various locations. Load balancers and proxy servers do not manage wireless access point configurations.

questions.text:
A user reports that a new VoIP phone works properly, but the computer that is connected to the phone cannot access any network resources.
Which of the following MOST likely needs to be configured correctly to provide network connectivity to the computer?
questions.explanation: VoIP phones often use a daisy-chained port with separate VLANs for voice and data; if the data VLAN tag isn't configured correctly, the connected computer cannot reach network resources. Port duplex settings would typically cause performance issues, not complete lack of connectivity.

questions.text:
A technician is investigating packet loss to a device that has varying data bursts throughout the day.
Which of the following will the technician MOST likely configure to resolve the issue?
questions.explanation: Flow control manages data transmission rates to prevent buffer overflow during bursty traffic, reducing packet loss. Jumbo frames address throughput efficiency for large transfers, not burst-induced loss.

questions.text: Which of the following connector types would be used to connect to the demarcation point and provide network access to a cable modem?
questions.explanation: F-type connectors are used with coaxial cable to connect cable modems to the demarcation point. RJ45 is used for Ethernet, not the coaxial cable modem connection to the ISP.

questions.text: Which of the following provides guidance to an employee about restricting non-business access to the company's videoconferencing solution?
questions.explanation: An acceptable use policy outlines rules for appropriate use of company resources, including restrictions on non-business use of videoconferencing tools. A standard operating procedure describes how to perform tasks, not usage restrictions.

questions.text: Which of the following would MOST likely utilize PoE?
questions.explanation: Cameras, especially IP security cameras, commonly use Power over Ethernet to receive both power and data over a single cable. Modems typically require standard AC power and are not PoE-powered devices.

questions.text:
A security administrator is trying to prevent incorrect IP addresses from being assigned to clients on the network.
Which of the following would MOST likely prevent this and allow the network to continue to operate?
options: Configuring DHCP snooping on the switch
Preventing broadcast messages leaving the client network
Blocking ports 67/68 on the client network
Enabling port security on access ports
questions.explanation: DHCP snooping filters untrusted DHCP messages, preventing rogue DHCP servers from assigning incorrect IP addresses while allowing legitimate DHCP traffic to continue. Blocking ports 67/68 would disable DHCP entirely, breaking network operation.

questions.text: Which of the following can have multiple VLAN interfaces?
questions.explanation: A Layer 3 switch can have multiple switched virtual interfaces (SVIs), each representing a VLAN with its own IP addressing. Hubs and bridges operate at Layer 1/2 and do not support VLAN interfaces.

questions.text:
A network technician needs to ensure that all files on a company's network can be moved in a safe and protected manner without interception from someone who is not the intended recipient.
Which of the following would allow the network technician to meet these requirements?
questions.explanation: SFTP encrypts file transfers, protecting data from interception, unlike FTP or TFTP which transmit data in plaintext. SMTP is used for email, not file transfer.

questions.text:
A device is connected to a managed Layer 3 network switch. The MAC address of the device is known, but the static IP address assigned to the device is not.
Which of the following features of a Layer 3 network switch should be used to determine the IPv4 address of the device?
questions.explanation: The ARP table maps known MAC addresses to their corresponding IP addresses, allowing the administrator to look up the device's IPv4 address. The MAC table only maps MAC addresses to switch ports, not IP addresses.

questions.text: Which of the following is the IEEE link cost for a Fast Ethernet interface in STP calculations?
questions.explanation: IEEE 802.1D STP path cost for a 100Mbps Fast Ethernet interface is 19, per the revised cost table. Older 10Mbps costs were 100.

questions.text:
Two users on a LAN establish a video call.
Which of the following OSI model layers ensures the initiation, coordination, and termination of the call?
questions.explanation: The Session layer manages establishment, coordination, and termination of communication sessions such as video calls, unlike Transport which handles segmentation and reliable delivery.

questions.text:
A network administrator received a report stating a critical vulnerability was detected on an application that is exposed to the internet.
Which of the following is the appropriate NEXT step?
options: Check for the existence of a known exploit in order to assess the risk.
Immediately shut down the vulnerable application server.
Install a network access control agent on the server.
Deploy a new server to host the application.
questions.explanation: Before taking drastic action, the administrator should assess actual risk by checking for a known exploit; shutting down the server prematurely could cause unnecessary downtime.

questions.text:
A company is utilizing multifactor authentication for data center access.
Which of the following is the MOST effective security mechanism against physical intrusions due to stolen credentials?
questions.explanation: Biometrics ties authentication to a physical trait that cannot be stolen like a card or password, making it most effective against stolen credentials, unlike card readers which rely on possession alone.

questions.text:
A help desk technician is concerned that a client's network cable issues may be causing intermittent connectivity.
Which of the following would help the technician determine if this is the issue?
options: Run the show interface command on the switch.
Run the traceroute command on the server.
Run iperf on the technician's desktop.
Ping the client's computer from the router.
Run a port scanner on the client's IP address.
questions.explanation: Checking interface statistics via show interface reveals cable-related errors like CRC or collisions indicating physical layer issues, whereas iperf or traceroute test throughput/path, not cable integrity.

questions.text:
An ISP is unable to provide services to a user in a remote area through cable and DSL.
Which of the following is the NEXT best solution to provide services without adding external infrastructure?
questions.explanation: Satellite internet requires no new external infrastructure like poles or cables, making it ideal for remote areas lacking cable/DSL. Fiber, leased lines, and metro optical all require significant new physical infrastructure buildout.

questions.text:
A new global ISP needs to connect from central offices in North America to the United Kingdom.
Which of the following would be the BEST cabling solution for this project?
questions.explanation: Single-mode fiber supports the long transoceanic distances needed between North America and the UK, while copper-based options like Cat 6a or coaxial cannot span such distances.

questions.text:
A network engineer developed a plan of action to resolve an ongoing issue.
Which of the following steps should the engineer take NEXT?
options: Verify full system functionality and implement preventative measures.
Implement the solution to resolve the problem.
Document findings, actions, outcomes, and lessons learned.
Establish a theory of probable cause.
questions.explanation: Following the troubleshooting methodology, after establishing a plan of action the next step is to implement the solution, before verifying functionality or documenting.

questions.text: Which of the following documents would be used to define uptime commitments from a provider, along with details on measurement and enforcement?
questions.explanation: A Service Level Agreement defines uptime commitments, measurement, and enforcement terms with a provider, unlike an NDA which covers confidentiality.

questions.text:
Switch 3 was recently added to an existing stack to extend connectivity to various parts of the network. After the update, new employees were not able to print to the main networked copiers from their workstations. Following are the port configurations for the switch stack in question:
Switch 1:Switch 2:Switch 3:
Which of the following should be configured to resolve the issue? (Choose two.)
options: Enable the printer ports on Switch 3.
Reconfigure the duplex settings on the printer ports on Switch 3.
Reconfigure the VLAN on all printer ports to VLAN 20.
Enable all ports that are shut down on the stack.
Reconfigure the VLAN on the printer ports on Switch 3.
questions.explanation: On Switch 3 the copier ports Gi3/0/21-22 are disabled and sit in VLAN 20 instead of the printer VLAN 30 used on Switches 1 and 2, so they must be enabled and moved to VLAN 30. Changing all printer ports to VLAN 20 would break the working copiers, and the Gi*/0/23-24 ports are intentionally reserved and unused.

questions.text:
A network administrator is setting up a new phone system and needs to define the location where VoIP phones can download configuration files.
Which of the following DHCP services can be used to accomplish this task?
questions.explanation: DHCP scope options (such as option 66) can specify a TFTP server location for VoIP phones to download configuration files, unlike exclusion ranges or lease time settings.

questions.text:
An engineer needs to restrict the database servers that are in the same subnet from communicating with each other. The database servers will still need to communicate with the application servers in a different subnet. In some cases, the database servers will be clustered, and the servers will need to communicate with other cluster members.
Which of the following technologies will be BEST to use to implement this filtering without creating rules?
questions.explanation: Private VLANs isolate hosts within the same subnet using promiscuous, isolated, and community ports without requiring per-rule ACL configuration, while still allowing communication with other subnets.

questions.text:
A technician was cleaning a storage closet and found a box of transceivers labeled 8Gbps.
Which of the following protocols uses those transceivers?
questions.explanation: Fibre Channel transceivers commonly come in speeds like 8Gbps for SAN connectivity, distinguishing them from Ethernet-based GBICs or iSCSI which runs over standard Ethernet.

questions.text:
A customer wants to log in to a vendor's server using a web browser on a laptop.
Which of the following would require the LEAST configuration to allow encrypted access to the server?
questions.explanation: Using SSL/TLS (HTTPS) in a browser requires no client configuration for encrypted access, unlike VPN solutions which require client setup and tunnel configuration.

questions.text:
A user calls the IT department to report being unable to log in after locking the computer. The user resets the password, but later in the day the user is again unable to log in after locking the computer.
Which of the following attacks against the user is MOST likely taking place?
questions.explanation: Repeated login failures after password resets suggest a brute-force attack attempting to guess the password, rather than deauthentication or phishing which don't directly cause lockouts.

questions.text:
A network administrator determines that even when optimal wireless coverage is configured, the network users still report constant disconnections. After troubleshooting, the administrator determines that moving from one location to another causes the disconnection.
Which of the following settings should provide better network stability?
questions.explanation: Adjusting the RSSI roaming threshold helps devices roam to a stronger access point sooner as signal weakens while moving, reducing disconnections, unlike EIRP or attenuation settings which affect coverage area only.

questions.text: At which of the following layers of the OSI model will the administrator MOST likely start to troubleshoot when a network is experiencing a number of CRC errors?
questions.explanation: CRC errors indicate frame corruption typically caused by physical layer issues like cabling, interference, or duplex mismatches, so troubleshooting starts at Layer 1.

questions.text: Which of the following uses the link-state routing algorithm and operates within a single autonomous system?
questions.explanation: OSPF is a link-state routing protocol that operates within a single autonomous system, unlike BGP which is used between autonomous systems.

questions.text:
A network administrator is designing a wireless network. The administrator must ensure a rented office space has a sufficient signal. Reducing exposure to the wireless network is important, but it is secondary to the primary objective.
Which of the following would MOST likely facilitate the correct accessibility to the Wi-Fi network?
questions.explanation: Selecting the appropriate antenna type allows the administrator to shape coverage to fit the rented space while limiting signal spillover, balancing accessibility with reduced exposure.

questions.text:
An office area contains two PoE-enabled WAPs. After the area was remodeled, new cable uplinks were installed in the ceiling above the fluorescent lights. However, after the WAPs were reconnected, users reported slowness and application errors. An intern reviewed the network and discovered a lot of CRC errors. A network engineer reviewed the intern's work and realized UTP cabling was used.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the CRC errors?
questions.explanation: Running UTP cabling near fluorescent lighting fixtures introduces electromagnetic interference, causing CRC errors, rather than pinout or PoE incompatibility issues.

questions.text:
Several users with older devices are reporting intermittent connectivity while in an outdoor patio area. After some research, the network administrator determines that an outdoor WAP might help with the issue. However, the company does not want the signal to bleed into the building and cause interference.
Which of the following should the network administrator perform to BEST resolve the issue?
options: Disable the SSID broadcast on the WAP in the patio area.
Install a WAP and enable 5GHz only within the patio area.
Install a directional WAP in the direction of the patio.
Install a repeater on the back wall of the patio area.
questions.explanation: A directional WAP aimed at the patio focuses coverage outward and limits signal bleed into the building, unlike an omnidirectional WAP or repeater which would spread signal more broadly.

questions.text: Which of the following is most likely to have the HIGHEST latency while being the most accessible?
questions.explanation: Satellite internet has the highest latency due to signal travel distance to geostationary orbit, but it is accessible virtually anywhere, including remote areas without terrestrial infrastructure.

questions.text: Which of the following is used to elect an STP root?
questions.explanation: The root bridge election compares bridge IDs (priority plus MAC address); the lowest bridge ID wins. BPDUs are merely the frames that carry and advertise those IDs, so they are the transport, not the criterion used to elect the root.

questions.text: Which of the following commands can be used to display the IP address, subnet address, gateway address, and DNS address on a Windows computer?
questions.explanation: ipconfig /all displays full IP configuration details including IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and DNS servers on Windows. ifconfig and ip addr are Linux/Unix commands, not applicable to Windows.

questions.text:
A user calls the help desk to report being unable to reach a file server. The technician logs in to the user’s computer and verifies that pings fail to respond back when trying to reach the file server.
Which of the following would BEST help the technician verify whether the file server is reachable?
questions.explanation: Traceroute shows the path packets take and where connectivity fails, helping determine if the file server is reachable and where the failure occurs. Ping already failed, so nslookup only resolves names, not reachability.

questions.text:
An employee reports to a network administrator that internet access is not working.
Which of the following should the administrator do FIRST?
options: Establish a theory of probable cause.
Ask the user to restart the computer.
questions.explanation: The first step in the troubleshooting methodology is to identify the problem, which includes gathering information and identifying symptoms. Establishing a theory comes after symptoms are identified.

questions.text:
A security engineer is installing a new IDS on the network. The engineer has asked a network administrator to ensure all traffic entering and leaving the router interface is available for the IDS.
Which of the following should the network administrator do?
options: Install a network tap for the IDS.
Configure ACLs to route traffic to the IDS.
Install an additional NIC into the IDS.
Install a loopback adapter for the IDS.
Add an additional route on the router for the IDS.
questions.explanation: A network tap passively copies all traffic passing through a link to a monitoring device like an IDS without disrupting traffic flow. Configuring ACLs would only route specific traffic, not provide full visibility.

questions.text:
An employee working in a warehouse facility is experiencing interruptions in mobile applications while walking around the facility. According to a recent site survey, the WLAN comprises autonomous APs that are directly connected to the internet, providing adequate signal coverage.
Which of the following is the BEST solution to improve network stability?
options: Implement client roaming using an extended service deployment employing a wireless controller.
Remove omnidirectional antennas and adopt a directional bridge.
Ensure all APs of the warehouse support MIMO and Wi-Fi 4.
Verify that the level of EIRP power settings is set to the maximum permitted by regulations.
questions.explanation: Autonomous APs lack centralized coordination, causing poor roaming as clients move; a wireless controller with an extended service set enables seamless roaming across APs. Maximizing EIRP or antenna changes wouldn't fix the roaming handoff issue.

questions.text: Which of the following will reduce routing table lookups by performing packet forwarding decisions independently of the network layer header?
questions.explanation: MPLS uses labels to forward packets instead of consulting routing tables based on the network layer header, speeding up forwarding decisions. EIGRP and VRRP are routing/redundancy protocols, not label-switching mechanisms.

questions.text:
While walking from the parking lot to an access-controlled door, an employee sees an authorized user open the door. Then the employee notices that another person catches the door before it closes and goes inside.
Which of the following attacks is taking place?
questions.explanation: The second person grabs the door on their own with no indication the authorized user consented or held it for them, which is tailgating. Piggybacking requires the authorized person's knowledge and cooperation, which the scenario never states.

questions.text:
Given the following information:
Which of the following would cause performance degradation between PC A and PC B?
questions.explanation: The 146 m run far exceeds the 100 m Ethernet channel limit, so the signal weakens over distance and the link drops packets: that is attenuation. Decibel loss would point to connector or splice loss in an otherwise compliant link, and the wire map passed and no EMI sources were found, ruling out incorrect pinout and interference.

questions.text:
An engineer recently decided to upgrade the firmware on a router. During the upgrade, the help desk received calls about a network outage, and a critical ticket was opened. The network manager would like to create a policy to prevent this from happening in the future.
Which of the following documents should the manager create?
questions.explanation: A change management policy establishes a formal process for reviewing, approving, and scheduling changes like firmware upgrades to prevent unplanned outages. Standard operating procedure describes routine tasks, not change approval processes.

questions.text:
A technician is deploying a new SSID for an industrial control system. The control devices require the network to use encryption that employs TKIP and a symmetrical password to connect.
Which of the following should the technician configure to ensure compatibility with the control devices?
questions.explanation: WPA-PSK uses TKIP encryption with a pre-shared (symmetrical) password, matching the industrial control system's requirements. WPA2-PSK typically uses AES/CCMP, not TKIP, by default.

questions.text: Which of the following ports should be used to securely receive mail that is synchronized across multiple devices?
questions.explanation: Port 993 is used for IMAPS, which securely synchronizes mail across multiple devices while keeping messages on the server. Port 110 (POP3) does not support synchronization across multiple devices as effectively.

questions.text:
A network administrator is getting reports of some internal users who cannot connect to network resources. The users state they were able to connect last week, but not today. No changes have been configured on the network devices or server during the last few weeks.
Which of the following is the MOST likely cause of the issue?
options: The client DHCP scope is fully utilized.
The wired network is experiencing electrical interference.
The captive portal is down and needs to be restarted.
The packet counter on the router interface is high.
questions.explanation: If the DHCP scope is exhausted, new or renewing clients cannot obtain valid IP addresses, causing connectivity failures without any configuration changes. The other options don't explain a sudden loss of connectivity for previously working users.

questions.text:
A network administrator needs to provide evidence to confirm that recent network outages were caused by increased traffic generated by a recently released application.
Which of the following actions will BEST support the administrator's response?
options: Generate a network baseline report for comparison.
Plot interface statistics for dropped packets.
questions.explanation: NetFlow records flows by source, destination, port, and volume, so it can directly attribute the traffic surge to the new application. A baseline report shows that utilization rose but cannot identify which application generated the traffic.

questions.text:
During a recent security audit, a contracted penetration tester discovered the organization uses a number of insecure protocols.
Which of the following ports should be disallowed so only encrypted protocols are allowed? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Port 23 (Telnet) and port 69 (TFTP) are insecure, unencrypted protocols that should be disabled in favor of secure alternatives like SSH and SFTP. Ports 22, 443, and 587 are used for encrypted or secure protocols (SSH, HTTPS, SMTP submission with TLS).

questions.text:
A technician is configuring a static IP address on a new device in a newly created subnet. The work order specifies the following requirements:

• The IP address should use the highest address available in the subnet.
• The default gateway needs to be set to 172.28.85.94.
• The subnet mask needs to be 255.255.255.224.

Which of the following addresses should the engineer apply to the device?
questions.explanation: With a /27 subnet (255.255.255.224), the range is .64-.95, with .95 as broadcast; the highest usable host address is .93, since .94 is already used as the gateway. Address .95 is the broadcast address and cannot be assigned to a device.

questions.text:
A network technician is troubleshooting an area where the wireless connection to devices is poor. The technician theorizes that the signal-to-noise ratio in the area is causing the issue.
Which of the following should the technician do NEXT?
options: Run diagnostics on the relevant devices.
Move the access point to a different location.
Escalate the issue to the vendor's support team.
Remove any electronics that might be causing interference.
questions.explanation: Removing suspected interference sources directly tests the signal-to-noise theory: if the wireless connection improves, the noise hypothesis is confirmed. Running device diagnostics examines the clients, not the RF noise floor the technician suspects.

questions.text: Which of the following must be functioning properly in order for a network administrator to create an accurate timeline during a troubleshooting process?
questions.explanation: NTP ensures accurate and synchronized timestamps across devices, which is essential for creating a correct chronological timeline during troubleshooting. Syslog collects logs but relies on accurate time from NTP to be useful for timelines.

questions.text:
A large metropolitan city is looking to standardize the ability for police department laptops to connect to the city government's VPN. The city would like a wireless solution that provides the largest coverage across the city with a minimal number of transmission towers. Latency and overall bandwidth needs are not high priorities.
Which of the following would BEST meet the city's needs?
questions.explanation: LTE cellular technology provides wide-area coverage across a city using fewer towers, ideal for VPN connectivity without high bandwidth or low latency requirements. Wi-Fi standards require many more access points to cover a citywide area compared to cellular technology.
